author: Samuel Lin
review_text:
Did I mention this was the best dinner of my 10-day trip to the U.S.?

An absolutely wonderful experience — every dish was fantastic. I especially recommend the Cajun seafood pasta; it instantly became one of the top three pasta dishes I’ve ever had.

Beyond the food, the service truly stood out. Every server was warm, friendly, and attentive, which made the whole experience even more memorable.

Highly recommended if you’re visiting Las Vegas!

author: Amber A
review_text: First time eating at Triple George and it did not disappoint.  We were a party of 6 on Christmas Day.  Service was great.  Drinks came quickly from the bar.   The Vanilla Raspberry Martini was delicious.  One of the best french onion soups I've ever had.  Great downtown restaurant.

author: CariAnne Behr Huffman
review_text: We stayed the Downtown Grand for one night and wanted a delicious meal with great service without a strict dress code, but not a tourist place, so we chose to eat here. The ambiance was perfection, but the service even better — with (of course) delicious food and drink!!  Our server, Rebbecca, was one of the two best servers we’ve ever had, and she tied with the other: beautiful smile, friendly, perfect timing! The food would bring us back, she makes us recommend it to others!!

author: J M (Texas Foodie)
review_text:
Slow.  And I mean painfully slow service. Maybe they are understaffed?   IDK.  I ate at the bar.

I started with the wedge that was ok but it had hardly any dressing and it was supposed to have bacon on it and I maybe had two bites.

For an entree I got the filet mignon with bearnaise sauce.  The filet was tasty but not Ruth’s Chris tasty.  Good flavor but not as tender as Ruth’s Chris or other high end steak houses.   Probably won’t be back.

author: Tina Bueno
review_text: LOVE LOVE Triple George Grill for dinner and lunch… we stopped in today for brunch and again, LOVE!!  Always a memorable downtown dining experience, decadent steaks,classic cocktails, and the BEST service!! Thank you to our bartender this morning, exceptional service by Joy!

author: Judy K
review_text: We had a group birthday dinner for over 20 people, and Triple George was a great choice! The room was comfortable, and the wood tone walls made the room very warm and easy to decorate. The staff worked hard, and the food was great. The calamari was a particular hit, and people said it was the best they ever had! The location is perfect with a 2 minute walk to Freemont Street after dinner. I was very happy that I had booked The Triple George!

author: BREW
review_text: Triple George is on par with the best. We have never had a bad meal or experience. Todd makes the best drinks and his vibrant personality just adds even more fun to the experience. Tana is also amazing and so attentive to requests you really feel special. LOVE this place!!

author: Jeff Petersen
review_text:
Great place downtown Vegas, just a block off Fremont Street.
Nice old school steakhouse vibe.
Real good steaks and seafood.
No wait for our table with reservation. Very good service.
Very cool long bar with seating; also some booths and tables for dining. Very extensive cocktail list.
Tableside prepared Cesar salad for 2 was very nice presentation, but it was just average tasting in our opinion.
Good portions- not huge (unless you order the huge steaks) and not skimpy. Too full to try dessert, but it was a nice list.
If there is free street parking, we didn’t see it. Paid street parking and a variety of paid garages walking distance.

author: Celeste Abbott
review_text:
★★★★★ 5 stars — Triple George’s is a downtown Vegas must!!!

We had dinner at a booth atTriple George’s on New Year’s Day and it was a ballet of hospitality… the kind of service that feels rare lately. They actually pick up the phone when you call! And from the host to the servers to the entire crew, everyone brought their best to the table warm, attentive, professional, and somehow still relaxed and human… even on New Year’s Day.

And the food? Perfection. Our steaks were cooked exactly right, beautifully paced, and genuinely delightful from start to finish. You can tell this place takes pride in doing it the right way… no gimmicks, just classic Vegas steakhouse excellence and a fun, professional team that makes you feel like family. Where is that these days?

Also: the staff had this bright sense of humor that only comes from teamwork and being appreciated. I truly hope leadership is as solid behind the scenes as what they deliver to the table.

If you’re downtown and want a meal that feels special (without the Strip chaos… which is the opposite of what happens downtown), go to Triple George’s. We left happy, impressed, and already talking about coming back… and we still have steak for days!

author: Charles Wonsey
review_text: Gave it a try with the $25 off from the hotel.  Would rather pay full price for decent food.  Lobster mac was basically undercooked pasta covered in bisque served lukewarm.  Maybe served hot the pasta would have been a bit better.  One scallop was slightly under and the other was rubbery.  Steak was cooked properly but doesn't have much flavor and the peppercorn sauce was abysmal and arrived with a film on top and tasted some kind of rancid.  Waiter encouraged a small Caesar salad, didn't expect $17 for a side salad when that's the same as my scallops or a side dish but the salad was the best tasting part of the meal.  Bill was $140 before the discount so not badly priced just poor quality. The food, including the salad, was quite slow coming out.

author: daniel garcia
review_text: The staff was perfect the food was perfect it was a perfect Birthday Dinner for my beautiful wife of 35 years thank you Triple George for the perfect Dinner and drinks. We had the dinner for 2 and added a Tail Ceasars Salad was excellent as well and the loaf of warm fresh baked bread was awesome we did not finish that whole porterhouse it was cooked to perfection, we left there completely satisfied. I never new this place was here will definitely go back next special occasion when we come back Downtown Vegas

author: Roland Stewart
review_text: I was in Vegas, and stayed at the Grand Downtown Las Vegas. I was hungry so I decided to venture across the street to Triple George Grill. I was greeted at the door by a slim gentleman wearing a blue shirt and wearing glasses. He had a pot belly and was holding his stomach as though he was sick. I asked him if he was OK, he never answered, so I said, for one pls. He responded rudely, "sit at the bar." Throughout my stay, I noticed he seemed very friendly and attentive to others sitting at the bar, but never once did he approach me and ask me how was my meal or how was everything? In fact, I noticed he asked others at the bar on several occasions, how their meal was? He wd look at me and keep going. Other than the seemingly rude host, the food was excellent and the service was great. Everyone else, the beautiful atmosphere and the food made up for the rude, unhappy host. He made me feel like I shoud have never come in there. I would not go back, or recommend to ppl I know to avoid this place. I did speak to a female manager behind the bar, who was very kind, and welcoming The male host in the blue shirt made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome.

author: Tony Solano
review_text:
I loved the service.
Sat at the bar and gentleman was pretty attentive and friendly.
The octopus was AMAZING.  The Steak even better. I was asked if I needed any condiment on the Steak. Just cook it with salt please.

author: Healys Internet Training
review_text: This is the best kept secret in Las Vegas. The food was amazing and the service went above and beyond. I was particularly impressed with Tanya the general manager who helped me get across the street because I am visually impaired. I come to Las Vegas monthly and will definitely make this my new go to spot.

author: Cori E.
review_text: We chose this location for my daughter's wedding celebration. Every single person we interacted with was wonderful from the phone calls to the service and the meals. Everyone raved about their food and fantastic cocktails. Such a wonderful evening of exemplary service and food. Thank you to all the staff for truly making it a magical night for all of us.

author: Stephanie Grant
review_text: The best food I’ve had in my ENTIRE life. My husband and I shared the steak dinner for two and it was perfect. Cooked to perfection. Flavored to perfection. I just cannot stress enough how delicious the food was. The atmosphere is so charming and romantic. Please visit this place!!!

author: Chad Hutchins
review_text:
Outstanding restaurant, and I can't believe this was our first visit.  They are doing everything right... food, service, and atmosphere!  Very friendly from the moment we stepped in.  The food was cooked to perfection and very tasty!  You don't hear many people talking about Triple George, but it's a hidden Gem.
Highly recommend and we'll be back for sure!

author: Angela Abney
review_text: This was an amazing place to eat. We came here for my fiancé birthday. We received a birthday card from the staff congratulating him. The tables were spacious and a beautiful ambiance. The meals were divine. We had steak, seafood pasta and prime rib. All the sides were ala carte. The waitstaff were very attentive. This is a must try outside of the strip

author: Onkar Bhamra
review_text:
Amazing restaurant with a New York style vibe! Ricardo, our server, is such a huge credit to the establishment and very patient with us whilst we were deciding on our dishes.

Popped in to celebrate mine and my wife's 20th wedding anniversary on the recommendation from someone who works at Mon Bel Ami Wedding Chapel (look out for the review for them 😘). We were not disappointed with the recommendation!

There is a bar you can sit at as well as tables and booths. We popped in on a Wednesday at lunch time and whilst it was not quiet, we managed to bag a booth to ourselves.

Food was amazing; I opted for the meatball starter whilst wifey decided to skip the starters and opt for just a main due to portion sizes. Wifey selected a turkey club sandwich with fries and I opted for a medium rare steak, which was cooked to perfection, along with truffle fries. The steak was so nice, even the fat was edible (it was very crunchy!) The sandwich was nice but as anticipated, too large for my wife to finish.

The restrooms, located on the other side of the bar from where we were sat were nice and clean, which is always good. Staff overall were friendly and polite and it's just a shame I am a visitor to Vegas and not a resident as I would frequent this establishment at least a couple of times a month (the Big Dogs Lager goes down VERY easy, even at $8!)

Thanks for a very memorable meal and top notch service, the food and service in this place are second to none!

author: Stephen Carvalho
review_text: We got there at Happy hour and got the Fremont salad and Steak and frites. The salad was one of the best I had. So refreshing and savory. The steak was cooked perfect. The bartender mixed up some great drinks. This was our first time here and it won't be our last!

author: Seal
review_text:
Good food good portions
Good atmosphere.
Gets packed so come early.

Besides the Tabasco sauce spilled half the bottle onto my plate bc it was missing the stopper. 2x within a week.
Everything else was good.
I especially loved the cute lattes ☕️

author: Carmen Toure
review_text: Good breakfast. The veggie skillet was great. I usually eat lots of ketchup but it tasted great without ketchup… the veggies were kinda sauter which gave good an elevated flavor. My partner has the French toast which was really good as well

author: Justin H
review_text: Loved this place. The wait was a bit long due to how busy it was (Saturday morning so im not too upset about it). We sat at the bar top which was cool cause we got to watch everyone buzzing around. They were well orchestrated, communicative and really pumping out the food and drinks. When it came to customer service, Antonio was really nice and friendly. The food was good as well! I got the breakfast sandwich and my wife got the spicy chicken sandwich. My sandwich was good, not great but I wasnt disappointed at all. Her sandwich was really good. The French Toast that I saw coming from the kitchen looked incredible. This will for sure be on the list to visit when we come back!

author: It's Nass Fitness
review_text:
The food was absolutely delicious, and Alfredo was an exceptional host. It’s now my top breakfast spot whenever I visit Las Vegas—the lively atmosphere, combined with Alfredo’s friendly and helpful nature, made for a fantastic experience. I highly recommend trying their legendary three-layer pancakes!

Parking is available on the street for a fee, and I suggest making a reservation in advance to avoid long lines.

author: Eklil Oriakhil
review_text:
We were visiting Las Vegas for vacation, and this restaurant was one of the highlights of our trip! Everything was absolutely perfect — the food, the atmosphere, and especially the service.

Our waiter, Rob, was incredible! He was so friendly, attentive, and really took great care of us from start to finish. You could tell he genuinely cared about making sure we had a great experience.

Everything was 10/10, and we left completely happy and satisfied. We’ll definitely be coming back next time we’re in Vegas — highly recommend!

author: Elaine Aviles
review_text: We had a fantastic experience here! We enjoyed a Philly cheesesteak with jalapeños on the side and fresh fruit, plus a delicious breakfast burrito loaded with chorizo, egg, bacon, and potatoes — served with their famous crispy potatoes. Everything was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The cappuccinos were amazing too! Alfredo, our server, was friendly and attentive, and Nick, the owner, made us feel genuinely welcome. Great food, great service, and great vibes — we’ll definitely be back!

author: Fay M
review_text: Nice brunch place downtown. I recommend getting on the wait-list through Yelp and then head over. There can be a wait. Large portions and lots to choose from. I got the veggie skillet. It was great and all fresh ingredients. There were 5 of us and everyone enjoyed their dishes. I would come again.

author: Sam Napolitano
review_text:
Ok, wow… what an amazing place. We stayed at “The D” on Freemont Street. Ameribrunch was a short 5 minute walk away. I saw previous reviews on Google Maps and thought we need to give this place a try… while we weren’t money winners in Vegas this time, we won the best picked breakfast place in town!

Every dish was meticulously prepared, hot, fast and fresh. The Americanos we had were smooth and tasty along with an amazing spicy Bloody Mary. The restaurant is super cute and very eclectic. It just had a happy vibe to it!

Topping off our experience was our waiter Alex. What an incredible guy and he really made our day. Not once, but twice. We had such a great experience with him that we brought more people from our party over the next morning. I hope the management sees this post and keeps him happy because he is a true asset to your organization! Thanks Alex!

Give Ameribrunch a shot! You owe your belly a happy experience and this is the place to make it happen!!!

author: Cayla Madaris
review_text: Pretty good experience! My eggs were perfectly soft scrambled. Potatoes were goooood. The chai latte was delicious. The biscuits were burned and tough, could only eat about half of it but they did take some off of the check. The waiter could have been more attentive but overall a pretty good visit!

author: Jessica Hensley
review_text: This place is unbelievable! The service was just the beginning of this fantastic experience. Alfredo was our server very friendly and cheerful. The food was off the charts. This is unassuming from the outside but don’t let that fool you. It’s a must try.

author: Jolina SM
review_text: I found this place just by searching brunch spots what caught my eye was it is family owned and operated. Also I wanted a place away from the strip. Boy it didn’t disappoint! The service the food was amazing the selection of savory foods and sweet was amazing. Rob was outstanding personality and hospitality!

author: Kathryn B
review_text: Do not visit Las Vegas and miss out on experiencing Ameribrunch Cafe! Even though we visited at a PEAK time we were brought to our table quickly yet not rushed once we were seated. Every interaction with staff was lovely. Our server, Jonathan, was charming, funny & knowledgeable.  The chorizo biscut is placed as one of my favorite brunch meals anywhere!!!! Chill music was at a level that allowed for conversation. Both the Bloody Mary and cappuccino were DELICIOUS. My only regret is that I couldn't finish everything because the portions are HUGE!!!! One of my favorite dining experiences in my 54 years of a travel filled life.

author: Evelyn Ladera
review_text:
We, the women, loved our lattes, toasts, and pancakes!!....However, the men weren't too happy w/ theirs. One asked for medium rare steak, but got medium well, and expected more steak than what he got. The other wanted medium well, but got medium. Steak is everything to these men, so I had to knock off a star for that.

Our server was welcoming, helpful, and attentive.

The environment is what was expected...hip, modern, yet homey, and moderately noisy....all indicative of a great place to eat! Space is limited however, so go early! Parking can also be a challenge if you go during the busy hours.

author: M P
review_text:
We came here our first day in Vegas, and bc of the service, the food and the total experience was awesome, we came back everyday for breakfast.
All the servers were awesome , but Rob was very memorable..he remembered us and always stopped by to chat even if he was not  our server.
Everyone who works here was so courteous and friendly,  the management team needs to appreciate the great staff they have here.

author: S T
review_text:
I recently visited a café that left me with mixed feelings, but overall, it was a pleasant experience worth sharing. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted warmly, which set a positive tone for our visit. After a brief wait, we were seated, though I did notice the floors could use a bit more attention; they were quite dirty. On the upside, the tables were relatively clean, and the polite demeanor of the waitstaff really stood out.

Now, let's talk about the food. I ordered an espresso, avocado toast with scrambled eggs, and a slice of French toast. The espresso was impressive, presenting a nice strong flavor that I really enjoyed. The scrambled eggs were decent, but nothing to rave about—I'd rate them a 3 out of 4. The standout for me were the French fries; they were exceptionally crunchy and flavorful, earning a solid 4 out of 4.

The avocado toast was the highlight of my meal. I rarely give top marks, but the flavor was absolutely amazing, and I’d rate it a solid 4 out of 5. The French toast was also quite good—fluffy and flavorful, deserving another 4 out of 5 rating.

While I typically reserve a 5 out of 5 rating for places that are flawless, this café gave off strong 5 out of 5 vibes despite my overall rating of 4 out of 5. I highly recommend it, as it has a charm that makes you want to return. I also appreciated that it seemed to be friendly towards 2A supporters, as I didn't see any signs against it. Additionally, they offer discounts for military personnel and veterans, which is a nice touch.

In my personal rating system, a score of 1 or 2 means I definitely wouldn’t return, while a 3 indicates a place I wouldn’t recommend but might revisit in a pinch. A 4 is a place I’d recommend without hesitation, and achieving a 5 requires perfection, which is tough to come by. Overall, this café is one I would happily recommend, especially for their avocado toast and friendly service.

author: Sandy Heidloff
review_text: Excellent breakfast spot just a short walk from Circa Resort. The staff were so inviting, felt like part of the extended family. Was the best breakfast we've had out in years. Highly recommend a visit you won't be disappointed.

author: Cyndi Scott
review_text:
If you’re looking for a top-tier brunch experience, AmeriBrunch Cafe is the spot — and be sure to ask for Big Rob! His service is unmatched — friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better.

We kicked things off with a Sunrise Mimosa — the perfect refreshing start. The food? Absolutely flawless. The Philly omelette was savory and loaded with flavor, and the smoked salmon toast was fresh and beautifully presented. We also shared the French toast with fruit, which was sweet and satisfying without being too heavy, and the breakfast potatoes were crispy and seasoned just right.

Everything from the drinks to the dishes to the hospitality was on point. We’ll definitely be back.

author: Michelle Walter
review_text: They accommodated our need for a larger table than we originally requested. I had the French toast which was great but too much for me to finish! Everyone else said they enjoyed their food. A short walk from Fremont street, much better prices than any casino restaurant!

author: Sacha Martinez
review_text:
Delicious and fresh food! Challenging that they only serve walk-in. We showed up just before 12P and were seated in 30 mins even though predicted wait time was 53-73 mins. I felt for people waiting with kids.
It was worth the wait! If you value fresh and wholesome food - you will not be disappointed here. I had the veggie scramble - it was great!

author: J Hill
review_text:
5/5 no question.

The moment you walk in, you can tell the staff works hard—just spending a minute in the lobby shows how much hustle goes into this place. I was greeted right away, and my food came out surprisingly fast.

The coffee selection was solid, the prices were fair, and the food looked just as good as it tasted. Overall, a great experience from start to finish and they even matched my partners sweater with the latte!

author: Ashley C
review_text:
Step back into the 1970s with this evil Knievel-themed pizza restaurant located right on Fremont Street that offers some no-frills New York style slices and a whole lot of evil iconography. You can even try your skills on the evil pinball machine while you wait for your pizza.

We started off with the cheese slice and evil ale for only eight bucks. The slices were large, hot, greasy, and everything you’d want in a New York style pizza. The aisle was really good, too, and the price can’t be beat.

We got a little adventurous with the sweet heat slice. I love the pepperoni and jalapeño, but the hot honey was a little much for me - still good though.

We finished with an order of the Led Zeppoli, and if you haven’t had these yet, you’re definitely missing out. They’re delicious!

This one is 4.5 out of five, and will definitely be back. On to the next!

author: Ethan Gaudioso Travels
review_text: I came here on a Saturday night, and the pizza was delicious! They had so many different choices to choose from. All of the pizzas weren’t too expensive and you can buy them by the slice. For a Saturday, we only waited five to ten minutes, and there was room to sit down and wait. I loved the vibes and atmosphere with all of the neon signs and pictures everywhere. I definitely will be coming back next time I am downtown!

author: Paul Duncan
review_text:
Amazing GF Deep Dish!
Using this app to locate a gluten free pizza option in Las Vegas was daunting with so many choices, however, due to the many positive reviews we decided to try Evel Pie.
The business was busy, a great sign of good food.  Ordering is done at the counter and if you are eating in, they give you a number for your table.
The gluten free is a little bit of a wait, but, 100% worth it.
I had the ‘Olivia Gluten Free John” with mushrooms, olives and pepperoni.  My wife had the same crust with the Maui Wowie version.  Be aware it is a little spicy, but great flavor.
After a 50 minute wait, we had our delicious dinner delivered to the table.
Great flavor from the pizza, and an amazing gluten free treat.  I have never had a deep-dish pizza in a gluten free version.
Ordering tip, grab a menu while you are waiting to be helped, then have your decision before to arrive at the cashier, and be prepared for taking some home as the deep dish is a lot of great food (that warms up very well).
Love it, would absolutely recommend.

author: B “BurrrBarrry” S
review_text:
Evel Pie didn’t live up to the hype for us. The place was extremely loud to the point where the staff could barely hear our order. Unfortunately, our pizza came out burnt and making it hard and unpleasant to eat.

Honestly, Pizza Rock down the street was ten times better. It’s a shame, especially after seeing so many great reviews, only to end up with a burnt, hard slice.

author: Susan Z
review_text:
Such a bad ass hole in the wall gem in the heart of Downtown Las Vegas -Adjacent to the arts district. Love the Evel Knievel theme throughout the dining area and the artsy feel inside with all the slap stickers flooding every wall and blank space.
They have a cool bar, small indoor dining area and a small outdoor patio area.
Great customer service and good drinks. But the food is what brings the entire experience together.  The wings are delicious, meaty, and done well. Love the garlic knots with marinara👌🏻 and the Caesar salad was good too.
I look forward to coming back and trying their pizza next 👍🏻

author: Terrence Reed
review_text: A very hectic, yet efficient experience. You walk in, get in line if it’s busy. You can order by the slice or order a whole pie. The restaurant itself, I hate to say, is disgusting. I don’t think 2 full time housekeepers could keep the place clean, sit to the sheer volume of people coming in and out. It was very packed at 8pm on a Monday night. The pizza was the best part of the experience. You get a wide variety of slices to choose from so that you can get a mix instead of committing to one whole pizza like a traditional restaurant. The pizza gets a 6/10 in my opinion. Many spirits to choose from top of course. Worth checking the box.

author: Ryan Schroeder
review_text: This place is definitely a vibe! The pizza was amazing for sure! My wife and I walked down from fremont street to get a pie before going back to hotel and we were not disappointed. So good and the slices were huge! Loved it!

author: Gloria Raymond
review_text: Can't speak for the other combinations but my Sweet Heat slice was soooooo good that I had to run it back before I left Vegas. Everyone in my party was happy with their pizza. Will def go back next time I'm in town. Creative pizza joint/bar with something for everyone.

author: Hannah Madaus
review_text: Solid 3 out of 5. Props to them for staying open late for all the drunk gamblers out there in Fremont, definitely saved us when we were hungry - however we waited in a very long line for alright tasting pizza that ended up being over 30$ for three slices including tax and tip.

author: Rick Cobb
review_text: Fun place, great service, but the food wasn’t great at all. The pizza was super salty. Then again we ordered one with several kinds of processed meats. The garlic knots were terrible though. They were hockey pucks with flavor added on the top. I hate to be so negative, but after reading other reviews I really expected better.

author: Natalie Amat
review_text: Had to show my brother my favorite pizza place in all of Las Vegas! It's evel kenevel themed. We have both worked in pizza places and this place is on point let me tell ya! Their slices are huge! Their toppings are delicious! The names of the pizzas are fun and silly! Absolutely adore this pizza place!

author: Rogue Sheepdog
review_text:
The reason for my two star rating is because I love their pizza.But all too often they burn the bottom black, and this last one I got was literally black.It was totally crunchy, not chewy with the crisp that we all love.  And I had to pay DoorDash to bring it to me. So that was like a $70 Pizza, not too happy.
Probably won't water again.Because this is the second time, and it's just to the impensive, to get a mediocre pizza That's burnt.

author: Lori Santiago
review_text:
I had the Extreme Pepperoni pizza...2 slices.  Thin, crispy crust, perfect amount of cheese and pepperonis (2 types with extra pepperoni).. Loved those big slices  where the cheese strings start when you bite and pull away.  Fresh herbs were there for sure.
Everyone got something different, and it all looked and sounded yummy 😋

author: Matt Bernson
review_text: A lil expensive but still accessible considering the area. Pizza was tasty. Beer was good. They had a deal for a cheese slice and the evel ale for $8 which is what I'd recommend.  Some seating but it gets packed easy so likely have to wait for a seat. Chill rockin decor. They call out your name for you to pick up your slice. Like a 2 minute walk to the fremont experience.  They have slices ready of each of their specialty flavors. T-Shirts for $35.

author: Chuck Roast
review_text: I have been here multiple times the pizza and the vibe is awesome! There is a nice outdoor seating in the back, as well as a few spots up front outside.

author: John Eckelbarger
review_text:
Evel Pie was the perfect spot for our wedding weekend kickoff dinner with both families.  We wanted cool + casual… and got it here! 🍕

We started with wings in 3 flavors — BBQ, buffalo, and lemon pepper — plus mozzarella sticks, then moved on to the Goblin Sausage and Barry White whole pies. 🐔

Everything was delicious and plenty to go around.  The atmosphere was lively and fun, which was exactly what we needed to kickoff the celebration 💒

Afterwards, we walked Fremont Street and soaked in all the energy of downtown Las Vegas.  It made for a very memorable night out bringing our families together over some pizza, wings, and beer 🍺

Highly recommend Evel Pie if you’re looking for great pizza, good vibes, and a quintessential Vegas experience. 🎲

Thanks for being a part of our wedding weekend! 💍

author: Jim Morris
review_text: Walked in with seven friends and had a great reception. Quick service premade pizzas are delicious and hot. You can custom order pizzas and they do take about 20 minutes to 40 minutes. Depends on how busy they are but it’s well worth it. The gluten-free option is absolutely amazing. One of my friends is gluten-free one of the best pizzas he’s ever eaten!  The traditional buffalo wings are non-breaded and great sauce. Step off the strip and have an affordable meal with all of the excellent service and awesome ambience!

author: Keith Lennop
review_text: Love everything about this place. The pizza isnt the best you have had but still good and the overall vibe of the place makes it a cool spot.

author: Aisha Pleasant
review_text:
If you’re in Las Vegas and craving an unforgettable slice of pizza, Evel Pie is a must-visit. This funky pizza joint/bar has a super chill vibe, great music, and a cool, down-to-earth staff that makes the whole experience feel laid-back and fun.

I ordered a slice of the chicken and ranch pizza and another one (wish I could remember what it was—probably too busy enjoying it!), and let me tell you, these slices are HUGE. Like, one slice could easily take up a whole small pizza box. At about $6.25 a slice, you’re definitely getting your money’s worth—and then some.

The pizza itself? Insanely delicious. Crispy on the edges, cheesy in the middle, and full of bold, creative flavors. Honestly, it might just be the best slice I’ve had in a very long time—hands down better than any slice I’ve had before.

They call your name over the microphone when your order’s ready, which just adds to the fun and casual vibe. Whether you’re just grabbing a quick bite or hanging out for a drink, Evel Pie delivers on taste, size, and good energy. Highly recommend! Don’t forget this place is on Fremont Street as well.

author: Tabatha Loihle
review_text: Great pizza! I’m very picky when it comes to pizza just because I personally prefer homemade, but sometimes you just need a good fold on pie, that heals everything!

author: Antonio T
review_text:
Why, why, WHY did I wait so long to come back to Carson Kitchen?

This place has officially become one of my absolute favorite restaurants in Las Vegas — downtown or Strip. I first discovered it years ago during a New Year’s trip with visiting friends from Boston, and I still remember being blown away. After taking a year-long break from downtown Vegas, I recently returned… and instantly regretted staying away for so long.

Carson Kitchen is tucked away behind one of the most nondescript entrances in downtown Las Vegas. My limo drove past twice before I realized the place was right in front of me. Hidden in plain sight — and I love that about it. Inside, the vibe is warm, friendly, and genuinely welcoming. Downtown staff always feel more grounded than the Strip, but Carson Kitchen takes it to another level. It almost feels small-town — think Biddeford, Maine or Snyder, Texas — smack in the middle of Vegas.

Over the years I’ve come with everything from parties of nine (five kids and teens — the pickiest eaters on earth) to smaller family outings. Every time, the food hits. Here are the essentials:

⭐ Must-Order Dishes

• Bacon Jam
This is next-level. Served sizzling with a strip of baked brie running through the middle. I’ve had bacon jams all over the country — this one is truly artisanal. An automatic order every time.

• Fried Chicken Skins
My whole family demands two orders right away. I grew up partly in Indonesia where this is normal fare, and Carson Kitchen nails it. Crunchy, savory comfort food with smoked honey dipping sauce. If you’re a chicken-skin person, this is heaven.

• Pork Belly
My wife’s forever favorite — perfectly rich and flavorful.

• Deviled Eggs
My oldest son insists on these every visit.

• Chicken Thighs
A recent new favorite. The charred chicken pairs with an Alabama-style mustard BBQ sauce that brings way more depth and complexity than expected. This is joining the permanent rotation.

The Finale: Glazed Donut Bread Pudding

The absolute showstopper. If dessert could be described as soft, bouncy, moist, warm, creamy perfection — this is it. I’ve said it before: we could’ve ordered nothing but nine of these and everyone would’ve been thrilled. Still my top dessert in all of Las Vegas.

Final Verdict

Carson Kitchen delivers consistently fantastic food, warm hospitality, and a downtown vibe that’s casual, elevated, and refreshingly genuine. After coming back recently with my family, I’m kicking myself for staying away for a year.

Highly recommend — and I’ll be returning regularly.

author: Ajay
review_text:
Waitress was very helpful and attentive. I forget her name but she's blonde and I remember her saying she's from an island. All the food we had was really good, I just wish they served the oysters in half dozen or a dozen instead of only 3. The outside looks a little suspect but once you're inside its worth it.
This is a little hidden gem.
Prices are not too expensive "but", certain dishes are a little over priced seeing that the portions are small.
The question you all want to know...Will I come back?...The answer is yes! Not only will I come back, I will bring my friends and family here when they come visit.
Right off Fremont street so once you eat add drink,you can go on a nice walk and get some good pics.

author: Dennis S
review_text: An amazing find! We dined on the patio in very relaxed and casual atmosphere. The patio is large an even has an upstairs area. Plenty of tables that seat 4 or pull up a chair to the large fire pit and relax with a drink from the bar. We had the short rib steak which paired well with the creamy mac and cheese. The steak is small but oh so juicy and tender. The mac & cheese was creamy and did not have an overwhelming cheese flavor. Just perfect! We finished off with the bourbon fudge brownie.

author: Jill
review_text: This was my favorite visit of our whole vacation!!! The atmosphere was nothing but perfect. The service was so friendly and welcoming. Now about the food! We ordered like half of the menu and not one dish disappointed. Everything was 5 star 🌟 Amazing drink selections to accompany the menu. Thank you for such an incredible dining experience 💖

author: Aden Teklu
review_text:
Got the chance to try a variety of things here and we were really pleased. The STAR OF THE SHOW is their baked mac and cheese. That was the dish that our group collectively kept saying they wanted more of. The bacon burger and spicy notes were so great, and the tots definitely were delicious. Grape and burrito was super refreshing next to all of the hot meals, and the black rice and oxtail risotto was perfection.

For dessert we tried the glazed donut bread pudding, and while yummy it was a bit underwhelming. Should’ve added their bacon ice cream on top, would’ve added a great flavor to it.

Staff was really friendly and accommodating. Also, they gave a rooftop but you need to make a reservation

author: Willy Illas
review_text: Went here with friends for my 50th. birthday. Food was pretty good and with a service to match. Atmosphere wasn't bad but not great. Kinfa family oriented I guess? But again, great to just go there to eat in supposed.

author: Peter & Rachel Badgett Real Estate Agents
review_text: Tempura green beans were the bomb and the desserts. Fruitcake buckle sounds like a terrible idea, but was our group's winner! Shortrib steak was terribly fatty - couldn't fully chew any one piece! Pork chop overcooked but still very flavorful. Burgers were great.

author: Lena Kim
review_text: Even though I had a reservation, I still had to wait about 10 minutes after arriving. Among the dishes I ordered, the bacon burger was pretty good, but there were no vegetables in it — no lettuce, pickles, or onions, just the beef patty, cheese, and bacon. The staff were friendly though.

author: Donnie Biederman
review_text:
Our group did the Lip Smacking Foodie tour. This was one of our stops.
They have a great selection of beer and mixed drinks. My favorite was the deviled eggs. Awesome atmosphere here. I plan on returning.

author: Rodney Yoswig
review_text: The only negative I have is they sat us at the bar saying it was the only thing available even though the whole time we we there they had empty tables. Food was good, my choice of wild mushroom flatbread didn't impress me. Wouldn't orde ot again, however plenty of others options to try.

author: Rachel Kissinger
review_text: WHOAH.  This place is a 5min walk from Freemont Street and absolutely amazing.  Even with the paving work outside, which added to the low-key vibe, we looooooooved this place.  We had Devil's Eggs, Beet salad and each had a smashburger.  Everything was delicious.  Great staff, great food and great ambience.  Do it - you won't regret it.

author: Will See
review_text:
On a lively Sunday evening, my friends and I, a group of six, visited Carson Kitchen in historic Downtown Las Vegas, a vibrant spot known for its creative American comfort food. Arriving without a reservation, we were fortunate to snag seats early, as the restaurant was packed and buzzing with energy. Reservations are highly recommended, as the intimate space fills up quickly.

The menu, though concise, offered plenty of tempting small plates perfect for sharing. We ordered several dishes, with the cocoa espresso New York strip, tempura green beans with pepper jelly cream cheese, and spicy killer shrimp stealing the show—each bursting with bold, well-executed flavors. Other dishes were tasty but leaned slightly too salty for our liking. The drink menu was similarly compact but thoughtfully curated, ensuring we found satisfying cocktails to complement the meal. The portions were generous for the price, offering solid value for an off-Strip gem.

Service was friendly and attentive despite the bustling crowd, though it felt a touch stretched at times, earning a 3.5-star rating. Carson Kitchen’s modern, urban vibe and inventive dishes made for a memorable night, and we’d return if back in the Downtown area.

Deliciousness Rating: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5)
Service Attitude: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5)
Value for Money: ★★★★☆ (4/5)
Likelihood of Returning: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5)

author: Lori Batronis
review_text: One of the best places I have ever eaten in Vegas!! We had the Pork Belly, Chicken Skins, Deviled Eggs, and Oysters. Also enjoyed the Tequila flight and bourbon flight. EVERYTHING was wonderful. Staff was very personable and helpful. We will be going back each time we are staying on Fremont street.

author: Jakob
review_text:
Attended dinner after making a same day reservation. Food choices are plentiful and are complementary to all palates. These are more of shared portion types of servings. Order a bunch and share amongst your party.
The Mac and Cheese is unmatched. The best I’ve had in quite some time. The only dish we tried that I didn’t have a second portion of was the shrimp scampi. Just didn’t hit hard for me. Everything else was fantastic.
Service was friendly and prompt. I really enjoyed the ambiance, though near the end of our visit it did get quite crowded and loud. Still, this is nothing that would prevent me from returning. If you’re in the area and looking for high quality food and service, all at a fair price, look no further.

author: Blane Hartleb
review_text: One of our must go to places every time we come to Vegas.  Chicken skins with honey dipping sauce.  The chicken thighs in a white sauce and the bread with bacon jam....omg.  words can't describe these dishes.  Then we finish with the bread pudding.  I ask for extra glaze.  Wow.

author: David Orridge
review_text: Great food, awesome cocktails, really enjoyed the steak, potatoes bravas and old fashion cocktails. Waiter took really good care of us.

author: David Ganzel
review_text: What an excellent find off Fremont! The food was well designed and extremely flavorful. I loved the drink selection and was tempted to double back to the bourbon headliner - Just the Tip. We sat at the bar, which I feel like gives the best restaurant experience. Adam entertained with great conversation and top recommendations. The vibe was intentional, as all staff were wearing grunge band tees, with an eclectic music selection and low key ambiance. If I was local, I would be a regular. DO NOT miss out on the dessert, Glazed Donut Bread Pudding. It’s worth every single calorie.

author: Matt Culbertson
review_text:
Meh. I tend to love new flavors and items but this was a miss. The chicken skins were weird. The bacon jam was blah. The deviled eggs were good but 16 bucks for 4 is crazy, especially when they aren't the best I've had. It was ok though so 3 stars.

Updated to one star seeing they charge credit card surcharge.

author: Yvonne
review_text: Had a great cocktail at the bar. We were seated and had another great cocktail. Service was friendly and they delivered great food! The shrimp, the devil's eggs!! The beat salad was also tasty.

author: Adam Shivers
review_text:
We were in Downtown Las Vegas for vacation recently and we always heard amazing things about Carson Kitchen and we decided to stop in for dinner during our recent trip.

We made a reservation in advance- the restaurant is pretty small, so definitely try to make a reservation if you can. We arrived a few minutes before our reservation and were seated promptly at a table near the front.

Our server came by a few minutes later and offered to answer any questions we had on the menu. We ordered a bottle of wine to start, all at reasonable prices, they had a few options to pick from.

We ordered the Pepp on Pepp flatbread to start ($18), and the Brussell Sprout Caesar Salad ($13) and two of the Pot Roast Dips ($19). All of the food was truly amazing and all very fresh and tasty! The service was also really good throughout the meal and efficient. We look forward to returning and highly recommend trying Carson Kitchen if you're in the Downtown Las Vegas area!

author: Karoadtrips
review_text:
The entrance was not the easiest to find, but we managed to locate it.

A spotless restaurant with extremely friendly staff.

The menu has something for everyone, but the prices felt a bit high. The food was fresh, though, so it was worth it. I had chicken and waffles Benedict. Those weren't the best chicken and waffles I've had, but they'll do. Also love the big chunks of fresh fruit as a side. My Bloody Mary was also delicious. Although I requested not to be spicy, it still made my mouth tingle, but not to the point of being too spicy. So that one is forgiven. Every person working that day kept checking on me, to the point it became a bit annoying, honestly.

However, when we asked for the check, we were offered the payment machine to be brought to our table. And the waitress already decided we were going to tip 25%... Although we could still change that before actually paying, the move didn't feel right, and it automatically makes me want to tip less.

Worth it? If you like over-friendly service that expects big tips and fresh food, go for it. I don't think I'll be visiting again.

author: BREW
review_text:
What an awesome place! It is a chain but this was our first visit. Well worth the trip! Great food and service! Emily, Kenna and the team are attentive and fun. We had a great experience all around. We will absolutely visit again.
Walking distance from every hotel on Fremont street.

author: END ADVENTURES
review_text:
We were recommended by our Air BnB host.   And they were right in the mark.  The menu is large, has so much available, something for everyone!

We started with a Bellini and a mimosas flight.   Amber was attentive and friendly.

The food was great, especially the sour dough toast.

Clean, airy, music playing.    Definitely recommend.

Erin
EnD Adventures

author: Devan “D Leg” Legington
review_text:
Broken Yolk Cafe was amazing from start to finish. My waitress D’Essence was fantastic. She was friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. I even requested a special order that wasn’t on the menu, and she made it happen without hesitation.

The food was on point. The chicken was amazing, the eggs were fluffy, and my special cinnamon roll waffle was absolutely delicious. Everything came out hot and exactly how I wanted it.

Great service, great food, and an overall excellent experience. I’ll definitely be back.

author: Liz S
review_text: No my first time in Vegas, but my first time at Broken Yolk and it did not disappoint! The food, the drinks, the service 10/10! My husband order the sopes, my son order the Diablo omelet and I ordered the ranchero skillet. We shared lemon custard pancakes and frozen drink flight. We were stuffed and there was food left over! Nice portions, good flavors and overall amazing service. Totally recommend!

author: Becky
review_text:
From loud Freemont Street to Broken Yolk Cafe. It was a nice change of scenery. Let's jump right into this review.

I'm not from Las Vegas so I have no logistical advice on how to get to the cafe or parking recommendations. But, it's worth you finding out or Google mapping yourself there. We visited on Saturday around noon. It was a 20 minute wait for a booth.

What did we have -
Mom Omelet -
Spinach, mushroom, onion, red and green bell pepper. Topped with avocado, salsa fresca, and sour cream - (530 cal) - vegetarian -$17.95 -10/10

Californian Omelet -Bacon, homefries, American cheese. Topped with avocado and sour cream - (1050 cal) - $17.95 -10/10

** Omelets are served with a side and toast. **

Food arrived quickly within 15 minutes.

The inside of the cafe is asethically pleasing  - bright colors, tables, booths, and bar seating available - indoor and outdoor. The menu had options/variety.

Our server was friendly and personable. All the employees we encountered were friendly and welcoming. Great customer service overall. When I'm back in Las Vegas I'll definitely be dropping in for brunch.

author: Bebe William
review_text:
This place is amazing. I love food. The portions are pretty big. They definitely give you your money's worth. Our server Noah was great. He was patient, attentive, and helpful.
I gave 4 stars ⭐ because the hostess said we'd receive a text when they had a table available. We never received any contact nor did they call our name for a table. I went into the restaurant and she said she'd called us already. Which was false. I told her we had been sitting in the waiting area the entire time.

author: Jeremy Guzman
review_text: We decided to try this place for breakfast since we were in the area running errands. The food was very good. And despite it being very busy at the time we went, since we sat at the bar the service was really good. The prices where about the same to other common breakfast places. Even though ever since the pandemic breakfast can be around the same price as dinner these days. But that doesn't mean the food wasn't good. I had the Santa Fe skillet made with chorizo... As pictured. My wife had the classic eggs over easy.. Made very well. And yes I will be back and I do recommend. 👍😃

author: Hans Griese
review_text:
Really great breakfast spot, easy to get to. Staff (Noah and Derrick) were awesome, really attentive. Vibes were cool but chill, nice easy start to a morning. Food was very tasty. I had:
Chicken & Waffles Benedict: 8/10. Was really just chicken and waffles, but it was very tasty. Add syrup!
Golden State Benedict: 10/10. delicious, hollandaise was well made, good balance of elements.
Biscuit and Gravy (side): 7/10. Solid, nothing special. Presentation was meh, but I did like being able to add butter under the gravy.
Bloody Mary Flight: 6/10. Solid options. Gin was meh, adding tobasco helped. Tequila was better, but wanted more spice. The two vodkas were both solid, but nothing crazy. The salt rim was really good lol.

author: Amanda Hoffman
review_text: Mike the manager went above and beyond to come to our table offering to fill our personal water bottles so we stay safe and having a great time during the day after we leave the restaurant. The food was delicious and hearty and our server D was very attentive and sweet! Will come back!

author: Roger Hamilton
review_text:
This was our first visit, and we loved it. There is no free parking, but that is expected in downtown Las Vegas. There is a public parking lot attached to the building that is very convenient.
The restaurant is modern and clean with floor to ceiling windows open to the street, and there is outdoor seating on a patio alongside the sidewalk.
The staff was polite and friendly, while also being efficient and unobtrusive. Our food arrived within 10-15 minutes of us placing the order, which was pretty good since the place was at about 70% capacity.  Once the food arrived, we couldn't wait to dig in because it looked delicious! We weren't disappointed with the flavors of the food either; it was excellent.
In conclusion,  I  definitely recommend The Broken Yolk Cafe if you want some good food near The Freemont Street Experience without the big crowds.

author: Andrea Hernandez
review_text: Best place for breakfast. Our waitress was very attentive. A nice vibe here. The smoked salmon with avocado and capers was delicious. Mom's omelet was very good too. We enjoyed the champagne flight and tropical flights.

author: Maria Bashko
review_text: Great customer service! Cute decor and a large menu. I appreciate the vegan options. I had the Spicy Vegan bowl which filled me up for a long convention day. Highly recommend :)

author: Cynthia Kenina
review_text: It was our first time in Las Vegas and I am goodie and love sharing experience on my social media and this is how I found this place. We visited one near fremon street and wow menu was just amazing so much to choose from. I had bloody Marie at 8am don’t judge me I was on holiday. I had an omelette and my fiancé had something else, soon as we stepped in service was 10/10 nice new clean and most importantly so so delicious. I would defiantly fine broken yolk in different areas and visit again

author: namredwop
review_text: Very impressed, here on vacation and stopped in. Very nice breakfast place. Great atmosphere.  Very fresh ingredients.  Had the salmon bene came with fresh till on top.

author: Danica Bahadur
review_text: Great breakfast spot! Drink option was insane in the best way. We had the mimosa flight. Service was excellent. Manager was also great in that he checked on all the guest to make sure their food and service was great. I can definitely recommend this location as I know there are a few.

author: Bryson Ritz
review_text: Such a great experience!  The Tiki Toast was a must get.  Dee was a great server.  Mike the General Manager came by and filled up our water bottles for us.  Will definitely come back both for the great food but also the great service!

author: Tammy Pavelich
review_text:
Food was great! Chicken n biscuits and a skillet, both were terrific and filling. Drinks were good, being Canadian, I find it somewhat difficult to find a good Ceasar in the U.S, mine was perfect!
General manager was chatting with all the tables, giving a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. They helped with some tourist attractions and recommendations and made a wonderful start to our day!

author: Raymond Bowman
review_text:
Such a great experience! Will likely eat here everyday while in Vegas. The food was delicious and our server, D' Essence was very helpful and overall just so pleasant. This place is definitely newer and you can tell that all the staff clearly cares about everyones experience. You can not beat the pricing!!!

Must try.

author: Leala Benally
review_text: The best was TASTY! And the Bloody Marry was cute and fun. Unfortunately our server was not the best. We had only seen our server twice during our time there and had to ask another server for the bill, etc. I recommend coming here if you have time to kill and don’t mind waiting because the food was awesome.

author: Priscilla Hernandez
review_text: The food here is amazing!!! I had the short rib fried rice and yellow chicken curry! Both spice level 3 which was perfect! Although the food is awesome what makes this place stand out to me is the service! My waitress was so attentive and all the employees were so friendly. The host Luis was amazing definitely set the tone for the evening. Nothing worse then when you get a rude host to ruin the evening. Definitely recommend.

author: Tony Skeans
review_text:
Just one block off Fremont Street, Lay Thai proves that escaping the chaos pays off. The second you walk in, you realize this isn’t another overpriced Vegas eatery—it’s an oasis of flavor and value. The wok sear on the garlic fried rice is, GAWD, the best I’ve ever had—smoky, buttery, perfect texture, and just enough spice to keep you hooked. I ordered mine at a level three, which turned out to be the sweet spot for both me and my wife. You could go hotter, sure, but three gives you that balance of burn and flavor that makes Thai food sing.

The crab rangoon? Adorable little handmade bundles of creamy perfection. The spring rolls? Crisp, light, and clean on the palate. And let’s talk about that bartending staff—easily some of the best I’ve ever encountered in Vegas: fast, personable, and genuinely proud of their craft.

In a city that’s forgotten what a fair price and great food look like together, Lay Thai nails both. If you’re tired of inflated menus and tourist traps, step a block away—you’ll find flavor, service, and sanity right here.

author: Cole
review_text:
Manny was absolutely amazing, best bartender I’ve had in a LONG time. Le Thai is easily the best restaurant I’ve had in Vegas, especially when factoring in quality, quantity, and price! The happy hour is great and the waterfall beef is insanely delicious. Also tried the beef short rib which was insane. I would recommend this place 1000 times.

It was so good, we went back a second time. Got the yellow curry with short rib and it was fantastic as well. Definitely recommend!

author: Akhila Illa
review_text:
We had to wait for 40 minutes to get our table.
We tried 3 color curry, garlic fried rice and the mango sticky rice. None of them were good. There was no flavor at all.

Mango sticky rice was the worst. I never imagined mango sticky rice can ever be bad, but it was a disaster here.

Service is very slow, prolly because the restaurant is very busy.

Overall, a let down :(

author: JM
review_text:
BEST MEAL I HAD DURING A WEEK IN VEGAS!

We were able to snag a seat at the bar around 7PM. We ordered drinks and the crispy spring rolls, which were AMAZING! I had the short rib fried rice and my husband had the green curry with pork.

Everything was amazing. If I come back to Las Vegas, I will have to visit Le Thai again!

author: Cerah Venturo
review_text:
Le Thai is seriously one of the best spots to eat in downtown fremont street. The green curry was incredibly flavorful, the oxtail meatball noodle soup was rich and comforting, and the Thai iced coffee was strong, sweet, and absolutely delicious. Every dish tasted fresh and well-balanced.

The atmosphere is super cute with plants, warm lighting, and creative décor, and the service was friendly and fast. Brayan was a great server ! Overall, just a great vibe and amazing food.

author: Rafael Alvarez
review_text:
I had a great meal and experience at Le Thai. This place gets busy but is worth the wait. I was seated immediately since I was just a party of one and went to the bar. Shout out to Gwen and Destiny for the great service.

For my meal I ordered the cheese Rangoons and the 3 Color Curry. I wish I had more pictures to share of the meal but I got too eager and started digging into the curry before thinking to snap a picture.

The Rangoons were delicious, crispy and filled to the brim with cream cheese. I definitely recommend for crab Rangoon lovers. As for the 3 color curry, it was exactly what I needed on a chilly evening. The curry was amazing with the right amount of spice.

author: Jinxiang Shi
review_text: A restaurant in Las Vegas with a lot of flavor. I've been to Thailand and the food here is very authentic, so the fact that so many people have given it good reviews is well deserved encouragement! I will definitely come back next time I'm in Las Vegas!

author: Rafael Souchet
review_text: Amazing experience. Manny was our waiter. He was incredible. Short rib fried rice, chicken fried rice, and waterfall beef all incredible. Best food we’ve had in vegas. Must go especially if you go to Fremont st.

author: Shelby Rice
review_text:
My favorite place we ate in Las Vegas. Our waitress was so friendly and seemed passionate about the food and history of the place. I got the Pad Thai which was good, but I sampled the Pad Si Eew and it was on another level. Savory, a hint of sweetness. Would recommend that.
They were out of the Mango Sticky rice which ended up being a pleasant surprise. The Ube Creme Brulee was SO DELICIOUS. The crisp, burnt sugar coating covered the whole dish. The ube custard below was thick and a perfect consistency.
Highly recommend this restaurant.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text:
Le Thai Delivers Big Flavors!
Le Thai on Fremont Street in downtown Las Vegas completely blew us away! From start to finish, it was a truly five-star dining experience.
We kicked things off with the spring rolls and chicken satay, and both were absolute perfection. The spring rolls were fresh, crisp, and bursting with flavor, while the chicken satay was incredibly tender with a rich, delicious peanut sauce that we couldn't get enough of.
But the real showstopper was the beef short rib with fried rice. Seriously, if you go to Le Thai, you must order this dish. The short rib was fall-off-the-bone tender and incredibly flavorful, and it paired perfectly with the savory fried rice. Every bite was a delight.
Beyond the amazing food, the atmosphere was fantastic and the service was top-notch. Le Thai is now firmly on our must-visit list whenever we're in Las Vegas. You won't be disappointed!

author: Sandra Cash
review_text: This was my first time here. I will definitely be back! We had the waterfall beef, pork belly, the wings and the short rib beef fried rice with an egg on top. Also had the mango margarita. Food was delicious. This was more than enough for 3 people to share with leftovers.

author: Hagz
review_text: One of the best Thai restaurant in Vegas it's a must every time I visit. The staff was pleasant and extremely attentive. The remodel has changed this from a hole in the wall to a stylish spot for lunch and dinner. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu it's all amazing and the heat scale is very reasonable. Worth a trip to Fremont Street! 100% recommend!

author: Summer Smith
review_text: Visited this place by chance years ago and fell in love with the waterfall sauce. I have frequented over the years when traveling.  Stopped in for a light meal before a music festival. Enjoyed the Larb chicken salad, mango margaritas, and always mango sticky rice.  I have over the years decreased my heat level from 4 to 2.  However i still find 2 on the Thai scale fairly spicy yet enjoyable. I sat at the bar and was surprised by the delightful bartender. He was knowledgeable, efficient, and attentive, Jose if I remember correctly. Regardless he was great!  Food and drink were delicious and I took the dessert to eat in my room later, excellent option for no microwave.

author: Leslie Jones
review_text: From the time, I walked to the front patio with the hostess greeting me and my cousin, to the bar staff and servers everyone here are pleasant and welcoming. Then the food just amazing, I had the Cream Cheese Rangoons when I said cooked to perfection 😊 The owner mother did her big one with that amazing treat, my taste buds were pleased 😋 Wait one more thing, I had the Garlic Fried Rice with Chicken and a fried egg on top,no spicy because I can’t 😫but you can choose your level of heat 🌶️  My taste buds are so pleased, I had to stop eating because I was full for one and I wanted to write this review while still here

author: Amber Burns
review_text: Small hometown feel!  Great atmosphere.   Service is hopping and ready at your beck & call.  Food came fast. Plum sauce and spring rolls were to perfection.  Steak salad was excellent.   Glad we found a local healthy place to eat!

author: Reno
review_text: We went there for dinner and the food and service were great. The food was so good that we decided to return for lunch the next day. However, two female staff members working at that time were very rude and ignored us when we asked for a table, so we decided not to have lunch that day. Overall, the food was excellent, but the poor service at lunch time was disappointing.

author: Xavier M
review_text:
I tried the short rib fried rice, with a 3/5 spice level ((3 is definitely hot enough to feel it)) and it was excellent. You’re able to add an egg but I chose not too.

Went in on a Monday and got seated without a wait but there’s usually a long line on busy nights, expect to wait 50-90 minutes on weekends. They also have an outdoor window for to-go orders.

Bar has a nice selection of wines and local brews on tap, some imported beers and spirits as well. Pedro and Destiny were rocking the bar when I visited.

Expect to pay downtown prices, but the portions are pretty large, definitely able to split an entree with 2-3 people.

author: GH W
review_text: I am not sure why this place has such a high rating. I have eaten hundreds of papaya salads in Europe, the US and in Thailand, where I spend 1-2 months every year and this was not a good papaya salad. It looked pretty authentic, but the taste was just not very sophisticated / refined. The Pad Thai was also on the lower scale in terms of taste. Further, the location is very busy and service rather slow. Nevertheless my waitress was pretty friendly at the end and asked me how everything was. Would not return here.

author: Mihir Kulkarni
review_text: Excellent lunch special. Really solid panang curry and Manny’s service was awesome.  Thai iced tea was a bit watered down but still great. $17.34 after tip for my meal makes this a great value.

author: Suuraj
review_text:
An excellent spot for authentic Thai food with one of the best ambiances in Las Vegas. The walls are beautifully painted with scenes that truly resemble Thailand, and popular English songs playing in the background add to the vibrant atmosphere. The restaurant was almost fully packed when we arrived, which speaks volumes about its popularity.

The location on Fremont Street makes it even more special. Beng, our server, warmly welcomed us and provided outstanding hospitality; from taking our order to serving the food. She thoughtfully asked about allergies and spice preferences, which we really appreciated.

We ordered the Red Curry with Tofu (similar to Panang curry), and it was one of the most flavorful and delicious curries I’ve ever had. The Veggie Pad Thai was equally impressive—perfectly balanced with a tangy taste, and the noodles had a unique dark brown, glass-like appearance. The Thai Iced Tea was absolutely amazing and a must-try.

There are plenty of vegetarian options available; just ask the server for recommendations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic Thai cuisine with great food, service, and ambiance.

author: Pitchaya Chanthawong
review_text:
We came here 2nd time already this year as we live in England. I am Thai and my husband is English. We love Thai food so much as I cook every day at home. This restaurant is very good and all the food is so delicious and authentic. We love Ribeye waterfall ( Nam tok ) so much and all the other dishes are amazing too.

P’ Kay assisted us with the order and even offered me to change a bowl of rice if it’s not hot anymore. He is very friendly with us.

The food portions are big and we allowed to take some back to the hotel as I can’t finish all the dishes I ordered.

Thanks so much for making me feel like home. We will definitely be back again soon ❤️

author: Londa Rozier-Taylor
review_text:
A Whole Vibe on Fremont! Last night’s experience was everything! The dynamic duo on service absolutely nailed it — friendly, attentive, and full of great energy from the first “hello” to the final “baai-baai.” Customer service is everything to me, and they went above and beyond!

The all-day happy hour is unbeatable — from the crispy calamari to the juicy pork belly, tasty spring rolls, and that papaya salad with a spicy punch that took me straight to Thailand. Every bite was perfection.

The ambiance sealed the deal — tuk tuks, wall art of Bangkok, and a lively atmosphere that made us forget we were still on Fremont. I live over 30 minutes away, but this is officially my new spot.

Thank you for one of the best nights out I’ve had in a long while — can’t wait to come back!

author: Nat Han
review_text: The man who took our order and served us our food could take some course in mannerism. He was rude. Didn't welcome or even greet us upon entering. This was our second choice because the other Thai Restaurant that we wanted to try had a line out the door. So we came here. The food was mediocre and way over priced. The portion was not worth the price but had the employee pretend to be friendly then I would have been fine with it. We thanked him multiple times but he didnt care to respond. This place should learn better customer service. No wonder this place was empty.

author: Life Of A Nomad
review_text:
Authentic flavors and colorful presentation!
Bangkok Street Thai Street Kitchen brings true Thai street vibes to Las Vegas. The papaya salad was super fresh, crunchy, and bursting with lime and chili just the right kick! The chicken satay was tender and grilled perfectly, served with creamy peanut sauce and sticky rice on the side. Everything came out beautifully plated, full of color and flavor.

The place has that cozy local feel with great service and a chill atmosphere. Perfect for anyone who loves real Thai food. Highly recommend if you want a little Bangkok experience right here in Vegas!

author: Zhip Phow
review_text: You must have the Salmon Carpaccio and the Larb Chicken, $10 each! This wonderful place has $5 Drafts! Modern, Clean, Inviting, and Service IS Tops! The servers that made my day, Bird and Top, great Bros. A Draft one Must try is Cali Squeeze, sweet, and flavorful. Dont Pass By ... Stop In

author: Joe Murphy
review_text: I took my Father to the Freemont Street Experience tonight for his birthday and after enjoying the scenery and street concerts Vegas has to offer, we stumbled into Bangkok Street Thai Restaurant. The staff was great and the food was amazing. My Father and I had the Drunken Noodles. It was absolutely delicious. You gotta check this place out and Bird thank you for the great service.

author: Apple Galaxy
review_text: We went to Chinatown and ate at Bangkok street food. There was a lady who serenaded everybody while they were eating. I ordered the orange chicken and my wife had the garlic chicken. I highly recommend going there! The food was everything I thought it would be!

author: Caylin Lancione
review_text: Amazing spot. Top and all the crew are wonderful people and great at what they do. So delicious, great drink options and specials. Sake bombs too! I had the Tokyo Tea and Drunken Noodle with beef. Superb 🔥

author: Laura Amador
review_text: Richard was awesome. It was my first time in and he answered all of my questions. It helped me make a fantastic choice. I had the steak with Thai fried rice  I take a picture of my food, but I already devoured it  I also had a lychee martini which was really good

author: guy nolan
review_text:
Kay and Richard were great !
I popped in mid afternoon for a few drinks and a light snack and I wasn't disappointed.
Is refreshing change from the craziness of the main part of Fremont street further up the road. I highly recommend this place.

author: jan Kennedy
review_text: Absolutely love this place! Had the best drunken noodles with shrimp that I have ever eaten!! Richard and Banks are the real thing. Richard came over and introduced himself to us!

author: Jimmy Si
review_text:
Decent place. They tell you to order at the front if you're ready, but they also take your order at your table. The waiter was very nice and attentive. It was nice they they offered hot water long with regular water. I ordered the khao soi with the large chicken. My family ordered the green curry and pad Thai. I also ordered the papaya salad.

The papaya salad was very refreshing and good and had that nice tangy flavor. The khao soi had a good broth and the noodles were very good and the chicken was very tender and huge. The green curry with chicken was decent. The pad Thai was ok. This place is also a bar/cocktail place and it has a decent selection to choose from. I had the pfriem Japanese lager that was very smooth.

The place is very much like a late night bar eats which gives it a cool vibe.

author: Jaxson Alexander Rourke
review_text: I recently visited Bangkok Street Thai Street Kitchen and overall it was a decent experience. The food was good we tried the Pad Thai and some of the curries, and the flavors were pleasant and reasonably authentic. The service was friendly and polite, which added to the visit. On the downside, the portion sizes felt a bit small for the price, and the atmosphere was nothing special just average. I might come back if I’m in the area and craving Thai food, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

author: Mafrey S
review_text:
I went there for dinner, and the service was amazing. However, I was very disappointed with the papaya salad. It lacked flavor, and the sauce didn’t taste right—it seemed like it might have been pre-made. I mentioned it to the server, but they said it was American style.

My husband tried the papaya salad as well and agreed that the taste was off.

On a positive note, the baked mussels were delicious and ended up being our favorite dish of the night.

author: Wander in Wisconsin
review_text:
I had the Thai Green chicken curry which was fantastic. The eggplant was a nice addition. The owner was very friendly and the restaurant is very clean. They offer Thailand beverages and lemon diffused ice water.
I highly recommend esp if you’re look for Authentic Thai food.

author: Margot Perry
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal! This Thai restaurant blew me away from start to finish. The flavors were bold, authentic, and perfectly balanced—every dish felt like a masterpiece. The service was warm and attentive, making the whole experience even more memorable. I honestly can’t recommend it enough; if you’re craving Thai food that’s both comforting and exciting, this is the place to be!

author: Paul Niehouse
review_text: Abolutely fabulous food! Had the pork belly appetizer, green curry Chicken and the Daisy, Eggplant with basil and a Lychee martini. Everything was absolutely fabulous.  Finished every bite. Can't wait to go back again!

author: Kpop Girl
review_text: SERIOUSLY amazing GOOD authentic Thai food!! My husband and I eat here multiple times EVERY single time we visit Vegas! (A true hidden gem!!) YES, it's THAT good!! And they have crazy good prices!! Try their crazy wings, mussels with seafood sauce, papaya salad with sticky rice and Tom Yum!! WOW! So so YUMMY!! And their service is fantastic!! AND Kay was AMAZING server too!!!

author: Tedd Lookatch
review_text: Right at the end of Fremont's experience, just a little outside the crazy zone, you'll find a nice little authentic taste of Thai. Big beer selection, including Chang Singha and slew of good selection and locals. The person next to me highly enjoyed theirLechee martini. The vibe with live feed footage of the streets of Bangkok lived up the hype. They had a huge menu with of of options including many specials. I tackled the dungeness crab fried rice perfect for late night bite. Light, fresh, and layered flavors made a simple dish a lot more complex. The red curry and its 18 ingredients made fresh had a nice snap to it to it. The yellow was more mild  and balanced.  Patron next to me took on a ribeye plate and raved about the flavorful cook on the meat.

author: Spud Racing
review_text: Incredible!  My new favorite restaurant in Vegas.  Would come here every day if I could.  Lol.  Portions are huge and the food delicious.  The house and hibiscus margaritas were fantastic.  Didn't actually like the other two specialty margaritas much, but they were interesting and beautiful if nothing else.

author: Ryo Zsun
review_text:
Met up with an old friend at Nacho Daddy, one of my go-to spots in Vegas, and it didn’t disappoint.

The newly renovated space looks great, and our server James set the tone with friendly, upbeat service. We started with the Daddy Wings (a must!) — perfectly crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and always a crowd-pleaser.

For our main, we shared the Supreme Nachos, loaded with toppings and just the right amount of heat. My friend loved the vibe and said she wants to come back — same here.

Whether you’re catching up with friends or just craving solid nachos and wings, Nacho Daddy is always a great choice.

author: Chris Peralta
review_text: Great food and great drinks here! The nachos pictured were as good as they look! I ordered the house margarita, and I was prepared for it to be just OK since house margaritas tend to be -- but it was actually very good! I recommend!

author: Irania Rodriguez
review_text: Randomly found the place while visiting Vegas and on Fremont St area. We told them we were celebrating his birthday and they were generous enough to provide a fried ice cream dessert with cinnamon sugar chips! They tasty food and the nachos order we had was enough for 2!

author: Ann Nguyen
review_text:
Late-night dinner when we are in Las Vegas.
We ordered Mexican Corn as a starter.
Rating our orders from most to least favorite: 1. Chicken Tinga Nacho was my top pick, great seasoning, and it's hard to find chicken tinga sold at stores, usually only grandma makes it at home.
2. Filet Mignon Nacho, very good.
3. Al Pastor Nachos.
The drinks came in huge sizes, perfect for a birthday celebration. The staff were very kind.

author: Simple Things
review_text: Nacho Daddy has a large, open space that’s perfect for big groups, with plenty of seating options to fit everyone’s vibe. Our waiter was super helpful, kind, and knowledgeable, which made the experience even better. The food was good and the drinks were refreshing. If you’re in Vegas looking for a spot with a fun bar vibe and great atmosphere, this is definitely the place to be!

author: Anthony Maxwell
review_text: It was a wonderful experience. Actually, I was told to go here by my side and just a lap and a friend of mine. When is some nachos so we went here? The service was great. The food was fresh i had the enchilada nachos.I left a picture, the music was cool, and the atmosphere was cool. Great spot to sit down and have something to eat or to drink. I definitely will go back..

author: Aditya Goyal
review_text: Living in Texas, I thought there can be no place for a better Mexican food experience. I was pleasantly proved wrong by Nacho daddy . The menu is very refreshing. A lot of options for vegans and vegetarians. It’s not possible not to overeat at this place.

author: Jamie L
review_text: Outstanding service! Somehow our group reservation wasn't in their system, but they quickly accommodated us, and they were happy to do so. From walking in the door to paying the tab, everyone we encountered was friendly and helpful. Our server, Jaredh, was very attentive and nice. Even the manager, Kevin, took care of us at times with a kind and friendly disposition. Also, the food was delicious! And the drinks... Get the margarita flight!

author: Reaching The Soul
review_text:
Just a short walk around the corner of the Fremont street experience and you will find yourself at Nacho Daddy!
It’s a fun casual atmosphere nothing fancy, but they have a great menu with lots of choices for unique style nachos.
We were just looking for a snack so we shared the  Al Pastor and had a margarita and we dug into it before I even had a chance to take a picture, but it was very good, but if you’re hungry, I would not share it again. To me, the portion size was a little smaller than I expected, and that was the larger size nacho platter that we were told we were getting.
I would definitely go back to try another one of their creations .
They have a tequila shot with a scorpion in it that they offer and you get a free shot glass if you down the scorpion  🤣
I did not partake as I’ve already had close encounters with scorpions since I live in Arizona  🤣

author: Celeste Zanabria
review_text:
Good joint just off of miracle mile, if you walk down where the boat is and past the Brazilian steakhouse.

We ordered a few plates: chicken quesadilla, wings, rice and beans, 2 carnitas tacos, chicken nachos and chips and salsa.

I loved the tacos, great amount of meat for the price (2 for $7). Nachos were also good. I asked for only the avocado, chicken, cheese, and pickled onions. The chicken quesadilla and wings were for my bf. He liked the seasoning on the wings and the chicken quesadilla was as should be.
