It wasn't until dinner time, at another place, I realized that my beans and rice was never brought out :( we were charged for it, and now I'll never know if the place was a 10/10 (I base my "Mexican food" review off of their rice and beans, a staple and must).

If staying near, I'd probably be back. The awesome early 2000s punk/pop music is a keeper!!

author: Vaibhav Jain
review_text: Loved the food—lots of great vegetarian options and tasty dips. The atmosphere is lively, but the loud music can make conversation tough. Overall, a fun spot with flavorful dishes

author: Lisa Russ
review_text: Great food,  salsa great went for lunch with others. The street tacos with rice and beans and the quesadillas. Check this place out and try the scorpion shot. Cool decor 😎

author: Sridutt Miraskar
review_text: Great spot just steps away from the Fremont Street Experience, yet far enough to escape the crowd and noise. Comfortable seating, a friendly bartender, and plenty of beer options to try. Even late on a weekday night, the staff had the same energy and enthusiasm, encouraging us to sample different brews. We only had a beer and a cocktail since we were full, but both were excellent. Bonus: free parking right in front of the restaurant after midnight.

author: Christina McFarland
review_text:
The food was verry tasty, chicken quesadilla could use a bit more sessoning with the meat but salsa helped, if you order the coffee is it a light/medium roast so not really on par- with dark/french roast. Server was happy and attentive.

The flaming fajita mix (stake and shrimp)
Was awsome easily enought for two if your light eatters

Blackened Brisket Tip Natchos- were tasty, think we would have prefered tortilla chips- the potato chips got soggy really fast.(still tasted great)

author: Jenny T
review_text: Overall the chicken quesadilla was the best dish. The nachos would have been nicer if they didn’t forget to add the guacamole and I didn’t realise until I looked at another review with it on it. So make sure you check that the guacamole is on the nachos if you ask to have the same dish as pictured!! The burrito was just average, nothing special. I loved the margarita!! Favourite I have had to date. The setting is nice would come again.

author: Erika Graham
review_text: Love the atmosphere here on Fremont Street . The food was ok but , love the fact they offer vegan  options. James our server was fantastic polite and very pleasant. When I make it back to Vegas I’ll hit it up!

author: PraSan
review_text:
Love this place. Everyone is so nice and our waiter was really nice and awesome!
I am coming again with friends. Love this place so much.
It is authentic nacho and it is really good.

author: BREW
review_text: Good place to stop, just off Fremont St.  Lots of nacho options. Did not disappoint. Perfect size to share and very tasty!

author: Lexie Corrie
review_text: Deanza served AMAZING service I will come back only when she is working and solely for her service. She brought personality and customer service to the maximum. She didn’t make me feel like just another customer she made me feel like THE customer. She made my night and I will come back only for her. Thank you <3

author: Jose Gordillo
review_text: We came in during a busy weekend it was packed and there a was a line but when I say the steak and lobster special was just too good to pass up. $17.99 for a delicious juicy steak, lobster tail, massive baked potato and mixed veggies but the only catch is it's only available during a certain time window. We came in for the late night special and it didn't disappoint. After our meal we ended up walking the food off up and down Fremont Street there's so much to do and see just be aware of your surroundings and respect the laws and locals and everything will be just fine. I can't wait to come back again for another round🥂

author: END ADVENTURES
review_text:
We decided to try the $18 steak and lobster!  It runs 9:00Pm-11:00pm.
The line was starting at 8:3@,  so we got into line.  We were near the front, the hostess came out and took our party size.

At 8:50 they started moving people in, it was well organized and efficient.   Our server came over very quickly and took our orders.   The potato skins were great, perfectly crunchy.   The steak and lobster was good.  The lobster was sweet and tender.   The steak was ok, about what you would expect for the price point.

Overall it was a good experience.  I would recommend going at 8:30, or 10:00 to avoid long waits.

Erin
EnD Adventures

author: Elizabeth Dickens
review_text: My salad was a 4 my husband's steak 3. Solid fresh salad, quite flavorful.  Great service, very busy and still served quick.  The steak was quite thin.

author: Michelle Lee
review_text: LOVE the world famous ribs. Steak meat is a little tough if you mind that. Service was amazing even though they were packed. Overall a great experience on my family's Christmas eve!

author: Rick Cobb
review_text:
I’ll be honest. We came for the late night $17.99 steak and lobster special, and we got a plate that was worth about $17.99. The baked potato was good. The butter made the lobster edible. As for the steak, it was medium rare, as I asked, but still somehow really dry. But they know this. That’s why they set the table with A1 already on it.

All that said, I might actually go back.

author: Sam Olivares
review_text: Staff was professional and friendly. The steak and lobster deal was delicious. We didn't care for the vegetables though. If you ask for ice water, they must put some carbonated water in it. Tasted kinda weird. Maybe they do this so that you can order a drink.

author: Dictator Xi
review_text: Lobster tail and steak special price was 17.99 plus tax and tips . Everything was good, but I think the steak was kind of small. The waiting time for a table was about 15-20 mins

author: Omar Lopez
review_text: Went there for the steak and lobster deal. That was a bad decision. The steak was dry and cold. The lobster was gummy and cold, and the service was atrocious. Me and two other buddies of mine ate there, and we all have food poisoning and diarrhea that same night and the next day. Do not come here if you think you’re getting a good steak and lobster the portions were small as well and everything is cold and not fresh. The 40 minute wait time was not worth it.

author: Amanda
review_text: Went here for the $17.99 Steak and Lobster Dinner special from 9pm to 11pm on a Saturday night.  Big line up but was seated in about 20 minutes.  Fast and friendly service.  They have a big menu and prices weren't bad. No substitutions for specials. 6oz Steak with either lobster or shrimp, baked potato and mixed veggies.  Steak was bland and over cooked but everything else was fine.  Still great price for a good meal.

author: H Merc
review_text: their cobbler soooo good! plus this thursday specials — steak & lobster @tonyromaslegendarygrill 💛✅👌👏 long line but did not wait too long. good job! very efficient.

author: DIAMOND LEE
review_text:
Waited an hour to get in.
We all ordered the steak and lobster. There was 8 of us in our group. I took a slice of the steak and I smelled it and then it didn’t smell very good. It smelled rotten. But then I said, maybe it’s just me. The meat was overcooked. So I traded it with someone else who had their meat cooked to my liking, which is medium rare. Then I cut a slice of that one. And it tasted really weird just as the first one did.
So I asked anyone if their meat tasted weird and they said it did so they didn’t eat it. Some of us ate it and some of us didn’t.
Then I began to look around, and I saw one man holding his stomach
Then I saw another couple get up and leave and only eat a baked potato
Then I heard people talking
So I continued, and I ate my lobster. The vegetables tasted frozen like frostbite.
Then I asked the bus boy if something was wrong with the meat  he said yes the meat went bad
The meat tasted as if they left it out or something !! it was horrible
I went to the bathroom and I started vomiting and throwing up and feeling nauseous. My temperature went up. I was sweating.  I didn’t know what was happening to me, but I think I got food poisoning. So after coming back from the bathroom, a lot of people were sitting there with no food.
So I asked the waiter if something is wrong with the meat because I just vomited and I don’t feel very well
He said don’t worry about it. I’m only gonna charge you for your salad.  And I asked him again. Is there something wrong with the meat? I feel sick I don’t feel well.
He said I’m taking off the food except the salad . That wasn’t my point. My point was the food bad or what? No questions were answered. The next thing I know these people are sitting there waiting 20 minutes for their food.
And the waiter tell them we close the kitchen we’re closing down the restaurant early . There will be no food coming out. But yet they were serving two lobsters per plate. To a group of 10 people. And then again another four plates came out with two lobsters on each plate. I will never go to this place ever again. The service was horrible. The food was rotten. And the lobster tail was the size of my finger. My pinky size that is. I wonder who’s gonna compensate me for my medication I had to take for food poisoning.

author: Sheralene Meria Clarke
review_text: There was a line so we joined figuring the food would be good. After waiting 20 minutes we were seated and our sodas were brought to us. The cup had food around the rim. The server never apologized when we finally got his attention. He only asked if we still 2an5ed a Pepsi. Ordered a medium well steak and it came out bloody. Didn't eat the  food nd the waiter didn't care. The ribs had no flavor. The gave us a cold bottle of bbq sauce from the fridge. This was a disappointment and a waste of money because the food was inedible

author: Kyle Lowman
review_text:
As everyone else came here for the cheap steak and lobster which wasnt bad, for the price it was great, I asked for rare steak and it came out like medium well but it did taste good still and wasnt super tough,

huge line that piles up in the hotel lobby that seemed daunting but our group of 3 waited like 15 minutes or so and it moved right on through and we got a booth earlier than expected also as they were asking for group sizes and we got picked to sit down before being at the front.

It was about 30$ a person but we got drinks and appetizers and split the cost for the 3 of us. Drinks were cheap and the onion tower appetizer was pretty good 😎

Don't have your hopes for a 5 star restaurant but for a cheap but still somewhat decent time its a good place on freemont street that isnt white castle or some crappy place haha

author: Wolfpack1
review_text:
Tony Roma’s restaurant inside the Fremont Casino in The Fremont Street Experience is mediocre.

“So-so” might be the best description for the food, service and overall experience.

I had dinner with a friend on a recent Thursday night. My baby back ribs were a bit dry but not bad. The side order of beans and the sauce for the ribs were tasty. The cup of cole slaw was so-so.
My friend said his hamburger was good.
A post by a Vegas social media influencer teases a steak and lobster deal for $15.99. When I asked about it, the waitress said it’s available only after 9 pm. Very misleading. Personally, I wouldnt go back.

author: Ode
review_text: $20 steak and lobster tail should have been a $5 special.  Idk where they found this "steak" if that's what it is, the tiny lobster tail came out cold enough it may as well have climbed itself outta the ocean and the apple crisp was like a soggy used pair of Huggies. Nothing crispy about it. I didn't expect much but I didn't expect it to be this low level food quality and service.

author: Rollinnfishin
review_text: Definitely hit this spot if you're on Fremont Street. Get in line early before it opens, very crowded but worth the wait, for the steak and lobster price.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text: We came for the Steak & Lobster deal!! 🥩🦀🥩🦀🥩🦀 It’s pretty good. The lobster tail was better than the steak!! The service was 5 stars!! Our server Pamela was beyond amazing!!! I will come back for the service and the lobster tail!!! Get here early cause there’s a huge line before 9pm!!!!

author: JF Piché
review_text: I went there for the steak and lobster special for $17.99 between 9 to 11 p.m. on a Sunday night in October 2025. We showed up 30 minutes before the start of the special and there were already about 30 people in line. To be honest, my expectations were not too high considering the low price for such a meal. But all in all I was quite happy with my experience. Once 9 p.m. hit, we were quickly seated even though the line was long. I was happy with the service and my meal overall. My wife and I were very happy with the steak specifically. The rest of my meal was fine. At that price, I would probably go back for the steak and lobster special.

author: Adeoye Sarah
review_text:
If you value your money and your time, avoid this place.

I was not going to leave a review , but this experience was too bad to keep it to myself. From the moment we got there, it was clear this place survives on hype, not quality. We stood in line for over an hour with no one from the restaurant checking in or giving any kind of update. They just left us standing there like we didn’t exist.

Then when we tried to go in to enquire what was going on, the manager was extremely rude and aggressive. Instead of offering any help or explanation, he actually called security over the simplest question. It was unnecessary and honestly embarrassing.

As for the food, don’t let that steak and lobster special fool you. The steak tasted like it had been sitting in a freezer forever. It was dry, stale, and falling apart in a way that didn’t feel like it was cooked fresh at all, it was rubbery and bland. Same with the shrimp and lobster. You could taste the decay in the food.

This place clearly takes advantage of new tourists every day, knowing most people won’t come back. It’s all about quick money, not quality or service.

Save yourself the disappointment and take your money somewhere else where the food is worth it and the staff actually cares.

author: Charles Derrig
review_text: I had an amazing experience. Our waitress was extremely busy, but was very friendly and helpful. I had the prime rib special and lobster tail and loved it. I would recommend just be prepared for a wait during the special hours.

author: Darrin Montes
review_text: The flavors here are amazing and every bite keeps you coming back for more. The carne asada and pork are perfectly seasoned, and the chicken is just as tasty. Mulitas quickly became my favorite with their generous portions, lots of cheese, and plenty of meat. The tacos are satisfying, and the burritos and quesadillas are hearty and filling. Truly a place where the food always delivers!

author: Reena Macon
review_text: Located on the corner of Las Vegas Blvd and Bonanza, a well known taco stand serving up tacos, quesadillas, burritos and much more. Came for lunch line wasn’t too long and food was ready within 5 minutes. I ordered a carne asada burrito, it was very flavorful , big and fulfilling. They also serve agua frescas but I didn’t get to try it this time. Customer service was good.

author: Xochitl Velasco
review_text:
This is a mobile drive thru. Very small parking lot think about in & out but not as advanced.

Staff is not very friendly and not as good or portion wise as the original.

Not a fan of this location, first time and last time coming to this location. Portions are smaller as well.

author: Maya
review_text:
Really good authentic tacos. Definitely the real deal. We tried pork, steak, chicken, chorizo, lingua, tripe, cabeza, buche and all were good. Drive thru is a cool experience too, but expect it to take 15-20 minutes on a busy day. Worth the wait though.
Hibiscus was also delicious.

author: Daniel Tonks
review_text:
We just had a carne asada burrito, gringa al pastor, taco al pastor, and taco carne asada. It was all great! We came here because a local recommended it to us, and we’re glad we did.

On our last Vegas trip, we went to el gordo and loved it as well. It’s hard to say which place we liked more, though I might give a slight edge to the adobada at gordo over the pastor here. I know they’re not the same thing, but the al pastor I had here was just a little dry. That could have to do with the time of day though. This al pastor was still very good, and the carne asada was amazing. I’d highly recommend anything with carne asada here.

author: Thomas Sheppard
review_text:
I think these are the best tacos in town. I eat here 3 to 4 times a week. But this location seems to misrepresent themselves, and the employees are sure not pleasant when they do. They are not 24 hours. They are closed right now as I am in the parking lot.

*Follow up: went back a second time because I really wanted some tacos and again I am a big fan of these tacos. My order took an exceptional long time to complete and it was only a couple tacos. The employees forgot to include my salsa and did not put pineapple on my pastor taco.

HOPE this was just a bad day.

Recommendation: Go To the Tropicana location. The staff there seems to care a lot more.

Update 11/30/2025:

Unfortunately, this is just a hood taco truck. Their service and food quality consistently shows this to be true.

I gave this location a second chance today I walked up and ordered a pastor taco, which Has a picture on their menu. When I received the taco, it did not look like the picture because they did not serve it with the pineapple.

I asked the employee why the taco wasn’t served with pineapple and they told me I had to request pineapple. I asked why I had to request an item that was on the menu and followed up by requesting some pineapple. I was replied to with attitude and told that from here on out I have to request the pineapple when I order The pastor taco.

This location is not worth your time or money. The Tropicana location is phenomenal. Absolutely worth the drive

author: Sir Barry
review_text: There's a sign on top of the truck that says "best tacos in Las Vegas". I haven't had every taco in Vegas but after having theirs, I think they might actually be.  Delicious 😋.

author: Kristopher Kuss
review_text:
I walked from the Fremont experience. I got 3 tacos. They were excellent. It was honestly one of the best meals I've had in Vegas. I will return.

It's right down the street from the excellent neon light museum. A must see in Vegas.

author: Get Some
review_text: I mean sure this place is in a rough part of town. But everyone around there is nice. There's never any issues and the food is amazing. I 100% would recommend going. I've sent four or five people there and they also agree it's the best tacos in Vegas. There used to be another place that was equally as good but they've been out of business for a couple years now. The quesadilla is amazing definitely recommend the pastor with pineapple. I don't think I've ever had a more yummy taco.

author: Ana Olivera
review_text:
Great food, my go to when i fly in or out..
They have a building specifically for eat in, seperate from kitchen. Nice outside to sit, have been to their other location as well...
Same, great food...

author: Dizzy Bee
review_text: This is a taco truck we saw on social media and it didn't disappoint. The meat quality was good as well as flavor. They packed the tacos. Had an aqua Fresca de Jamaica. That was good too. Will definitely return

author: Leo Montoya
review_text:
Food is perfection. Flavor and quality. Incredible.
It is on a corner, repurposed gas station, limited parking, cash/debt only. Stay safe but if you can get food fresh from here, you should.
I'll be back (not at night and not alone) for incredible food.

author: Nov
review_text:
I explicitly asked for a veggie burrito. The unprofessional lady at the counter asked me if I wanted everything inside. I said, "As long as it's veggie and not meat." They gave me a meat burrito, and when I asked them to change it, she said they couldn't do it.
I had been keeping my eye on that spot and wanted to give it a chance for a while now. Luckily for me, it never happened until today.
These guys do not respect their customers. Stay away from this place.

author: Diana Wei
review_text:
It's good as after 2am or 3am tacos, or else I would not consider it. Taco Truck Open 247, Cash and Debit Card taken. Near Fremont Street/DTLV but not walkable, or at least safely. $3.25 tacos, $10.50 burritos. Only taco joint open after 3am in the area. The price, and quality isn't up to my standard but it's definitely decent for Vegas DTLV or Eastside 24 hours. We take what we can get. Drive through is very efficient with 2 lanes. Walk up window is in between the drive thru and taco truck.

We've been twice in a roll. First night at 3amish for drunk food, then 9pmish for late dinner to actually recall the experience.
$3.25 tacos. (No carnitas here, only al pastor). Buche was cold, and some room temperature warm.
$4.75 for lengua and tripa tacos. Lengua was okay and I can reorder it. Tripa was fried and okay too.
$10.95 burritos. Comes with rice, beans, cheese and sour cream. +$4-$5 extra if you want half half meat on a burrito. SO got tripa and  al pastor. Al pastor was fatty.
- Red and green sauces, and onion/ciltrano garnishes. Red sauce is orange and not the typical red sauce I'm used to.
- The double tortillas are generic and felt like microwaved warmed....no bueno for me. The SO is down to order his burrito again but with only 1 protein next time.

We will most likely go back since it's the only place open after 3am in miles and miles, or nearby DTLV. You can stand, or drive thru, or pick up for takeout.
Most Vegas taco places specialize in birra vs carnitas in LA. It's been difficult to find decent tacos in non-North Vegas areas.

author: Sophia Rivas
review_text: The best food hands down!! Any time of day or night. They have a few locations, but this one at the corner of Las Vegas Blvd & Bonanza hits the spot. Don't let the taco truck or location fool you. You will be smacking your lips and loving the food. The carne asada and pork are very well seasoned. The chicken is yummy. Mulitas are my favorite. Large sized. A good amount of meat and very cheesy. Tacos are a good size, burritos and quesadillas are large. Oh... and a grilled jalapeno on the side. Don't forget the drinks! My favorite is the lemon and pina agua mixed. I have never been disappointed.

author: Alfred Chin (Alfred)
review_text: They only do takeout order.  At first, I parked my car.  I walked up to order.  I order 4 tacos.  It takes some time to get the order.  I drive my car back to the line of vehicle and wait for the order.  I learned that you can order tacos like going through a fast food drive through.  The food stand is located on a ex-gas station.  There is a drive through order line.    The tacos is very good and I would come back for more.

author: Jackie H
review_text: there nice people fast , efficient and my torta de chorizo always HITS . it’s massive and literally not stingy at all with the meat . 10/10 recommend going .

author: Jasmine T
review_text: We had tacos and a quesadilla. It is a walk up location. Food is done quickly. They give onions and cilantro and salsa on the side. The star off is for service. The woman taking the orders seemed to have an attitude and was very snappy when answering questions. They were not busy so it's not like she was overwhelmed. Not really a great way to represent the business, but atleast the food is good.

author: Claudia Reyes
review_text: Randomly came across this food truck and they really do have the BEST tacos!!! 👌  so good we ended up ordering a 2nd time after we finished the 1st round! Got the lengua and Bistec tacos 🔥 Follow me on Instagram for more vegas foodie pics @foodie_theclaw956

author: Buck Tafoya
review_text: I ordered the Mulitas de trips and Mulitas de lengua and both were so delicious. The salsa, and condiments enhanced the meal. The portions were huge, each order turned out to be a meal in itself. Highly recommend this taco spot. Plus it was a bargain for Vegas.

author: Datashia Stansell Estes
review_text: We had an amazing time! I took my fiance here for his birthday yesterday and we had great food,service and drinks! Our waitress was so sweet and nice! I'm assuming the gentleman with the hat was the owner he got us seated very quickly and he was very kind.  We felt very welcomed.  Upon them knowing it was his birthday they came out singing and brought him a tequilla shot!! Very big menu 😋  very tasty! We will be back also great drink specials.

author: Michael Elias
review_text:
Definitely the best spot for a Mexican family breakfast! Authentic comida that’s full of flavor—perfectly seasoned and prepared. The atmosphere is great, almost like when I was a Lil one. Customer service is truly beyond on point. I highly recommend Frannie as your serve, she was the best! It felt like we were part of her familia, and even though she had other tables, it was like we were the only ones there. I’m sure all her tables would agree.

We’ll definitely always come back here. Thank you, Frannie!

author: Leo03
review_text: An authentic Mexican restaurant. We enjoyed our lunch here, it was delicious! If you like coffee you have to try the cafe de olla with the concha bread to dip, it was amazing! I recommend the chilaquiles with the ranchera it’s fire! The burritos are delicious too! Huge menu with many Mexican dishes, we will be back to try the other options soon! The sever was very nice and took very good care of us!

author: Lj
review_text: This is a family friendly Mexican restaurant. They serve the best authentic Mexican-inspired breakfast. The atmosphere is lively with friendly service. Our waiter Lorenzo was very attentive & made sure our food arrived quickly. They are famous for their pancake & mimosa flights. Best of all you have to have their cafe de olla, served with a concha. Their portions are large & the prices are reasonable.  Definitely have to come back & try the other amazing dishes!

author: Frank Herrera
review_text:
I don't want to give up this hidden gem but too good to keep it a secret! Nothing on the menu disappoints!! Cafe de olla a must try with a free piece of pan dulce! Now to the service.....my boy Frank handled business with top notch service.  I always come here when in town not only for the food but amazing service!

Pictured is the sopes of chorizo and papas and chilaquiles tricolor.

author: Leticia Berrios
review_text: I ordered the tricolor chilaquiles and they were amazing! They come with a very generous portion  steak. Their cafe de la olla was delicious and they serve it with a concha bread that is to die for. It was so soft and very tasty. Our server Marvin was very nice and attentive and brought our food out pretty quickly. I highly recommend you try this place out if you are looking for excellent authentic Mexican food with great service.

author: Alivey Maldonado
review_text: The food is so good and so many options!! I love the mexican music playing the whole time. Really represents our culture. Lots of authentic mexican food options as well as american. George was our server and he was super friendly. They provided fast service. 10/10 recommend. Will come back next time i am in vegas!

author: Christina Estrada
review_text: What an incredible and authentic Mexican restaurant! I visited with my boss and a coworker, and we loved the experience. The service was fantastic our waiter was friendly, funny, and let us taste-test all the mimosa flavors (which were seriously yummy!). Great food and a wonderful time.

author: Yadira Breland
review_text:
It is wonderful to find a breakfast restaurant with so many delicious platters to choose from. My all time favorite is the Tri-Color Chilaquiles with the New York Steak! The green sauce is tangy and yummy. The red sauce is just the right spice and flavor! The steak was cooked medium rare with tons of flavor!
The atmosphere is nice, cozy, and relaxing. Our server Lorenzo was very welcoming and on point! I recommend this place to anyone missing home made Mexican food!!! The "Cafe de olla" is the bomb!!!

author: Freddy Gonzalez
review_text: Absolutely wonderful food! You definitely get your money's worth here, great proportions for your meal, the pancake flight was the perfect size to not overwhelm you. Mimosa flight was very good as well. Shout out to Lorenzo for being a great server, very attentive and wasn't helicoptering over us, came in just in time to refill drinks, customized breakfast orders were executed perfectly and was friendly the entire time we were there. Some of the best Mexican food in Vegas, and bonus stars for being a local business. Highly recommend and can't wait to return.

author: Ray Martinez
review_text: Frank was an excellent waiter and he suggested items for us to try since it was our first time here. Food recommendations was great and we will definitely be back and also recommend this place to our friends. Loved this place, the food and our waiter Frank. Best food in Vegas!

author: Adriana Rivera
review_text: We arrived at 9:30a, got seated right away. I ordered the mimosa flights, Jorge (server) recommended some yummy flavors! My crepes combo hit the spot, came w/2 eggs, bacons & sausage all very good. My daughter loved her cafe de olla & my son his chocolate milk shake. Jorge was very attentive, great customer service! Will def be back soon.

author: Stephanie Rivas
review_text: We visited this establishment for the first time on a Friday morning and were pleased to find there was no wait time. Our server was exceptionally kind and efficient. The food was average; I ordered the carne asada burrito with a side of French fries. However, I was disappointed to find French fries already included in the burrito, which defeated the purpose of ordering them as a side. The carne asada had an unusual flavor, and I only managed to eat half of the burrito. We also tried the mini trio pancakes, expecting a variety of flavors, but were surprised that the Oreo pancakes only had Oreo toppings and as well as the dulce de leche pancakes hint of dulce de leche. The strawberry pancakes lacked banana flavor despite being labeled as strawberry and banana. The concha served with café de la olla was only half a concha. Given the food's somewhat lacking flavor profile, I personally do not think I will be returning.

author: Suspish
review_text:
Steph our server was so nice, and on her game! Give her a raise! She kept our cafe filled, and was very helpful and attentive.
The food really is amazing, and priced well! Please come!!! You will not regret it! Better than any breakfast spot around!!

author: Chris Guarnieri
review_text: Stephanie was one of the best waitresses we had came across. She gave great service and recommendations for food. The mango mimosa was the best one we sampled and ended up getting a big one to share. Will definitely be making this a regular stop.

author: Addriana Esparza
review_text: “We came for breakfast and loved everything from start to finish. The chilaquiles were flavorful, the beans tasted homemade, and the tortillas were fresh. The staff made us feel like family. Jeanine was our server, she was the sweetest and made our experience memorable. Can’t wait to come back!”

author: Jessica Bishop
review_text: The food here never misses! Always delicious and full of flavor! You need to get the chorizo sopes. On this visit we had Johnathan and the service was fantastic! He had a full section but took excellent care of us. Very attentive and friendly! We’ll be sure to ask for him every visit!

author: Soly Portillo
review_text: When driving up to the place you think two things. One, where will I park and two, this place must be very good.   I didn't actually have to wait for parking that long. Under 3 minutes.   Also it was on a Saturday morning.  They have bench seating even outside of where you check in your party which is a nice gesture especially for those who need/want to sit while waiting in line. The servers were on the go at all times.  So we waited under 20 minutes which showed just how quickly the service was.  The placed was a little crammed up it seemed like but,  walked through the aisles with no problems.  The agua fresa drinks are made from concentrated. Unfortunately.    The liquados were made well.   All there dishes seemed like they had a little of that spicy .  It tasted really great except, not everyone such as a person in my group can handle and amount of it.   There fresh coffee from their pot was delicious.    Lorenzo was the server.  He was quick. He was knowledgeable about what they had. His suggestions were tried with appreciation.   With one of the plates having a piece of  shell from the egg still, I let them know so they could mention to the chefs. I know you guys are busy and all but dont rush to where it becomes a growing mistake.   The noise level was perfect unlike those other places that have music so loud you can't even hear yourself think.  I heard it was like a Spanish Dennys. I reminds me more of Eli's on the eastside.  As if they was its sister. Maybe they are?   It was priced well compared to other places. I think I went in there with higher expectations.   Overall decent place.

author: Tandie Nunez
review_text: From Utah trying here loved it definitely go eat there real Mexican food so good I had chilaquiles kids had carne asada burrito and other kid Nutella pancakes coffee was amazing 🤩

author: Sandra Elizondo
review_text: We are in town visiting from Texas staying at the Aria and my husband found this place on Tik Tok and I must say we will be back 10/10 Carolina was Great and answered all our questions we had about menu. Everything was delicious.

author: John in NV
review_text: First time at this place, it's a very cool diner type in a pretty busy strip mall, there's a capriotti's, roberto's, and a wing place. The parking lot is pretty busy but I was able to find parking at 10:30 in the morning on a Tuesday. The food was delicious particularly the pancakes with their homemade syrup. The country fried steak with  pork meat was also very tasty. They were very busy, so I had to wait a bit for my coffee refill. The coffee was worth the wait, one of the best at a diner I've ever had. I would come back here anytime.

author: April Butler
review_text:
Literally probably the best breakfast I've ever had. Visiting for for hubby's bday and our 10 year anniversary. The service was phenomenal and the food was even better. These 2 employees made our whole experience that much better at this restaurant and we're a highlight of our day.

Not to mention the bloody Mary was SO GOOD and I'm a bloody Mary connoisseur.

GO EAT HERE AND SUPPORT THIS RESTAURANT

author: gina theesfield
review_text: Delicious food and friendly service.  Large portions.  We ordered country fried steak, French Toast w candied pecans and fried chicken sandwich.  Biscuit was a bit doughy and claggy.  Cornflakes were a nice touch to the French toast.  I ordered the season drink of apple horchata coffee.  It was not a good flavor profile.  I do not recommend that drink. Plenty of parking, but currently hard to get to with the amount of construction going on in the area. Kinda pricey. $100 for 3 including tip. Definitely a great stop during our brief visit to Vegas.

author: Jo V.
review_text:
Winnie & Ethel's proved to be an excellent place to meet up for brunch with wonderful foodie friends, which makes Winnie & Ethel's even more iconic 👏🏽

One of their best features is their venue. Feeling like an expanded living and dining area in someone's home, we were seated at a good-sized long table with enough elbow room, and table space for all our plates.

Check out their drink specialties! Their drink and food menus are ones to really browse through and make calculated decisions, because their selections are all appetizing 😋

Service with a smile and attentiveness from Katherine (I believe) was what any customer would love. Many thanks for making our ordering and dining experience easy. We know how stressful large groups and extremely busy weekends can be.

If you haven't eaten at Winnie & Ethel's yet, make your reservation in advance. They book up for a reason. Come enjoy and experience it for yourself, and learn about its special history.

author: Dolores Damian
review_text:
Such a cute mom and pop spot.

Got the cold brew it was good. But asked for flavor and basically had to make my own coffee. They even brought out the milk for me.

Got the club sandwich and man that was huge! But good. The sausage in the biscuits and gravy were not that great.

author: Cristina Anderson
review_text: Great food! Impeccable service and beautiful decor. I truly enjoyed this place! Make reservations ahead of time. We came here at 8:45am and luckily I made reservations otherwise it would be an hour wait and I understand why! It’s not in the best location but I felt 100% safe at least in the morning, so don’t quote me if you’re going in the evening. I had the French toast (which was fresh and delicious) and a rose and vanilla cold brew, my kids had fried French toast. Definitely go!!

author: Jamie Spranger
review_text: This was a great spot for a pre-wedding breakfast. Our server was fun and attentive. She even brought us mimosas to celebrate! The plates were plentiful and tasty. My onion bacon and mushroom omelet really hit the spot and I was fueled for the the big day being a brides maid. It was a cute place with an old school style inside. If we are in the area we would come back.

author: Kyla Burton
review_text: We had been hearing a lot of good things about Winnie & Ethel's and being locals, of course we had to give it a try. We went mid-week to avoid the long wait times on the weekend. We had to wait for just a few minutes and we're seated. The restaurant decor was nicely done, with a comfortable feel. The waitress came immediately with a great attitude and a friendly and knowledgeable demeanor. We ordered right a way. I chose the catfish & grits  with their special Mothership coffee and my husband got steak & eggs. Everything was well prepared and tasty. We really enjoyed our meal. The only downside was, it took quite a long time to get our food, close to 30 minutes and we weren't the only ones. But it gave us a chance to chat with some other locals sitting on either side of us. We also thought it was a little pricier than other breakfast restaurants, $75 for two regular breakfasts and 2 drinks plus tip. Overall, it was a good experience.

author: Faray Almazrouei
review_text:
Winnie and Ethel’s is the kind of diner that makes you feel instantly at home the moment you walk in. Nestled in downtown Las Vegas, it blends that old-school diner charm with a touch of modern flair. The staff are genuinely friendly, greeting you like a regular even on your first visit, which sets the tone for a relaxed and welcoming experience.

The menu is full of comforting classics done right—fluffy pancakes, perfectly crispy hash browns, and hearty sandwiches that hit the spot any time of day. The portions are generous without feeling over the top, and everything tastes fresh and thoughtfully prepared.

What really stands out, though, is the atmosphere. It has that nostalgic, retro-diner vibe but feels clean and updated, making it a cozy place to enjoy breakfast with friends or a late-night bite. Whether you’re a local or just exploring downtown, Winnie and Ethel’s is the kind of spot that leaves you planning your next visit before you’ve even finished your coffee.

author: Neil May
review_text:
Excellent food.  Their waffles are savory and lovely.  One of the better coffees.  My wife's club sandwich looked fresh and massive.
I'm also glad to see the arts district is growing  and improving.

author: George Dickerson
review_text:
Winnie & Ethel's Downtown Diner is a true Las Vegas gem.  All of the food items are homemade.  My favorite is the Diner Breakfast.  I always get all bacon that comes with 2 eggs, home style potatoes, and a biscuit. In addition, I get coffee and water.
I can say that this place never disappoints and the staff here are absolutely amazing! This truly is the best breakfast place in Las Vegas!

author: Karen Shepard
review_text: Our first meal we had once we got to Vegas was this restaurant. It was totally hopping. Busy. Busy. We had no reservation (highly recommended), but got seated quickly since it was myself and my husband. I had a breakfast special with a pancake (a huge one at that),and my husband had a huge omelet. There was so much food we couldn't finish it! But it was so gosh darn delicious! All fresh. All homemade. So we boxed it up and had it later on. This place is so amazing that we went back again, the day we were leaving Vegas 😪. I had sausage gravy and biscuits(huge bowl) and my husband had a breakfast burrito (that was huge also). Soooooo goooood!! So much food we got that boxed up and finished it before we got on the plane. Please go visit Winnie & Ethel's. You won't be disappointed! I guarantee it 👍👍

author: Kagura Misaka
review_text: Our family came here for brunch on the last day of our Vegas trip after seeing it recommended online, and it absolutely lived up to its name. The food was absolutely incredible, flavorful, and the menu is such a great blend of classics. The service was so amazing as well, with Cheri being such a sweet server and taking such great care of us. The rest of the staff were also just as kind and their energy really adds to the comfy atmosphere. We are already excited about our next visit to Vegas so we can hit this gem of a diner again! Highly recommend and many thanks!

author: Megan Alvarez
review_text: What a gem! Food was amazing, awesome atmosphere, and the service was excellent. We had the breakfast sandwich and country fried steak and eggs with a side of pork belly! Yum! Had the Cherry Lemonade to go and it was delicious. Our waitress, Melissa, was attentive and sweet. Will definitely be sharing Winnie and Ethel’s with any and everyone we know visiting Vegas.

author: Daryl Combs
review_text: Arrived at about 9:30 Sunday am.  Was told there would be about a 20 minute wait and that I would get a text.  An hour later, still nothing.  Went inside and was told, “sure we can seat you.”  Of course that was true, she had 6 empty tables.  FYI: an important metric for restaurants is turns of the tables – if they are empty, there is no revenue.  So, we were seated, and almost immediately, Catherine showed up.  Catherine had just finished the last of a coffee pot and a Dentyne commercial, so she was way too hyped for us.  She then proceeded to tell us about every single new drink that was available from the bar, and each one was better then the last.  Sorry, we were not interested in drinks.  Next the menu.  After my wife decided on the pancakes, next came all the add ons, blueberries, eggs, hot chocolate, etc.  She felt like she had just chosen the Dodge in the back and had been pushed to get the seat covers and spinners.  I ordered the haystack.  Wife was satisfied with her pancake.  The haystack was not as I pictured in my mind – it basically was fries with chorizo gravy dumped on it and the worlds smallest egg on top.  We came here for the chorizo gravy because of @brandonfromvegas, but it didn’t live up to his hype.  All in all, the food was edible, but the experience was not so much.

author: Endea McKnight
review_text: First, I would like to say Kathryn is one of the best waitresses I’ve ever had ! I visit a Las Vegas restaurant 1-3 times a week and I have had some great service but Kathryn is now number one . She made several recommendations and gave me a background on the coffee, house potatoes and malt syrup. She seemed very excited about their menu items which made me even more excited. She was also very attentive . I just loved her energy and fun sweater. Next, the house potatoes were incredibly crispy on the outside and fluffy in the inside. The gravy on the chicken fried steak had something special in it. The gravy was sweet and savory. Lastly , I never want to eat a waffle without malt syrup again !

author: Melody Quiros
review_text: Great service and excellent breakfast and lunch items. Everything looked delicious from what we saw and we both loved our food, we just couldn’t eat it all of course. Brandon was a great server and knows the menu well. We both had their specialty elderberry and pistachio coffee and we loved them

author: Kimberly Vallejo (Kimbuyanda)
review_text: Good experience server was very nice. Food took a while to arrive and my father's plate was the last one we were waiting for with was only a sandwich so we sat at our table watching out food getting cold waiting for my father's sandwich to arrive. It was his birthday too. Food was ok. I had to ask for tomatoes on my plate so it didn't look all brown. Dad enjoyed his sandwich with was good. Overall good experience.

author: Misti Pierce
review_text:
I had been wanting to eat at this restaurant for over a year, & it did not disappoint! We went for Brunch. The Staff was fantastic from the moment we walked in the door. They were busy, so we put our name on the list & got seated within 30min.
We tried some of the new Drink Menu items & loved them both. We shared a Breakfast Plate, which was more than enough for 2 people. We also added 1 of their famous Pancakes, at the suggestion of our Waiter. Highly recommend.
The prices were extremely fair & we enjoyed everything about this restaurant. Next time we are in Vegas, we will definitely eat at Winnie & Ethel's again.

author: Leo Jacquez
review_text:
We’ve been regulars at Winnie & Ethel for a while and always enjoyed it, but this last visit was rough. From the moment we walked in, the floor was covered in crumbs and it didn’t feel clean at all.

The staff seemed robotic and unhappy, with zero warmth or friendliness. Every request felt like a hassle, even just asking for water refills. I tried to swap poached eggs for scrambled and was told they “can’t do substitutions” even though I’ve done it numerous times, including last week.

The food, which is usually great, came out overcooked and just off. The place is still nice inside, but between the lack of cleanliness, poor service, and disappointing food experience. Hopefully this was just an off day, but it was enough to make us think twice about coming back.

author: sergio perez
review_text:
Coming for the barbacoa not complain, take my back to mexico flavors
Saturday mid-day they are busy
Menudo, my son's likes the menudo and quesabirrias.
Churros small p good.
Thanks

author: Jackie esquivel
review_text: I was here earlier with my family for our first time service was bad constantly had to keep reminding our server for what we asked .. I got my 4 year old the nugget basket with French fries she took couple bites of it and to find out it was raw.. look at this like how can this happen very disappointing I will not be coming here again .

author: Carmen Pineda
review_text: Barbacoa didn't disappoint! The food was delicious, but what really makes ut special is our server maria. She's so kind, always checking in on us, and made my first time visit feel welcoming. We truly appreciate her! I'm from Santa Ana, CA this is worth the trip and ill definitely be coming back again!

author: Adrian Zambrano
review_text: I like it alot they have good deals and prices that you can’t be the food also tastes very authentic and Mexican. The people were very kind and made me feel welcome. I 100% guarantee this amazing restaurant.

author: Jasmin R
review_text: My family and I came to this restaurant for dinner and was pleasantly surprised but the atmosphere. Our server, Fabi, was attentive and super friendly.

author: Hyunwoo J
review_text: Delicious Mexican food, enchiladas were amazing. Service was above and beyond. Ordered more after my meal for takeout.

author: noeshk com
review_text:
Very good food.  Plentiful portions. Waitresses are very attentive.
Food is well priced and worth it. Better than most pricier restaurants on the Strip or Fremont areas. Ho eat here.

author: Arlene Rivera
review_text: We had a horrible experience at this restaurant and would not recommend it. My nephew, who is on the spectrum and has food aversions. He is very sensitive to different foods. We brought in french fries. After being seated, a waitress approached us and informed us that we had to leave because we had outside food. author: YEREMIAH PRINCE
review_text:
To give Pepe's Tacos just five stars feels like an injustice. If I could, I'd give them 45 stars for their exceptional food, incredible value, and consistent quality. This place is a Las Vegas institution for a reason.
Let's start with the food: authentic, flavorful, and generously portioned. The carne asada fries are legendary—piled high with perfectly seasoned steak, rich nacho cheese, and a perfect blend of toppings. It's a full meal that could feed two, and it's easy to see why it was voted the best in Las Vegas.
For taco purists, the street tacos are a revelation. Whether you go for the succulent carnitas or the spicy adobada, the meat is cooked to perfection and served on fresh, warm tortillas. The condiment bar is stocked with fresh salsas and toppings that add the perfect final touch.
Service is fast and friendly, even during the busiest hours. The fact that it's open 24/7 is a gift to anyone looking for a satisfying late-night meal that's a massive step up from fast-food chains. This isn't just a restaurant; it's a dependable, delicious cornerstone of the community. Pepe's Tacos delivers a fantastic, authentic Mexican food experience every time, and that's worth more than five stars in my book.

author: Jenifer Mattock
review_text:
We’ve eaten at this IHOP a few times and it’s always been great. Even though it’s located in a casino and therefore cigarette smoke is unavoidable, the restaurant is always clean and very comfortable. We ate there last night and there was only one visible employee on duty, Roger, who took excellent care of us. He was polite, attentive, and genuinely seemed eager to provide excellent service. There’s one key detail that I believe makes the biggest impact on guest satisfaction that many, if not most, restaurant servers fail to understand. That is checking back a minute or two after order delivery to make sure everything is satisfactory and asking if they need anything else. Roger not only did that, when I asked for a side of mayonnaise, he brought it promptly along with a refill of my husband’s soda which he noticed was nearly empty when he delivered our food. At the end of the meal, he thanked us for coming in—another thing many restaurant workers fail to do a lot of the time.

It might seem like I’m Roger’s mom or friend based on my glowing review, but I’m just a former waitress who remembers what it’s like to only have negative experiences reported.

Last but not least, our meals were delicious. We’ll definitely be back soon.

author: John Castillo
review_text:
You know, I hate like heck to be so negative about this place, but I have to be honest.
In the quest for the franchisee to realize profitability, unfortunately they have gone down a rabbit hole.
The problem is that they have cut back on staff because it is slow. The last time I came in was to pick up to go order last Wednesday at about 8:45 am. When I walked in, all the tables were empty. The server was just seating 2 people. Considering the location and time you would think the place should be packed, but they have disappointed too many guests with bad service because of lack of staff when it does pick up. Not to mention very inconsistent food quality and cook times.
Also the app is not well developed and confusing. The rewards program is a joke. To redeem a reward, you have to first pick what food you want, then they give you a long set of numbers that you cannot copy or transfer to the payment page. You have a write it down on a piece of paper, because it is too long to remember. And half the time it says it is not valid.
Want to hear something funny? I cashed in some of my rewards for a short stack of pancakes. Guess what? There is no short stack in the app or online menu, so it can't be redeemed! I sent an email to IHOP customer service asking about it. After 3 days they wrote me back. You know what they said? They want me to CALL customer service to get an answer.

Bottom line: After ordering from this location in person, pick up and delivery, at least 10 times unfortunately, they consistently disappointed me. All of it self inflicted. Considering, as of this posting, they have several breakfast specials for only $7, the place should be packed.
Set for success. Fix the service , staffing shortages, food consistency, app, online menu, rewards and customer service.

author: Kurt Kurtenbach
review_text:
I highly recommend this restaurant.  You shouldn't believe me. Go there for yourselves to test my judgement. Ask if the old chef is cooking - he makes the magic.

I was driving around looking for a place to eat with my wife. Being in Las Vegas as visitors had left us missing a little bit of home. We couldn't eat in a casino restaurant again - neon lights, loud music, people smoking ten feet away, someone trying to sell me a watch - couldn't do it again until we had a normal meal. We trekked around town in my truck until we got into a very Hispanic neighborhood.  Like our home town of Tucson, AZ, that tends to mean good food. My wife pointed out the restaurant,  El Canelo Restaurant.  We pulled in and went inside. The owner, I believe, greeted us immediately.  She was colorfully dressed to match her beautiful attitude and genuine smile. We chose the seats we wanted to sit in. They serve canned soda or Mexican imported bottled soda along with a selection of beer. After a time of our looking over the extensive choices in the menu, she took our orders.
My wife got a cacerola campirana while I ordered the molcejeta mixta. Chips and a delicious medium heat salsa were served. Not long after our food was served. If you have never experienced a molcejeta, let me tell you about it. Great big stone bowl on carved legs. It's been in a very hot oven till its super hot. Then they add thin sliced beef. Chicken strips. Fish filet. Shrimp in styles butterflied, peeled with shell on the tail, and bacon wrapped. All this goodness is in the bowl with a generous leaf of lettuce draped over the side, a grilling (and grilled) onion, and a halved jalapeño.   It's all afloat in a generous amount of delicious broth and cream.
When the molcajeta arrives at your table, the heat from within the stone is boiling the broth and mixing all the flavors. I could not believe how good it tasted. I've eaten good Mexican food at fine restaurants before, but this was honestly great food.  The service was awesome. The atmosphere was typical Mexican restaurant affair,  except it all was clean and well placed - nothing crooked on the walls,  dust was absent,  not even a single fly. We leave town in two days and hope to return before doing so.
My wife really liked her food.  Normally I would talk you though it, but I was busy head down working on that molcejeta.
(Did I mention the Queso Fresca in the broth?)

author: Alexsis Deleon
review_text: Food was horrible and the waiter refused to give us a refund on it. They never checked on our table and took over an hour for our food. The next day the food made me sick!

author: Denzel Espinoza
review_text: First time there an waited for more than one hour for my ceviche, I have cooked ceviche an it doesn't take that long to cook an the oyster shots didn't had the whole oyster lol just juice (really bad service)

author: ANA BEL V
review_text: The waiter has an awesome attitude and always smiling. The margaritas had NO alcohol taste whatsoever (not worth the price). A 500ml bottle water was $4.79???? DON'T  get the bottles water.

author: Ruben Castaneda
review_text: Excellent service, host made our birthday girl feel great with all the attention n surprise dessert.

author: Anonymiss Angel Mami
review_text: The food was disgusting and I have had good quality Mexican food before. They say it is regular Mexican food and sea food the dish washer didn't properly wash any of the dishes even while ordering regular food you could still taste the sea food on their dishes. The Waitress had a Nasty attitude and was extremely slow bringing the food and when she brought the drink we never got cups with ice she just brought hot drinks. To top it when she brought the food she only brought 3 of the plates we ordered and nearly forgot to bring mine out . I don't appreciate the bad service especially when you are asking for close to 100$ and i don't care if it was a different part of Mexico or not I know good service when I see it . It also is loud and hot. Where is all the money going from customers if not to fix the place up and its right their on Mojave and pecos

author: Vanessa Raquel
review_text: I called to order a agua chile negro , my order was ready in less than 15 minutes and it was delicious. Best one I’ve had in Las Vegas.

author: Jacqueline L
review_text: The taco truck is the only place I have visited and highly recommend it! Handmade flour tortillas as well. A must try is the baby toxic as well as the chicken chipotle burrito. The quesabirria is 💣. Com.

author: IBETH Molina
review_text: Loved it food was delicious, they where fast with are food and very polite 🙂I will definitely come back when I come back to Las Vegas

author: Fuentes
review_text: The birria was amazing, very flavorful and the service was exceptional, pleasant music in the background was gratifying.  I will definitely be back for more.

author: Selina Simmons
review_text: This is the best Mexican restaurant ! The food is so delicious and the service is great! Amanda was the best waitress you could ever ask for. Definitely 5 stars!!!!

author: MiMi T
review_text: Super good food alr server havent used and also atmosphere so good i take pics all the time

author: Roman Petrovskii
review_text:
Pulled up hungry — left full and happy.
This spot’s got mad variety, and most of it actually hits. Nothing too fancy, but the flavor’s there, and that’s what matters.
It’s clean, staff moves quick, and the vibe is chill — no chaos, no stress.
Perfect for squad lunch or late-night refuel after roaming Vegas.
Could’ve used a couple more dessert options, but overall? Solid buffet — would def hit again.

author: Victoria D
review_text: I had 4 plates. Great value ! The food is fresh and the variety . I had two servings of Bourbon Chicken it was so flavorful and  cooked to perfection. , fresh roasted ham,all vegetables I don't get at home.

author: Sabrina A.
review_text: Host and service staff are great. Good place to go for meal on a budget where you get to pick and chose. Salad bar could have been better in my opinion.Nonetheless, I provided a 3 star as a lot of dishes on the line seemed to be unattended to ie: not stirred appropriately while on a steam table or warmer. The womens restroom was disgusting and needed attention.

author: A Rosen
review_text:
I had a GREAT experience
At the wonderful Golden Corral on south lamb boulevard in Las Vegas!

The food was absolutely delicious and what a great variety ...more than any Golden Corral, that i've seen in my life.

I went there for breakfast and it was a wonderful experience!  They had everything you could imagine
For a wonderful brunch...Including things you normally find at a more expensive and upscale type restaurant like Delicious Quiche and an omelet station!
Not only did they have all the breakfast meats and egg dishes you'd expect... They also had freshly made Belgian waffles with strawberry compote and other toppings... Along with
Pancakes, french toast, cinnamon rolls. Muffins... And the incredible list goes on.

They also had a fabulous salad bar, and wonderful Soups, and chicken and fish and so much more...

The building is modern and clean, and the staff we're wonderful and friendly and dressed in the same color and everyone was neat and clean. They play UpBeat music... And they have lots of comfortable booths and tables if you prefer.  Even the parking lot was clean and well paved and well lit in case you dine at night.

It truly was an amazing experience and I will be back when I visit Vegas again... It will be at the top of my list of places to dine.😀

author: Bertrand Levesque
review_text: I frequently go at Golden Coral for my meals. I only have excellent things to say about the quality of the food and the service. I seek to sit in Alicia section to be my server. She has alway been curteous, polite, sociable, attend to my table promptly, is available and pays excellent attention to my table, as she does with all her customers. Alicia is an excellent server with all the great qualities to represent Golden Coral. She has alway been pleasant, respond immediately and a hard worker. She has no hesitation to say hi with a smile. Golden Coral is very fortunate to have such a great loyal employee, who promotes the restaurant and extend her services to make sure that her customer leave with a good experiences and return. Thank you so much Alicia you are the best and wish you longetivity with Golden Coral because you make my experience a very pleasant and enjoyable one.

author: Gina Guedesse
review_text: The food was really good. It looks dated inside and there were a lot of people so I can't fault the servers but in this particular instance, it just took a little while to get drink refills (and our first drink, because the Coke and sweet tea was out when we went through the line to pay). I would definitely go here again.

author: Wolf Raven
review_text:
The place looked great — clean, stocked, plenty of choices, everything warm and fresh on the surface. But the taste? That’s where the wheels came off.

Most of the food was either bland or just… off. I grabbed a deviled egg, and whatever that flavor was, it sure wasn’t “egg.” Tried a hotdog next — it acted like it wanted to be all-beef, but it missed the mark and limped in with a weird, almost-there flavor.

Good presentation, zero payoff.

author: Bernardo Dizon
review_text: Please dont come here expecting fine dining. It's a chain buffet. Come here for a cheat meal. Come here for your protein intake. Variety of choices to fill you up without breaking the bank. I spent >$20 for a Sunday breakfast buffet with water and coffee, and that's including tip.

author: john alexander
review_text: Great time, nice atmosphere and friendly folks. First time here, actually had a great experience and I ate the most my wife said in a couple years. So, there's that.  Recommended for sure. Oh, sorry, the one picture was the end of second plate of catfish, excellent.

author: Joshua Moses
review_text: I first visited this location at the grand opening back in December of 2013, the line was outside the door lol. I've visited this restaurant a few times lately. The food is good especially their omelettes. The service is good, and the ambiance is always busy.

author: andronicus pannell
review_text: Their sweet potato casserole is thee BEST in the world!!!! You can order a whole turkey or ham holiday meal for small and big families or for a giant crowd with their online catering. It's just me and all I wanted was gooey, marshmallow sweet potatoes. But Their website when I tried to order the sweet potato casserole online it wouldn't allow me to pick it up the next day but for like a week later. But I went inside today and the manager said I could get it today. So there I was scooping up buckets of sweet potato casserole. It was a marshmallow mess. I could of took a bath in the stuff. Ha ha ha  They only have this during the holidays and I highly recommend you stock up on it while you can. I'm sure you can freeze it and have some other than the Holidays. And it's to long a wait until next Thanksgiving/ Christmas. OMG It is SOOOOOO good. It really is the best ANYWHERE. I'm having mine for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, late night snack. Thank you to the manager during lunch on Dec. 9, 2025 and to the cashier. Thank you for allowing me to grab it today and not wait a week. Your the best!!!! I'm in sweet potato casserole heaven!!!!!

author: DAVE MACKENZIE
review_text: Definitely a five star free it was clean. It was friendly. Oliver was fantastic. The food was warm and fresh. Definitely worth the value definitely worth the time. Something for everyone.

author: june megumi
review_text: Very family friendly buffet. The food is pretty good. Not gourmet but no complaints. Gave 4 stars because the frozen yogurt machine was broken and they did not have biscuits and gravy. The birria tacos needed more meat and less cheese. Dessert station is AWESOME.  I would go again.

author: Paola Nevarez
review_text: My family and I have been coming here for years & it has really gone down hill. The service is terrible. The lady cooking the steaks today 9/16/25, has a serious attitude and turns out to be the manager. Our server was nice but didn't even come around to refill our drinks or take our plates until we asked. The restrooms are beyond disgusting! They are covered in dust & and just filthy. You can tell they haven't been cleaned in weeks. The Henderson location is definitely better.

author: Phyllis Twilligear

Love the buttery fish, clam chowder, etc. Ice cream cone.carrot cake, bread pudding, banana pudding Yum, went to heaven! May God bless these hard working people! Love you guys, Carlos- great waiter thank you!

author: Robin Luff
review_text: I went to the buffet with my neighbor an we truly enjoyed the buffet! It was all hot an very much enjoyed it! The service is amazing too! It's very busy but the food is hot everytime we went back for more! The drink shouldn't be a separate charge? With the drink its over $20 so folks know. We will definitely be back! Bringing my bff in a week! Yummy meal! Steak is great too! See ya soon!

author: Giovanni Velez
review_text: Ruben was awesome! He paid attention to detail and constantly making sure that we are not missing anything and keeping our table clean.  He really take care of us. Always smiling and friendly no just with us also with everybody else as  well. He is the best. Thank you Ruben.

author: Sandy
review_text: Visited here a couple times when we are on holiday in the states. Always busy which is good for business. The food choices are great and always well stocked up. I always go with the intentions of having a feast but never get close. I wish we had decent places like this in the UK

author: Alejandra Ruiz
review_text: Everything was good except the manager who was training the cashier really ask to see my daughter ID to prove she was 12. I know people lie but even my daughter told her age and why lie about it. So that means if she was 9 or younger that would be ask too. Other than that it was a good.

author: Ms. Monrare
review_text: Came here for Thanksgiving. Everything was amazing. Did wait in line, but the line moved fairly quickly. The food was up, kept very well. The servers were on top of keeping the tables previous bus very impressed

author: Daniyal Arai
review_text:
The Plate Bar & Grill – Review:
The Plate Bar & Grill offers a welcoming atmosphere with a diverse menu featuring American classics and comfort food. Known for generous portions and well-prepared dishes, favorites include burgers, steaks, and hearty appetizers. The bar selection is solid, with a good variety of beers and cocktails. Service is friendly and attentive, making it a great spot for casual dining or meeting up with friends. The ambiance strikes a nice balance between laid-back and lively, perfect for both dinners and weekend hangouts. Overall, it’s a dependable choice for good food, drinks, and a relaxed vibe.

author: BigP
review_text: Came here with family for a quick dinner, food was great Michelle was even better! Thank you guys for the fast and friendly service. Love the halloween vibe, will definitely be back!

author: Blaker Giron
review_text: I'll start off by saying this is a local sports bar. It leans towards the divey side in the best way possible. The best thing about this bar is the surprisingly well cooked food. They have a great selection that is reasonably priced. You can't go wrong with any other burgers and if you want a steak dinner the prime rib is amazing. I thoroughly enjoyed the chili bowl with beans. Whether you go to watch a game or play billiards with some friends, you won't break the bank with the pricing of the drinks. During the week they have different events, such as scavenger hunts, bingo and karaoke, to name a few. This is a great place to have a relaxing evening with friends. I will definitely be back.

author: Courtney Abbott
review_text: Treated me like family and a dope chill spot. Always have cake and always a good time. You best get my bud mr jon a budlight, wings are fire, any special that have is delish ❤️ shane is also a charm.

author: A Google User
review_text: Great energy, bold flavors, and solid drinks. The ribs were fall of the bone good, and the cocktails hit just right. Lively crowd but still cozy enough to chill. Perfect spot to unwind after work or kick off the weekend.

author: Craig Johnson
review_text: Bar food wasn't that great.  It wasnt bad but didn't live up to some of the other reviews I read.  Lots of homeless camped out right next to the building. Table clothes were thin cotton blankets that were dirty, full of crumbs.

author: Xbox User
review_text:
5🌟
I vote this one of my BEST neighborhood bars

One of those hidden gems in Vegas that you don't know about unless a buddy takes you there.

Food is great. Bartender is always awesome. Drinks are cheap. Places nice. It's also kind of military-centric sports on all TVs. Bar poker/slot/keno.  Totally recommend it. Very community feel so you'll have to put some time in here before you can really get your groove on. Jukebox always playing good jams. It's clean. author: DJ Reynolds
review_text: Waited 1.5 hours for a terrible salad that said grilled chicken but came out with deli meat. Terrible atmosphere filled with cigarette smoke. Don’t waste your time or money

author: matt pesino
review_text: Waited hour and twenty minutes for a terrible salad that said grilled chicken and came out with deli meat. Don't recommend unless you want to wait forever for horrible food and breathe cigarettes in

author: Ron Wayne
review_text: The cook was great. But it's really smokey. Nothing worse than eating your prime rib in a cloud of cigarette smoke. Ruins the taste of everything. The farthest table from the actual bar was about 20 feet

author: Cody Flowers (Cody Flowers)
review_text: Stopped by here on a whim. Fun, smaller hole in a wall type atmosphere. Food was great and fair prices. The Saturday night prime rib special was better than a high dollar steak house we ate at while here. Will definitely come back when in Vegas next.

author: Jacqueline Khoury
review_text:
This is a really cool bar. It has 2 pool tables, large TVs, full food menu, and WIFI. I like to come here to get work done from my computer while eating lunch or dinner. Coffee in the morning is also really good. The bartenders treat you like a friend would and they are very helpful overall. I recommend trying the burgers here.
Thanks Zo for making me feel welcomed and introducing me to the bar. That was a nice feeling.

author: Irwin Wainwright
review_text: Such a wholesome fun bar perfect place for a good meal if you’re hungry or a good drink at the end of a work day! Karaoke is a blast every Friday and the bartenders Renea, Marissa , and Zoe are the best

author: Maria
review_text: Absolutely love this bar!!! Marissa, on grave, is the BEST bartender in town with the BEST drinks for every occasion! Amazing food and they make you feel like FAMILY!!!!

author: Leanna Saavedra
review_text: Marissa makes the BEST shots in Vegas!!! Every employee treats you like family and you really become family in there! Trivia night on Sunday at 10:30pm with Marissa is THE BEST and the most fun I've had in a long time and is hilarious! Also, Michelle, Shane, Zo, Renée, and Sharon are awesome as well, but no one is better than Marissa because she will give me wake up calls for work in the morning😁 I LOVE THIS BAR

author: TheMikey1865
review_text: This place has a down home neighborhood bar atmosphere. It's a locals hangout off the strip that has great food,at reasonable prices. The wife and I haven't been disappointed yet. They serve burgers,sandwiches and a lot more.

author: Lauren Castaneda
review_text: Marissa and Zoe have always made my experience here amazing and have always kept me returning! My new favorite place to go with my friends and especially to see all the amazing staff that is always so friendly :’) 10/10 recommend !!

author: Ed Taylor
review_text: Went at 3 AM and had a Huge Plate of Steak and eggs cooked to perfection .. The Service was Amazing and so was the whole vibe of the place .. Definitely recommend this Great East Side Gem ..!🙂

author: Stacy Rohrer
review_text: This place is great. The food is good and very reasonable. The staff have all been very friendly. We will be back again and again and again. Cheers!!

author: LaMozae Kelley
review_text: I stumbled upon this neighborhood bar, checked it out in a night Marissa was there and fell in love with the bar huts based off of her energy and service . The food exceeds your average “dive bar” expectations and I feel like I found my home bar ❤️

author: Carmine Santiago
review_text:
The absolute best deal and quality in the Fast Food arena is this ($10 Burger Pack )
You Must try it nothing compares to this excerpt paying more than double at a sit down restaurant.
You get a restaurant quality burger with everything on it too humongous homestyle Chicken strips that taste like my mother made, but couldn’t cook them as good as these a bunch of fries and a big cup of Good ranch!
It doesn’t taste like anybody else’s it taste like a restaurant and for $10. It is amazing to go through a drive-through and get this.
To get the best quality, eat it ASAP You know how those delivery apps take almost an hour and your food taste like an hour old but hands down best bang for your buck!

author: Las Vegas Hair and Makeup
review_text:
This place taste so good. They are burgers are authentic and amazing. I don’t like burgers and these ones were my favorite. I was gonna tell Alexx can you get One of my sons got pancakes. We got zucchinis.
The only thing that I could say is, it’s kind of pricey. But I would come back for a caving.

author: Yuliana Gallegos
review_text: It doesn’t matter what time of the day it is they have breakfast and lunch All day !! This is one of my favorite restaurants in Las Vegas  !!  Fresh food  excellent customer service  and their Manager  is an amazing and humble person I’ve ever met .

author: Jayy L
review_text: Many varieties of foods , very good serving portion sizes worth the price !! Amazing customer service, always help you out. quality food, definitely worth it! The staff is top notch always ready to assist us customers for a great customer service experience! And to top it of all store is clean and ready for new customers to enjoy the dine in experience!!!

author: Juan Mendoza
review_text:
R Burgers on Nellis is a very welcomed surprise in the Eastside.

I went through the drive-thru after work to get my family some dinner. The service was fairly quick for the large order I placed. I ordered 4 double cheeseburgers, 2 carne asada Fries, chili cheese fries, zucchini fries and a grilled chicken salad. It took about 10 minutes to receive my order. The burgers were what I consider a good California style burger, delicious thousand island dressing that got my bottom bun all soggy and delicious. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. The chili cheese fries have got to be the BEST in all of Las Vegas. The seasoned fries loaded with that delicious chili and tons of melty cheese is the perfect combo. The carne asada fries were a hit with everyone. Perfectly seasoned fries and asada. The zucchini fries in my opinion were a 3 out of 5. They were a little soggy in the middle. The grilled chicken on the salad was perfectly grilled and a very nice portion.

I will definitely be returning to try more of R Burgers delicious menu. Can't wait to return!

author: kevin uhlin
review_text:
Finally tried R Burgers on Nellis, & have been back almost every day for the last few days. Tonight I asked for a custom burger not on the menu, a double chile cheese burger & it was GREAT!! Please add this to the menu.
Love the buy 1-get 1 breakfast burritos, 2 fat loaded burritos for 10.95? Can’t beat it. The fries are excellent too, all in all a great little spot for everyone’s appetite!

author: sabrina gonzalez
review_text: The food is pretty good also for a great price. Service is fast and the staff are friendly and professional. The only reason why I'm doing 4 stars is I think they could be a lot better customer service and greeting when customers walk in the door.

author: Lexi Lopez
review_text: Super super super delicious food omg!! The burger and the sauce on it were amazing. But the highlights were truly the fries and chicken tenders, all so flavorful and perfectly crispy. The ultimate stand out was the delicious ranch. Order was ready quickly despite being so fresh. 10/10 would definitely go back again. Super good prices as well

author: stevenis
review_text: Great to find a good classic burger really. The short end: the food is good and that’s the value. The long end: I just don’t see the value in fast food, McDonald’s is expensive for what you get. I remember eating at a Carl’s Jr and was shocked at the price of a combo. In this way, it’s good to find a classic burger joint. I think the price is a little more than other fast food places, but I’m willing to pay the extra for a decent burger. Also, the fries are my favorite fries in town, hands down. The service is friendly, the atmosphere, is as expected, it’s a burger joint, but, it is really clean inside, that a plus. I’m definitely marking this as my go to burger joint. They also have good snack deals if I want a quick bite when I’m not in the mood for a burger. Looking forward to the other menu items…the pastrami fries look pretty amazing.

author: Chris Lindsay
review_text:
What an awesome 1st experience!  Its good to finally have a great quality Burger place on the East side of town that exceeds expectations!  The burger meat is fresh, NOT frozen like the guys accross the street. Cooked on a flat-top not in a convection Microwave. The pickles, and all the other toppings where crisp and fresh. The dining room was extra clean and comfortable, with booths and tables that can be moved around for the larger parties, and an awsome soda station for your refills! Service, was above and beyond, Andrea who brought us our food on actual plates not card board and Sophia was full of friendly information. Hats off to the BOH, nothing was over or under cooked, it was perfect! I will try the chorizo burrito 🌯  for breakfast with the awesome fresh salsa I saw Sophia making tonight from scratch...
