If your concerned with price people....you need to re-evaluate what you would spend at the guys accoss the street, for frozen unhealthy chemically preserved food. Honestly, for my family of three we only spent about $9 dollars more, or $3 dollars more! However, we took Hella left over fries home to reheat in the Air fryer...because, O' YEAH they are using real untreated fries....thx R burger and you will be seeing a lot of us... East side get on board 👌.

author: Latisha B
review_text: My first time using the R Burger app AND eating at R Burger’s was very different! After using the app to order my food, I went into the Nellis location and was advised my food was ordered for the California location when I’m actually in Las Vegas. Idk how that happened but the manager, Andres came over while I was on the app talking to a customer support agent via chat and asked what happened and explained the app is fairly new and asked to check out the chat to see how it worked. After he checked out the app, he offered to make my order and to simply advise CS he had done so since it was very clear that there wasn’t really a resolution to my situation as CS stated I could hire a third party to pick up my food from California and have them bring it to Nevada. Andres was very helpful and friendly!!! His actions alone has made me an R Burger customer for life!!! FYI, My burger and fries were so delicious!!!!! 🤤😋

author: ed crisostomo
review_text: fast quick service, food came out less than 5 minutes. menu has something about everybody from burgers, chicken fingers, tacos, burritos,shakes, and breakfast.  don't forget they have happy hour too.

author: Aaron Brown
review_text:
The burgers are on par with Whataburger. There, i said it and I'm sticking to it. The service was great, very friendly and helpful to a first timer, and they guys cooking are fast and efficient. Don't get me started on the chicken strips. One word: Huge.
That milkshake, omg! I'm officially designating R Burgers best burger Las Vegas 2025. That's official, write it down, make a plaque, go ahead and give it to them

author: Yuridiana N
review_text:
Food is delicious! Great prices and Excellent Customer Service. I highly recommend this location at Nellis.

Aldo the gentleman who assisted me through the drive up window made my day. He offered me excellent customer service, he welcome me with a Smile and a happy attitude. I loved this encounter and I LOVE the food!! Will definitely be back! Thank you.

author: Dymond Glover
review_text: Chili cheese pastrami fries. BOMB! I was wondering where this place was from when I drive past I saw pastrami.. I’m like yeahhh they from Cali fasure! But these fries have lots of flavor, not dry, seasoned well and cheesy. Every bite has pastrami. Looking forward to trying more from their menu.

author: Ty Bridges
review_text:
Messed up my order after asking multiple times for two meals. Ordered a burger and a chicken sandwich. Didn't come with the chicken sandwich but another of the same burger I ordered.
Also the burgers are impossible to eat especially with the bag you are supposed to pick it up with. Like sonic and carls jr burgers can even be picked up better than this. Fries are great though. But most likely won't come back do to how expensive this place is for how crappy the burgers are.

author: José Alfredo Maldonado
review_text: Probablybthe best burguer I have tasted in Las Vegas. Great fast, and friendly service, clean establishment.

author: normie_ loser
review_text:
R burger has decent food, out of all 3 locations in Vegas, the one on Russel and valley view is the best one, but this one, I went today and the manager had a very mean look as soon as I walked in, luckily he wasn't the one to help me with our order, it was another worker who seemed very nice. Another thing to state that, the manager was wearing sandals, sandals in a restaurant?
Very unhygienic and can cause a work place accident. After today, I rather spend more money on gas just to go to the other locations.

author: MA TM
review_text: Legitimately good food and very reasonable prices. The zucchini sticks are great!

author: H.Y.M
review_text: Great food and polite staffing and clean service. Great salad 🥗 preparation, flavors for days. French Fries were perfectly seasoned and fried to perfection. I would recommend announcing greetings at the door for guest entry it would definitely improve overall experience.

author: Nate MrInk
review_text: Must try when visiting vegas. Portions are Huge and Very Very Fresh. Pricing is excellent aswell. So if you want to save a few dollars versus eating at the strip this is your spot. Food quality is better than most asian cuisine on the strip

author: WTFYD DYFTW
review_text: Well what can i say about this place, it was an experience, please do not compare this place to panda express, its a moms and pops style, mixed with traditional asian style food, even though it has many similarities with panda express, but panda can never COMPETE WITH THE NOODLES IN THE CHOW MEIN. The place was not pack when we arrived but im sure we arrived at the right time because as we entered the line the place began to look we had found a neighborhood jewel with the amount of people that showed up. The staff were focused on taking care of the rush and everyone seemed to know how to do there jobs. This place was busy and not one customer was complaining about the wait. We drove 15 miles to get there because of recent publicity on tik tok, my wife finds these places all the time for us to experience different things as a family. The food portions were comparable to the price,  if not more of a value than what we paid, we had left overs for two days. The selection was what you would expect in a franchise Chinese restaurant. I chose not to use the sauces they had to get a taste of the food they made, it was not bland at all. I can see me going back if i was on that side of town without a doubt.

author: Kina R.
review_text:
I’d rate it a 5, but the teriyaki chicken was a bit bland, although fresh, but lacks sauce/flavor. The orange chicken was good, but my fav was the kung pao chicken for sure! I got a 2 item plate and 3 item plate with half noodles and half rice and spent about $23 and some change so not bad at all! They are generous with their portions so this easily fed my family of 5.

I will say, the wait time is no joke! They’re super busy so I get it. I went during dinner time and arrived at about 5:47 and got out of there at 6:52! The line was all the way to the back and because they make the food fresh as they run out, many people had to wait for one of their items to be ready, like my orange chicken. I’d definitely recommend it to others, but probably won’t go back until the hype dies down and it doesn’t take so long. After all, it’s meant to be take out “fast Chinese food”.

author: Joe B.
review_text:
Message to the Chef:
All your food taste the same. I couldn't find the difference among Beef Broccoli,  Compaw chicken or orange chicken,  salty and overcooked vegetables. Too sweet and missing special ingredients such as ginger, green onions and or fish sauce. The amount of food doesn't compensate flavor. I gave your place 3 chances  try different plates. Work on you seasoning.

author: Miché U
review_text: Food is great for the price. Service is so-so because wait time even when there is a small line. Overall the restaurant is small and gets packed with people to the brim that I wouldn’t recommend visiting during peak hours you’ll be in line for 20-30 minutes. The men’s restroom needs to be cleaned and maintained more properly. The plumbing is slow when flushing, the knob is a little loose and the urinal is out of order. There is a mop bucket in there as well. I feel dirty just being in there. You can tell a lot about an establishment by how well they maintain their restroom. For now it’s more of a carry out place for me. I wouldn’t recommend dine in.

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text: The portions are huge and the food was good.  Reminds me of a  mom and pops spots in cali.,Service was ok the team wirks fast . The bbq pork was probably the only item not worth getting.the expeditor is fast and knows his stuff.  I though I was missing an item and he said he knew it was in there just by the weight.  He was right but should still open it up and show the customer that all items are in just incase he happens to be wrong especially to go orders. Will try again if we are out on that side of town.

author: Pokerface S
review_text: The food was by far the BEST, the serving size was enough to fill to the top. The cooks were constantly cooking fresh food, the lines are getting longer by the minute. They have variety of drinks to choose from . The only thing that was upsetting was the thin Hispanic ladies that serve the food had a frown face and had no energy, nor customer service. While a young Hispanic lady was serving i can hear another Hispanic lady talk in SPANISH , “quietly telling the other girl, “Don’t serve so much PUT LESS in there plat and kept telling her over repeatedly!” They have such bad attitude I try not let it get to me I want to come back but they need to not be in the front line serving if they have such a bad attitude for no reason at all. Nor was I rude to them.

author: Kimberly Renteria
review_text: Went in and there were only two people ahead of me, but somehow I ended up being one of the last to pay. The portions are huge, I’ll give them that. I ordered half noodles, half fried rice with teriyaki chicken and beef & broccoli. My brother-in-law got half noodles, half white rice with BBQ pork and teriyaki chicken. The rice was dry, so it wasn’t enjoyable, but the noodles were great. The teriyaki sauce definitely carried the chicken, and the beef & broccoli had a weird texture. When it came time to pay, they couldn’t find my order even though I was already at the counter. They kept moving other people ahead of me. About three customers, while trying to figure it out. I mentioned it to what seemed like the owner, and he just shrugged. To top it off, they only gave my brother-in-law and me one teriyaki sauce to share for both plates, which was ridiculous. Overall, definitely not worth the TikTok hype. I won’t recommend this place at all.

author: Mike Be
review_text: Tastes pretty good and the portions were decent.  Typical Chinese food options. Kinda small on the inside so seating was limited. But over all the food was good.

author: Jacob Fisher
review_text: Imagine Panda Express but good. Line out the door good. Portions overflowing the to-go box good. Imagine a wonton soup that isn't 2 wontons in water with three scallions but a hearty flavorful broth with massive leaks made fresh to order. I had genuinely forgotten what good wonton soup tasted like until I chanced in on this place. You know the place is good when it is always busy and I've never seen this place. Not busy but service is still fast and you are in and out the door. I love the idea that this place is doing everything that Panda Express wishes that it was and should aspire to be. For my money, this is my favorite local asian food restaurant. I hate to even compare them to Panda Express because they're not even in the same class. Dragon Express is so much better.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text:
**Dragon Express — Nellis Blvd, Las Vegas**

Located on the east side of Las Vegas, Dragon Express stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of a vibrant culinary tapestry of Las Vegas. Dragon Express stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of family-run establishments that resist the sterile confines of modern minimalism. With the warmth of a bygone era, this eatery embodies a heartfelt commitment to satisfying its patrons with genuine hospitality. The counter—creatively situated within a thoughtfully transformed former Panda Express layout—exudes an atmosphere radiating earnestness and unpretentious generosity. Upon entry, one is immediately enveloped by an ambiance that prioritizes the diner's appetite over curated aesthetic experiences intended for social media.

My culinary journey commenced with Plate B, a veritable feast comprising fried rice paired with two sumptuous entrées: orange chicken and Chinese sweet BBQ pork. The to-go container itself was a marvel—a veritable cornucopia filled to the brim, defiantly resisting closure as its bountiful contents spilled forth. This overflow is reminiscent of a traditional ethos where generous portions reflect gratitude and hospitality, serving as a tactile embodiment of warmth and welcome.

Upon its arrival, the orange chicken immediately tantalized both the eyes and the palate. Its outer shell, delicately crisp and audibly crackling, sidesteps the common pitfalls of overly sweet or gummy variations. Beneath this crisp exterior lies perfectly cooked, juicy meat, inviting the diner to indulge. The accompanying sauce enhances the experience with a vibrant citrus note that sings on the taste buds, beautifully balanced by a caramelized depth. This harmony combines a gentle sweetness with a zingy acidity that invigorates the senses. Subtle hints of ginger dance alongside a nuanced soy essence, while a persistent umami resonance compels the diner to savor each bite long after the last mouthful has been enjoyed. This interplay leaves a lingering pucker-sweetness that tantalizes the palate and entices for more.

Complementing the exuberant orange chicken, the Chinese sweet BBQ pork presents itself as a more reflective counterpart. Its glossy exterior, masterfully caramelized, exhibits a sticky sheen that entices without overwhelming. Each tender slice yields effortlessly, unveiling juicy morsels imbued with a fragrant medley of toasted garlic and nuanced fermented soy. These layers of umami depth transform the accompanying fried rice from a mere side dish into an essential contributor to the overall experience, enriching the meal with every harmonious bite.

Speaking of the fried rice, it is a triumph of precision and restraint—each grain is meticulously separated, imbued with savory aromatic undertones that invite exploration, punctuated by the bright freshness of scallions. This rice serves as an ideal underpinning, effectively balancing the saucier elements of the meal while providing a comforting contrast that delights both the palate and the spirit. The dish unfolds as a culinary symphony, intertwining the luminous zest of the orange chicken, the smoky richness of the pork, and the grounding comfort of the rice into every bite.

What lingers in memory is not merely a singular flavor, but rather a harmonious gestalt—a delicate equilibrium of sweetness and salt, a profound umami foundation, and an evident spirit of generosity manifested in both the ample portions and the thoughtful preparation. Dragon Express does not seek to redefine culinary boundaries; instead, it elegantly embodies the art of straightforward, satisfying Chinese-American fare, crafted with authenticity and care.

For those who appreciate cuisine as a quiet act of camaraderie—inviting, devoid of pretension yet bursting with flavor—Dragon Express deserves unequivocal recognition. Five stars.

author: Noc L.
review_text:
Checking out the hype that everyone was raging about. I have to say its overrated. Can't believe everything you see on social media.

The chowmein was salty, the mushroom chicken was salty, the orange chicken was more batter than chicken. The flavor is there, just too salty for my palate. My favorite would have to be the honey walnut shrimp, but they're stingy on that bc I had to pay extra for that side.

Because they just open, I might give them another chance to settle in and improve their routine and recipe.

author: Dana Carrasco
review_text: Service, food and atmosphere is always awesome. Very friendly. Huge portions. The food is always fresh and tastes wonderful. This is our #1 Chinese food restaurant when we come to Las Vegas.

author: K. O.
review_text: Great food. Great service!! The portions were huge!! My wife and I saw this place pop up on a TikTok and decided to make the trip from Anthem to the Eastside. Let me tell you, the trip is definitely worth it.

author: R w
review_text: It’s a small restaurant and the workers are very fast. Overall nice 👍🏾 my favorite is the honey walnut shrimp best honey walnut shrimp I had in my 35 years of living.❗️❗️❗️ I usually order the small honey one shrimp by itself when I don’t want a whole full course meal, but they only give you a few when you do that!! But the plates are very large they give you a lot.✅✅

author: Risse Simpson
review_text:
The location was decently busy. Portion sizes are really large, I can make at least three meals out of a two entree plate.

Rice and chow mein were pretty standard, like you would find at most Chinese takeaways. Cream cheese wontons were just that, cream cheese only. Named appropriately, lol. Mushroom chicken was juicy with whole mushrooms. Salt and pepper pork was outstanding. Nicely spiced! There were chunks of bone and gristle, letting me know this wasn't a processed pork product. May not be everyone's preference, but I liked it.

Service could have been better, the server had to be told a couple of times she had a customer before she came to take my order (she was on her phone). And no receipt given. Overall I would come again because the location is so close.

author: Vonnie H
review_text: I never had Beijing beef with potato’s in it but it truly was flavorful. I am so picky with Chinese food but the reviews spoke and it was delicious. I’ll be back to try some other entrees.

author: Alexis Escaray
review_text: can I just say the food was delicious and the servings were generous! bbq pork was our favorite , haven’t had anything like it in a while! & the customer service was great. he gave us free soup to try with our purchase too. not pricey at all! we’ll definitely be back!

author: Magdalena Rocha
review_text:
Service was fast and friendly,  the food is very good and portions are a good size.  I ordered plate A, which was chow mein, fried rice, and entrée (salt and pepper pork chops) which was the chef's special, and you have to add $1.50 more.  That was a lot of food, the plate was full.  I ate probably 1/3 only and you can see in the picture how much was left. (Sorry but I was hungry and didn't take the picture BEFORE eating) I also ordered cream cheese ranguns and paid around $17.00 plus tip.   Honestly, that's enough food for 2 hungry people.
It was nice to see actual Chinese people cooking and serving the customers.  I recommend this place.

author: chris carvo
review_text:
I kept getting adds saying it was so much better than panda without the panda price.  The rice was ok but the chow mein was disgusting. The noodles were overdone mush. The orange chicken was super thick breaded and all sugar no flavor. The real star was the bbq pork. I spit out the first bit due to the overwhelming sugar and taste of red dye. It didn't take like any bbq pork I've ever had. I ate almost all of everything simply to not waste food but I couldn't eat more than one piece of the pork.
Good marketing but the food doesn't hold up.

author: Nancy E
review_text: Food is always great! This time I rated 4 stars because the red chilaquiles were pretty much just chips and salsa, not a chilaquile sauce (yes, there's a difference). We ordered them without chicken and the price remained the same, I expected the price to go down, but I didn't ask. The breakfast items like eggs, bacon, pancakes, are always great. Coffee tasted great, ordered the TikTok coffee and it was huge and delicious. Everybody is always friendly and despite the place being full, we got seated right away and served in a timely manner.

author: Wholesome CBD & Supplements
review_text: The food was fast, the server staff is friendly and helpful with their menu, and the restaurant is clean. We were able to eat in their 50's Diner Car which adding a nice ambiance to our meal. The music was family friendly and the price for their pancake special was affordable. The food was delicious and we will be back!!!

author: MA TM
review_text:
I would rate this restaurant 3.5/5.
Ambiance is awesome, I love the 50s vibe and it is well done. Service is super friendly and welcoming and prices are reasonable. My issue is more so with the food. I ordered an omelette, coffee, and orange juice. The orange juice was fresh and delicious; however, the coffee was extremely watered down and the omelette was very bland.

author: Maria Colomy
review_text: Super cute place - excellent service. Bacon could’ve been cooked a lot more - crispy is best lol… Would visit again- they had a huge menu.  Had the BLT with a side of fried zucchini - it was fast, fresh, and the servers were super fast and friendly.

author: Mo Jo
review_text: The service was great 👍 and the food was very satisfying and tasty.  Atmosphere was good but we sat in a booth in the corner which had worn out seats that felt lumpy. But overall, a good place to get a good meal. Orange juice is fresh squeezed!

author: Joel Keane
review_text:
We went for dinner while waiting for our laundry to dry.   The food was absolutely delicious and very well priced!

Some of the most friendly customer service we have experienced in the USA.  The 50's theme was very well done also.

Would most definitely return.

author: I'm a pisces and love food
review_text:
The 50's theme was fantastic. There is a car themed table, pictures of cars,and Elvis.
The chocolate chip pancakes were good
The severs were fast and kind. The prices are very good and low. The impression that I got was I would come back if I was in town. The oreo shake was big and good.

author: Ashley C
review_text:
Looking for a cool 50’s diner off the strip? Check out the Omelette House 50’s Diner on Desert Inn. Known as “the friendliest diner around.“

They have an awesome menu, the portions are huge, and they have some of the lowest prices we’ve seen in Vegas. Make sure to try their signature pumpkin nut bread and delicious spuds.

Got 10 bucks to spare? You can splurge to eat in style in their classic 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air.

author: Rosa Munoz
review_text: This place is amazing! We been coming here for the last 7 years. The food,service and the atmosphere never disappoints. I highly recommend this place🔥

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 5-Star Review – A Blast from the Past at 50’s Diner!

Stepping into 50’s Diner in Las Vegas is like taking a time machine straight back to the golden age of jukeboxes, chrome, and rock ’n roll. The vibe is spot-on vintage — black-and-white checkered floors, red leather booths, and walls lined with classic pin-ups and retro memorabilia. They even have a Chevy Bel Air booth — yeah, an actual car turned into a table. That’s how deep they go into the theme!

The service? Fast, friendly, and downright old-school in the best way. You’re treated like family the moment you walk in.

Now for the food — top notch. I had a hearty plate loaded with crispy chilaquiles, two perfectly runny sunny-side-up eggs, grilled steak, creamy refried beans, fresh avocado slices, and sour cream. Full flavor, no shortcuts.

And for the kiddo? Classic pancakes with butter melting just right, scrambled eggs, and sausage that was cooked to perfection. Clean plate = happy customer.

Whether you’re craving comfort food or just want a legit retro experience, 50’s Diner hits the mark. Nostalgia, great food, and better service — what more can you ask for?

Highly recommend. Will definitely be back!

author: jme sheppard
review_text: The Food was so good,  I got the number 13 omelet Large and the Large is a Large,  delicious and the service was very good....we got to see the king of kings lowriders there aswell......thanks again for the great start to our day.......

author: Aaron Brown
review_text:
This is my go to place for friendly people, great food, at a really good price. Your sweet tea mug will never be empty, your food will always be cooked the way you order, and the servers are some of the nicest people in Vegas.

03-16-25
I still stand by my original review.
My boys, daughter-in-law, and grandson flew in from Texas, so I reserved the Belaire for them.

The service, food, and atmosphere made it a great first breakfast in Vegas.

06-11-2025
Kick ass Club sandwich

10-2-25
Hours are now till 10pm. yes!

author: Candy Ramirez
review_text: First time going with my husband and it did not disappoint! I would always see the place but we finally made it today and it was worth every penny! Service was great everyone there working together in checking in and asking us if we needed anything. The food was done so quick and it was DELICIOUS!! 😋 The spuds were a 10/10!! Definitely will be recommending this place! I love the whole vibe of the place and music!

author: Lester Adea (punkmonkey92)
review_text: Food was good. Ordered the eggs Benedict and it hit the spot. Also has that nice 50's theme if youre into that.

author: Ayesha Connolly
review_text:
We’ve been to just about every diner in Las Vegas, and saying we’ve tried them all is barely scratching the surface. As true diner fans, we know a good one when we find it. This place is it.

Sure, it’s in a rougher part of town, but honestly, who cares when the food is this good? Everything they make here hits the spot. The omelettes are always cooked perfectly and packed with flavor. Their chicken-fried steak is comfort food at its finest. The cheeseburger is classic and satisfying. Don’t miss the chili either. It’s hearty and full of flavor. And for a sweet finish, you have to try the blueberry-filled French toast. It’s unreal.
Always check the board for their specials!

We keep coming back because it never disappoints. Friendly staff, great portions, and real-deal diner food. Highly recommend to anyone who loves diners as much as we do.

author: Nelly Torres
review_text: i never do reviews because I never do food delivery but I was sick yesterday so thought it was the easier thing to do. I was very upset yesterday with our food order and feel like they should at least hear the good and bad. I spent $50 for two breakfast meals first off the meal on the menu said 2 sausages or bacon.  We picked sausage and only got one sausage on each order. Our food arrived extremely cold and who ever prepped our order put all the condiments napkins and utensils at bottom of the bag and the boxes of food on top so of course the boxes flipped to the side. Due to not a flat surface of bottom of the bag. The French toasts were little, cold and not fluffy at all. The whole thing was a whole disappointment having to wait an hour, spending $50 and then having cold food and missing food.  We ate it because well I mean if you spend $50 you better eat it at that point but very dissatisfied. The dasher was very nice she was trying to hold the bag a certain way and once I grabbed it I noticed it was bagged incorrectly.

author: lisa murphy
review_text: Came here every day for a week it was so good. Great omelets. Awesome value for money. Cute diner.

author: Ricardo
review_text: Excellent food, fast service, but I find the place a bit expensive.

author: Sierra Phillips
review_text: Was so excited we found this place it was everything we wanted and more! Dennis was amazing and had the best customer service we have had our whole visit here in Vegas! The food was delicious and great prices! We also tried their tik tok coffee, it was the best and bigger than our heads! The vibe over all was exactly what we needed!

author: Sexy Eyez
review_text: Today November 22,2025 I went into this diner I have been into many of times before . There food and prices have always been reasonable . Placed my order over the phone to pick up was on the way to work and was on my way . I pulled into the parking lot to pick up my food and it was a ghost town that should have been my clue to get on .This place is one of those places you can never find a parking spot went in the lady told me the price and I almost fell out for what I usually order is $ 11.00 she told me $19.49 I  really just wanted to walk out I  paid and picked up the bag and the bag felt like a bag of paper how light it was. I get to work and open my bag and this is the worst $20.00 ever spent for food special them I  will not be back 2 scoops of eggs and a few potatoes is a dam shame I understand prices go up but this is really ridiculous I WILL NOT BE GOING BACK ..

author: David Stejkowski
review_text: Honestly, the food fell short today. Everything we ate was terribly over salted. Ironically, they included extra packets of salt to go with the salt that I think also consisted of some meat and potatoes. The service was fine the atmosphere was good. But I’m going to have  to drink about a gallon of water to flush out all the extra sodium.

author: Lauren Prado
review_text: Always a great experience. Loved the location on the Strip. We ate outside on the patio since it wasn't too hot. Place was packed but they move so fast you don't even feel the wait.

author: Mela M
review_text: I never mind a long line when it comes to waiting for food here because my food is usually hot. But that did not apply at this location. This was my first time here and definitely my last. I waited in the drive thru for 28 minutes and when got my order and bit into my burger it was absolutely cold!! I did not wait until I was home to eat. I started digging into my food immediately upon pulling out of the parking lot. This was super disappointing!! My pictures clearly show the melted cheese was nearly solid because the burger was now cooled. There is no reason for that. If the shopping center here wasn’t so chaotic I would have drove back, went inside, and asked for a refund. Eat at different location if you’re expecting hot food.

author: Twila Kawai
review_text: This location on Flamingo is the cleanest In-N-Out Burger I've been too. The staff was friendly. They stopped to ask if they could take away our trash. The food came out fast.

author: Mr Polo
review_text:
10/31/25
Casandra made my day. A beautiful 18 yr old employee who exchanged my fries to make them lighter and more tender.She’s the perfect customer charmer with a beautiful smile to Charm an older wizard like myself and make my strawberry shake sweeter!

I’ll be back ! This place also runs like a  Rolex Watch!  A clean as they go and stock up supplies and condiments gracefully and with ease . Thanks to management.

Sincerely M Polo!
6/30/25
Sebastian made my day, especially this wonderful location. From the moment I walked in, he informed me about additives that I asked about that you could put on fries and burgers at no extra charge. He was constantly busy cleaning everywhere from the floor to the windows and the doors. He also rang up my order on the register. I had a wonderful shake fries with chopped herbs on top and a mustard fried patty on my double burger with extra tomato lettuce. A wonderful experience with the wonderful guy who I know will be a huge success and all he does. Thank you in and out Management for having such a wonderful employee such as Sebastian. I’m looking forward to seeing him in the future.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++
10-16-2023
Again a  great 4x 4 burger and strawberry shake. Very quick service, clean rest rooms and a fast staff of 8 to 10 workers.
**********************************
In and out 9/22 8pm

The young lady at the counter was very professional and smiling. And my food came out quickly thank you for that.

Of course I had to order my 4 x 4 which the lady said they still had. I ordered it with extra tomatoes no pickles but it came with cheese that I didn’t order but I ate it anyway. It was fresh and delicious and the fries are pretty good as well.
The strawberry shake was delicious as well.

I was surprised they didn’t have any veteran discounts because all the other burger places I know do.

The front door does not have any auto handicap buttons to open the doors and although it’s wheelchair accessible but not handy. It’s a nice clean establishment.
Enjoy your food.

Be blessed and safe always.
Jesus cares say your prayers Amen

******************************
****New location. Sandhill at Flamingo.  Great 4x4 burger. Fresh & tender, moist and delicious.
Delayed Service with a smile but counter service seemed ignored  even though 5 employees like busy  bees. I had to call loudly across the counter and ask if they were taking orders while the cashier was packaging catsup.

Food was quickly served, clean rest rooms for male as female.  Very clean establishment. Great atmosphere .

author: Andy Bullard
review_text: You can count on consistency when you ho to an in-n-out burger place. One time I went and the drive through was a super long line, so I just went inside and the wait was not so long. The next time I saw the drive through was clear so I went through there. The service in both instances was the same, great. No differences in food quality or service. I will make it my choice when the need arises.

author: Miss Pink
review_text: I ordered the flying dutch man and received just meat and cheese with a sprinkle of lettuce on top. I even relayed that I wanted the double double with everything on it but with onion instead of a bun and received the wrong order anyway. Please train the employees in proper preparation or they need to admit they don't know what something is. Me and my friend were so excited to try them and we were so disappointed.The fries were also stale and hard.

author: Stuart Gibbel
review_text: For peeps from the east coast In-N-Out is a rare treat. Same great taste and prices as a regular in n out but in Vegas.  Very busy but  fantastic service.  If you stay at the Linq its only a few steps away.   A great burger and fantastic prices await you.

author: RG K
review_text: Great team & service. Everyone is sharp, attentive & Pleasent. Clean place. Burgers are nicely assembled beautifully.

author: Shawn “SinCity” Burke
review_text: Great crew, excellent service and always friendly! The burgers and fries are just what you’d expect from In N Out.

author: KRISDIAZ
review_text: I'm a fan of good burgers... and if you're looking for that, this is the best place. I also want to highlight the customer service provided by Gary, an older man with a great attitude toward children and young people, offering stickers and hats... thanks IN-N-OUT Burger...

author: Judy Trimarchi
review_text: This In n Out burger is next door to the regional headquarters so we expected it to be a great cafe.  The regular hamburgers were tasty with free extra toppings.  Not anything spectacular, but tasty.  The French fries were outstanding!   Service was fast despite it being very busy. The cafe was clean and bright.

author: Matt Begley
review_text: When I walked in the door, I was greeted by multiple of the friendly employees. They were a little bit busy, but my order came out fresh and then a timely fashion.  This is a good spot to go eat if you have a vehicle and can get away from the strip.

author: Christy Boiles
review_text: We travel full time around the US. Hardly EVER do we get the kind of service like we did here at a fast food place. Didn’t get the managers name but he obviously does a great job in hiring and training. Place was clean and everyone was so nice! I will add we are from TX so it’s all about Whataburger lol. This place has won me over! Even though my husband ordered it “doggy style” instead of “animal style “ 😂😂 🤦‍♀️

author: Filip Mizerski
review_text: First time on the west coast and all I can say is I loved the food. Although just a burger and fries, it was amazing. The service was great and really fast. The restaurant is clean and there was no issues with my order. Loved it

author: Jennifer Krueger
review_text: Did a takeout order on Veteran's Day. Staff was incredibly nice. I've dined at this location before, dine in and takeout. Always clean, friendly staff, who work well together. Food is hot fresh and delicious and very quick!

author: Billie Perrone
review_text: Great west coast spot. Always fresh ingredients and fast friendly service. Everyone gravitates to this place. Drive thru is always crowded. Love the huge safety pins on their uniforms! I'd hate to keep those white uniforms clean!!!

author: Anthony McCool
review_text:
I do like this place. No chicken sandwich only burgers? Well that will limit my visits as my wife doesn't eat beef. Great service!!!
See our YouTube channel Coolest Life.

author: Karla Martinez
review_text: This is a Classic!! You can’t t leave Vegas without trying it at least once! This burgers were Fresh, Hot and Made to Order. It’s a Favorite among the Locals! We had some simple cheese burgers 🍔 for our picky eaters… That were more Out than In 😆 In the City that Never Sleeps… They had other plans… Definitely Check it out!

author: Dr. Ravikiran Barigala
review_text: Stepping into in-n-out felt like walking into a time capsule. The burger was objectively the best burger I've ever had. There was a nice employee who gave my kids the in-n-out hats and some stickers, making them really happy. It was a great experience on the whole.

author: Sabrina A.
review_text: VISITED DRIVE THRU AROUND 1230PM. NO ONE IN DRIVE THRU. WAS ASKED TO PULL AROUND FRONT TO WAIT. ORDERED CHICKEN SUPREME MUNCHIE MEAL. PRESENTATION OF SANDWHICH WAS BEAUTIFUL BUT MY BREAD WAS HARD AND FRIES WERE NOT HOT. HAVING TO PARK, I WOULD EXPECT HOT AND FRESH. THE ICE WAS MELTED IN MY FRESH BREWED ICE TEA WHEN I RECEIVED. GOOD NEWs, I RECEIVED MY JIBBI!❤️

author: John Bevis
review_text: Have been here several times and you are lucky if the order is right. Don’t even bother asking for a sauce or napkins. Just got a medium fries and the container is maybe 1/3 full. Been here multiple times and lucky if my order is right, let alone anything else.

author: Shallyce
review_text: January 4th 2026 Juan was the manager and he was snappy and mean, not helpful I called corporate on him to give him more training..don't go here if you want to enjoy your day ..there's another Jack in the box 2 miles down  Wendy works there ..she admits Juan is a grumpy man! With food that cheap and greasy at least the customer service should good..but it wasnt!

author: Jasmere Savage
review_text:
My go to place for ice coffee and its affordable..The meals are good here. Nice size portions
I normal get spicy chicken or crispy chicken.  I also like the Nashville hot mozzarella sticks

author: Parker:xgps
review_text: good service, burger more like beef jerky.  can't feel spending  more if value buys arent. waiting in front of the store for not fresh hurts even worse.

author: lillian gonzales
review_text:
WORST Fast Food location I've been to in a long time 🤢.. I'm the only one in the front area & I end up waiting 3-4 minutes for someone to take my order🤔 .. the inside is filthy/ the outside is disgusting 😲 😠
I tried to order tacos' (only to be told they didn't have tacos).. I'm sorry isn't that what Jack in the box is famous for?? It's okay I have a choice of super gigantic tacos or a bunch of little baby tacos..
SAVE YOUR MONEY!! SAVE YOUR TIME!! AND SAVE YOUR STOMACH!! 🤢

author: Ernest Energy
review_text: Very rude and slow service. The drive-thru is advertised as 24/7, but I was told they close at 4am even though I ordered before that. I had a card issue and the employee told me to drive around. When I came back, I was told the drawer was closed and they couldn’t take my order. Extremely poor customer service and a huge waste of time.

author: Richard McGar
review_text: I work till late night early morning and it can be 2am 3am or 4am and drive through always says the same thing, we are sorry our systems are rebooting.  Too many times leads me to think thats code for we dont want to work

author: Marisol Peña
review_text: Tasty meals , HONEST and kind staff. We lost  a bag with our passports and cash which was returned with everything inside!!!! We really want to thank all the staff and wish them the best luck!!😊

author: Isabelle Shavlik
review_text: Went through the drive thru. We waited 10 minutes. My husband went in and they weren't even making our order. We showed them our receipt so then we had to wait for them to make it ..

author: Becky
review_text: My experience was horrible so much so I had to call corporate because I just couldn't let go how dissatisfied I was with my interaction with the general manager. I didn't want the young man to lose his job I'm sure he has a family to support but I wanted to make a point that in his position he should treat people with respect and with some common courtesy. I just want him to stop and not treat people the way he did my husband and I .

author: Jenifer Jolley-JJ-
review_text: Live this jack in the box- great work to the swing shift & mainly graveyard crew!

author: Carolina Aguilar
review_text: On Tuesday at aroud 12:20am past  by the drive thru and got a combo 13  a home style ranch  and two tacos when I stared eat the sandwich was hard then I notice the the chicken sandwich was raw  I went back to telling them and the lady on the drive thru  didn't even apologized . She asked my if I wanted more food  and i said  not she gave me a refund  for the sandwich  .not great service at all

author: Isawasquirrel Ilikepiekinda
review_text: They always park me when I go ...what's the point of going  thru the DRIVE - THRU if I'm just going to be parked?

author: Matthew Thomas
review_text: Most everything here is ok.  One concern is this.. at the drive through window, the metal frame at the window is covered in LAYERS of dust.  Looks awful!

author: Melina Solorio
review_text: I come here almost all the time, and every time I do they forget something. I'm only leaving a review this time because whoever was going my order has me repeat myself 3 times and when finally getting to the window, she seemed pretty high and still forgot something. It's getting irritating, do better. **Had to edit my review because they overcooked the chicken on the sandwich and it was inedible.

author: orion sanchez
review_text: All good, except it is no 24hrs this is the third time i pass by around 4am, and im greeted with "unfortunately we are not serving any orders right now, please publish the right hours for this venue, thanks.

author: Sandi Perry
review_text: They made me and 2 cars in front of me pull to the front after we ordered and paid.  I waited for 15 minutes before I gave up and walked into the place and asked where my food was.It still wasn't ready.   I finally got it and left.  The 2 cars in front of me were still waiting.  I only ordered 2 tacos and French fries.  How long should that take!!!

author: MARKROBERT WRONGWAY MURPHY SR
review_text: 1st off. Onions are the cheepest..of all overhead...portions  controlled. When I ask for Xtra Onions  I measured 1/4 sliced in 1//2 inch slivers..& ure jr bacon  was thinner then ah white castle...DO YOU KNOW  15$

author: Conception Ordunez
review_text:
I just drove thru. My food was good.
The workers were very nice .
The lemonade with the popping balls sucked, but i don't blame noone for that ..lol.
Besides that my food was good n the customer service was good.

author: Estrella Rodriguez
review_text:
An exceptional dining experience from start to finish. This all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant truly sets the standard for quality, offering some of the freshest and best sushi in town. Each dish was beautifully prepared, impeccably fresh, and consistently delicious.
The service was equally outstanding. My waitress, Brenda, provided above-and-beyond hospitality—attentive, warm, and genuinely welcoming throughout the entire meal. Her professionalism elevated the experience and made me feel truly valued as a guest.
The restaurant itself was immaculate, with a clean, inviting atmosphere and a pleasant, fresh scent that immediately stood out. To top it all off, the pricing was phenomenal—surprisingly affordable and easily among the best values in town for the quality offered.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking exceptional sushi, outstanding service, and unbeatable value.

author: Joshua Moses
review_text: I've been a few times and I have Amazing experience every time. The service is amazing. The servers are provided an awesome level of service. The ambiance is very chill with a variety of good music playing. All of the food I've tried is delicious from  the sushi, steamed snow crab legs, to the seafood boil, and the price for all you can eat Crab Leg, and Seafood Bowl along with the Sushi is for an unbeatable $45.95. I highly recommend this place to everyone I come across whether it be friends or family. This place is in my top 3 favorite places to eat in town.

author: Danny Graffice
review_text: So, the food itself was not bad I don't do sushi witch they have a lot of. It was everything else that earned a 3 star rating. They had everybody creamed into 1 side of the restaurant. The wait staff was scrambling to stay caught up,to the point that I had 2 dishes dropped on my placement. The entire team seemed very unorganized,and I was still charged full price. I don't think between the 2 of us we are 80$ worth of food. Needless to say, probably won't be returning anytime soon.ps there was no wait when we arrived,but when we left they were telling people 20-30 minutes, while still having 1 hole side of the restaurant unused.

author: Joycelyn Pangilinan
review_text:
EXCELLENT: customer service, food, ambiance.
Only $24.99 lunch. Definitely recommend and will visit again.  One and only thing that made us sad, ONLY ONE PIECE OF DESSERT IS ALLOWED.

author: Victor Ramirez Romero
review_text: Joe is an amazing server. My wife and I used to come here all the time, and although we had to stop for a bit due to traveling, it was great to come back and see that he had become a manager or lead. He truly deserves it. His service has always been outstanding, and it clearly shows why he earned the promotion.

author: Food Soul
review_text: The food are totally really great here but you have to wait a little bit for the service. Maybe, it's just busy and they have to take care all costumers. It's all you can eat but you have to order everything from the staffs. The crab legs were a little salty for us. But all the sushi and Japanese food were delicious. Also, all deep fried food was amazing. They also gave us plastic gloves to eat crab legs.

author: Mikki McGehee
review_text: My daughter and I love sushi and have been to several places in Las Vegas but this is by far our favorite. The sushi is always fresh and delicious. Something I also love is that there is so much variety on the menu, so it’s perfect if you have people who don’t like sushi. The service and staff are exceptional and we always feel so welcomed. The prices for take out can’t be beat!

author: Alexander Pasay
review_text:
My wife and I had a wonderful  time here. Great service.  Amazing atmosphere.  And the food was so delicious.  Will definitely come again with the whole family.

Came back the 2nd time and brought my daughter. She loves this place so much. Highly recommend  if you like seafood and sushi.

author: Rob Gonzalez
review_text: The Food was great and or server Jacqueline was very friendly and sweetheart offered substitution on some of the sushi cause I was allergic to salmon and avocado. Thank you for such great service. The food tasted great and came to the table quick I'll definitely be back

author: GirlgeniusNYC
review_text:
Excellent!
The avocado salad is great! The sushi is delicious! The affogado dessert was awesome! (Small but mighty -- perfect!)
The menu is very clear and easy to understand. I suggest ordering only one or two dishes at a time, you need it eat it ALL. You can order as often as you like. Excellent friendly service!
I will be back!
*** You have 90 minutes to enjoy the ALL You Can Eat ***

author: Kat Jane Thirsty
review_text: I've been here once before so I suggested to my friends for us to come here for lunch. They almost suggested somewhere else because the reviews were all over the place. I insisted that the last time I was here, I really enjoyed the food. So they took my word for it and ended up loving it! Everything was fresh and tasty. The servers/ staff were so friendly and attentive. My friends are coming back with their kids. I'm glad I introduced them to a new spot for them to enjoy.

author: Roxana Gonzalez
review_text: Lots of options, everything is fresh and delicious! Love their all you can eat options.

author: Bill Munger
review_text: Random Google find. Amazing food and great value. The waitress walked us through the menu and how the ALL YOU CAN EAT worked. Left stuffed and happy. FatKid friendly for sure.

author: Traveling Kupo
review_text: Great great AYCE. I got 3 of the specials which two of them were the ones that offer a cloister, jumbo shrimp, & oysters. The other was the cajun style which was really really good & not that spicy at all. Sushi was also great sushi over rice ratio is an 8 out of 10. Which is really good.  This is kot your typical AYCE where the sushi is sitting out. You order it and then they make it as you keep ordering. Well worth it, service is great. Large parking, wheelchair access. Great price cheaper on weekday, but is a bit far from the strip. So worth the drive. I will be returning again & again when I am in that side of town.

author: Dj Gillespie
review_text: Sat there for over 2 hours and sushi didn't show up. The people without a clip board won't even talk to you. Waiter and manager did make an effort to make it right,  but still. Waiting 2 hours for your main meal is a bit much even if you get a 10% discount. At $40 a person...was a bit disappointed. Food was great when they finally brought it out.

author: Gary Bressler
review_text: AYCE is opening soon on Ft Apache in Spring Valley right by our house so we drove to Henderson to check it out and everything was great.

author: John Vaisa
review_text: I’ve been coming here since this AYCE first opened. Sadly, I have to say, with a heavy heart, that the restaurant has gone downhill in customer service. You’re given 90 minutes to eat, but when you wait over 45 minutes just for a server to come by and take your order, that time is wasted. On top of that, when the food finally arrived, it wasn’t even the correct order. This was during dinner on a Saturday, which made the experience even more disappointing.

author: Stephen Black
review_text: Luis was our server and he was awesome explained everything and took care of us. The food is awesome and is served fast! The ambiance is nice and they were playing best of the 80s music. Very clean and has there A rating posted clearly. And I have been to many AYCE sushi restaurants and this one is a step above the rest. And there are many options for someone who does not like fish. So weather you like fish or not it will be your fault if you leave hungry. Thanks Luis

author: Miss Bella
review_text:
Open daily and all options are available from open to close.

Parking is available but limited.

The atmosphere is Casual.

Staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive.

The menu is listed on both front and back.

Pricing for the food is reasonably priced, the all you can eat Crab Boil option is $45.95 which also includes everything on the menu except the items that are listed within the AYCE Premium Option $35.95.  Price for kids (ages 4-9) is $14.95.  Please refer to the picture of the menu that I have included.

There is a 90 minute limit on dining.

Enjoyed the Crab Boil, Boston Roll (Cooked Sushi), Steak and Shrimp teriyaki skewers, and of course the Crab legs with butter.

Definitely a restaurant I will be returning to regularly.

author: Broderick Tolbert
review_text: Maaaaaaaan!!!!! This place is amazing! The food is second to none but, the drinks are to GOOD-to-be-true! The owner puts his own swing on the cocktails. I recommend The Mule, Apple Sake(comes in a nice bottle) and the Berry Citrus Sangria. This place does not disappoint!

author: Pat L.
review_text: Excellent place. The entertainmen along with a small cozy dance floor is lots of fun. It'll probably become a regular.

author: Jeremy Guzman
review_text:
UPDATE: After many years is been since we have been here, we are not disappointed with the food or service. I had the fish special and wife had the hamburger as pictured. It was very good. Prices are reasonable, but no higher than most places these days. I still recommend and will be back. 👍👍😃

I've been coming to Inchabods for a few times now. And every time I come I love the food. It's fresh daily and the soups are good too. The wait staff is good too. I'm only speaking of the table side. But will keep coming back. :-) It's worth trying.

author: Katie Maus (KAT)
review_text:
A truly wonderful place where you can order the same types of meals that your Mother or Grandmother's house used to make.
There are 2 sections, smoking & non smoking. The Live 🎷 music is sensational. Sometimes jazz, sometimes country, 🎹and they have a crowd that comes for it, too.
And did I mention, FINALLY priced low and fair, as it should to be. Drinks are righteous 🥃🍸Vintage Vegas at it's absolute BEST✨️

author: Monique Quiros
review_text:
I stumbled upon this hidden gem while waiting for my vehicle windows to be tinted, and I’m so glad I did! This local restaurant and bar has a fantastic atmosphere with a Sleepy Hollow theme that adds a unique charm to the experience.

The bar area offers plenty of seating options, and they have live music every evening, with karaoke kicking off every Saturday at 11 PM and going strong until 2 or 3 AM. It’s a perfect spot for a late-night hangout.

What’s even better is their separate family-friendly dining area, so kids are more than welcome. Dinner is served all day, and I couldn’t resist trying their steak with breakfast potatoes and eggs—absolutely phenomenal!

The food quality, paired with the ambiance, makes it a place I can't wait to return to.

Service is pretty good as you’re promptly attended to, regardless of where you seat yourself and whether there was anyone at the front when you walked in.

Ample parking that is free and directly in front of the lounge is available it is nestled in the complex next to the planet fitness.

Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area!

author: Dan Buckle
review_text: I had seen outside and thought it was just another Bar/Casino. But OMG this is Vegas nostalgia! The food is amazing, service is great. Went on Sinatra Saturday and the performer was fantastic, people were dancing - a perfect night out!

author: mackfrack
review_text: One of my absolute favorite places to spend an evening in Las Vegas. There’s live music every night, and our favorite group to watch is always The Ambassadors. They took a few special music requests and made our evening. We’ve had the same waiter several times, and the service is phenomenal. Definitely a budget friendly option for dinner and a show off the strip!

author: christopher varner
review_text: Was there for dinner very early, with my inlaws, so only saw the early bird crowd. I had the haddock which was surprisingly good. It has an old Vegas vibe, complete with a large chandelier over the baby grand. The restaurant side is non-smoking. Would definitely go back.

author: Lynn Surnock
review_text: We went at lunchtime and it was lovely. A relaxing and delicious meal. Service was exceptional. The chandelier was a real surprise. I would like to go back in the evening for rat pack type music.

author: TDC
review_text:
This is an unassuming old school Vegas spot.  There's a smoke-fee restaurant section and a bar/lounge section with live music.  The clientele is older.  This is not the Instagram crowd, and I say that in a good way.

They have the best prime rib in town.  Tender, juicy, well seasoned and perfectly prepared.  My picture doesn't do it justice.  The other items on the menu are generally ok.

The customer service is hit or miss.

The owner doesn't have the best reputation for different reasons.

author: Elaine DeFelice
review_text: This restaurant has wholesome, delicious food.  I recently had the haddock which was so wonderfully cooked and they gave me enough for two people. This place is sort of vintage Vegas. The owner has a old car collection and he usually is displaying one at the top of the parking lot when you go there try this, you’ll like it. It’s also a great place to have a good conversation with friends or go on a date.Enjoy!

author: Kim Reale Artist
review_text: Ichabod’s is wonderful old school Las Vegas. The food is terrific. The service is superior and it’s got a very cozy atmosphere that you don’t find and a lot of the newer restaurants these days. Five stars all the way! I recommend it very highly.

author: Wade Marshall
review_text: I just want to thank you to Ichabobs  for a wonderful Thanksgiving dinner. The atmosphere was outstanding. The customer service was even better. My experience there was 100% delightful Thank you Ichabobs .

author: Danielle M Liquori
review_text: I’ve never heard of this place and I went there for a party. It was a pretty good party and the people I New had a party in the dining room and they accommodated and set a really large table for them. I enjoyed my euro salad, and I had a iced tea. All the other dishes looked really good too.

author: Matt Krick
review_text: Great servers at this lounge. Great pasta but the steak was so so. The chocolate bomb cake was amazing! Very affordable prices!

author: Zelilah Perez
review_text: We had such a great time last night! The service was excellent, and the food was even better! My steak was cooked to perfection, and you can never go wrong with a baked potato. The atmosphere was Old School Vegas with a beautiful baby grand piano in the dining area.  They even had a band in the bar area. Highly recommend!

author: CedarwoodPhotos
review_text: We had a great time in the lounge. Quick bite to eat and then sang along with the piano man. Neal was fun and took requests. I would come back just for the piano bar.

author: Shelby Schwilke
review_text: This is one of those places where you walk in and you just know that you're comfortable there. The food is awesome and the services as well. For the couple of times I have been there the machines have not been very nice to me though. That is no fault of ichabods though. That's why they call it gambling.

author: James
review_text: I would like to say this is an amazing establishment. They have amazing food. Amazing customer service the owner keeps this place looking amazing. You can go here to have dinner or have a good time. Live music.

author: E L
review_text: Old school Vegas spot with great food and service. I enjoy that they have a seperate enclosed dining area away from the gaming and smoking. Been coming here for years with family and friends and we've never been disappointed.

author: Richard Carrillo
review_text:
So I usually stick to the restaurant side of Ichabods but this time I opted for the lounge since I wanted to play a little video poker. Glad I did! They had my go-to drink: a Heineken 0.0%.

I asked for a menu and went straight for my comfort food—the Meatloaf with a baked potato and steamed broccoli. A classic, and reasonably priced (especially in today’s economy).

Service was great—Steph behind the bar was friendly and welcoming, and Kelly, my server, was attentive and made sure to time my meal just the way I like it. I asked to finish my salad before the main course came out, and she made it happen.

By the time I was done eating… let’s just say I proudly reestablished myself as a member of the Clean Plate Club!

As for the video poker… it wasn’t exactly my lucky day, but hey—that’s the game. Win some, lose some.

If you’re in the area, definitely stop by. The place has that classic Old Vegas vibe that’s getting harder to find these days.

author: Marina
review_text: My husband and I have been here twice now and we will be back again. The food is to die for!!! We were the only ones who were eating when we arrived but we did go at an odd lunch time so we had the whole place to ourselves. I think the husband-wife owner team served us and they were very kind and also accommodating. I ordered a tea, shish kabob and then we ordered the saffron pistachio ice cream. The food is so fresh and flavored perfectly. The meat was tender and the veggies were grilled to perfection. My tea was delicious and fresh and the best part was the ice cream. I’ve never had saffron ice cream before but it’s now my favorite. We love the ambiance here. There is a stage where I imagine is live music but while we were there, Arabic music was playing and I loved listening to it. Can’t wait to come back. Oh yeah, the booths were very spacious and comfortable and the serving size for the price is worth it.

author: Juvanny Joseph
review_text:
We had the Kabab Koobideh (which is ground beef kabob skewers, rice, and grilled tomatoes) and the beef soltani (which is one ground beef skewer and one flat filet mignon/tenderloin piece with rice and grilled tomatoes).

Everything was delectable. The beef was seasoned to perfection and cooked perfectly. Every bite was juicy and bursting with flavor. It’s clear that they use quality meat. I can’t speak on the chicken kabobs but if their beef kabobs are any indication, the chicken should be just as good. The rice was also cooked perfectly. At a lot of Persian restaurants I’ve been to, the rice is usually undercooked or lacking in flavor and the meat is either too dry or lacks the appropriate seasoning.  But this place does both right. They also serve black tea after a meal if you ask.

The service is friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is also a nice place to bring family or friends to. It would also work well for a small event (80-100 people).

If you’re looking for high quality, delicious Persian food, I strongly recommend Soroush.

author: Dio Fitzgerald
review_text: Food and Music was awesome!!! I had the Chicken Kabob and it was the best chicken kabob I’ve eaten! And the waiters are very nice and friendly! Don’t miss out on amazing Persian food so please eat here.

author: Kinney
review_text: Joojeh (chicken breast) and Koobideh (beef) charcoal grilled! Delicious fluffy basmati rice. Grilled tomatoes. Authentic. Spiced perfectly! You will love it! Clean and bright restaurant, inviting hosts. Very enjoyable dining experience.

author: Rmsadeq
review_text:
It was great 😍🤩Iranian authentic food with the best koobideh kebab and excellent rice.
Definitely give it a try.
The staff were also wonderful and very kind.

author: Sammy Sage
review_text:
Expectations were absolutely met and exceeded. From the moment we arrived, the service was fabulous—warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. The staff made us feel taken care of without being overbearing, which really set the tone for a great experience.
The food came out piping hot and was beyond tasty. Every bite was full of rich, authentic flavor, clearly made with high-quality ingredients and attention to detail. Portions were generous, presentation was beautiful, and everything tasted fresh and perfectly seasoned.
You can tell this place takes pride in both their cuisine and their hospitality. It’s the kind of restaurant that makes you want to come back again and again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for amazing food and outstanding service!

author: Arvin Rahmatian
review_text: Persian here, food was amazing with PLENTY of options. We got the family platter and it was at a great price and plenty. I cannot stress how AMAZING our waiters were, they were nice and very funny. One of them even were so nice they called someone famous who I like, I didn’t even ask them or anything. They just were so nice because they realized that I liked the person, but I didn’t even say anything. This completely made my day. He even told my family amazing stories.

author: Julie Ershadi
review_text: Unfortunately the food was really bad. The service was very friendly and attentive. But the skirt steak in the beef soltani was not browned and tasted very old, like one day away from going bad. The ghormeh sabzi was black(?!) and not very flavorful, the meat in both khoreshes was totally dry and flavorless, like cubes of cardboard. Everything was really oily and salty. The kashke bademjan tasted really off, I don't even know what was going on there. Even the lavash sucked. :\

author: Ehsan Asadi
review_text: The food was generally okay. The portion was smaller than I expected. The chicken wasn't cooked well though. The kobideh was better than the chicken. The service was not professional. They had difficulty managing 5 tables.

author: Mory Rabi
review_text:
The food was absolutely delicious and tasted very authentic. The kebab koobideh and ground chicken were perfectly seasoned and juicy, and the saffron rice was fluffy and fragrant.

The atmosphere was warm, clean, and welcoming, and the staff were extremely friendly and attentive.
Higher recommended.

author: David DiVito
review_text:
Me and my wife stopped in starving for a late lunch and had no idea what to expect. We love trying new places, and Soroush Mediterranean Cuisine did not disappoint! The atmosphere is warm and beautifully decorated.

I ordered a barg kabob, and honestly, I wanted to lick the plate clean. The portion was generous, the food fresh, and hours later I was still full and satisfied. We also tried the pistachio and saffron ice cream—absolutely excellent and unlike anything I’ve ever had before.

Thank you to Soroush for a wonderful dining experience. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Lucia Spill
review_text: Delicious homemade Persian food !! Authentic and tasty. Stumbled across this place and happy I walked in. Owner and staff are lovely. Highly recommend will be coming back soon.

author: Beyzaa Osmani
review_text: I have tried many different Persian and Mediterranean cuisines, but this one stands out at the top. The food is absolutely delicious and enjoyable. The staff members are friendly and attentive. I loved everything about the experience and will definitely return. I highly recommend it 😃

author: Staci Crouch
review_text: The best Persian food in Vegas! The food is so good and the owner is the sweetest. It's worth going off the strip for. Just a 15 min cab and you'll get one of the best meals! My favorite is the Barg with rice. So tasty!

author: Bradford Webster
review_text: What a hidden gem Saroush is! We got the filet and the chicken shawarma and the hummus and eggplant and everything was amazing! They have room for big parties and can have a full bar if you need it. We got to meet the owners and they were lovely, we will definitely be back soon, thank you for your hospitality!

author: D J
review_text: The food was average. It didn't have a lot of flavor. The grape leaves were the best item for the taste that we ordered. The beef kabob wasn't char grilled which made a difference in the taste I am used to getting. While eating the heating ventilation system kicked on and was horribly loud. We left early because of the loud noise. You couldn't hear the other person talk. I expected a lot more for the price point of the dinner. We did not get any free soup as others outlined in their reviews. We asked for a glass of water and was told we would be dissatisfied with the tap water and to order the bottle of water for $2. Somehow I don't think they will be in business for long. I won't be returning soon.

author: Mishary Almutairi
review_text: Amazing experience overall. The lamb shank was outstanding—tender, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the meal. I genuinely loved it and would definitely order it again.

author: Aryan Shah
review_text: Great food and great service. The food was so good I wanted to keep eating but had no space left. Cant believe this place isn’t more popular. I must suggest the chicken kabab

author: Seth Coldren
review_text:
The food, service, hospitality, and ambiance was incredible. We arrived at lunch time with a large party of 11 people. They took our group in and treated us like family! They moved tables around so we could all sit together, and prepared one of the most delicious family style meals we’ve ever had.

We will definitely be back and look forward to next time!

author: Kach Opinion
review_text: Was craving Mediterranean food and came across this place on a whim. The koobideh is absolutely delicious!!! The plate was enough for 2 people to share. Will definitely be back :)

author: Fay M
review_text: All you can eat sushi for 90 minutes for $31 ($18 for kids 5-9). They have a lot of items on their menu including ramen, salads, skewers and desserts. We got there late so I chose to just à la carte a couple of items but next time I'll definitely do the all you can eat option.

author: Jay Kim
review_text:
Got there super as they opened and our waitress was really nice. Ordered the dinner version of the ayce for two.

Food was good and I enjoyed it for an ayce spot. I loved that my rolls were not mostly rice ... but the fish slices were quite thin for my liking so it was a borderline wash for me.

As I mentioned that my waitress was super nice and was very attentive, however, some of my orders were never fulfilled (but  I did not mention this to my waitress).
Service would have been a 5 out of 5 but since several dishes I ordered were unaccounted for and still a little hungry at the end of my 90 mins,tis why I have the service a 4 out of 5.
Taste wise, I would give this spot a 3 out of 5 (as a sushi snob) but accounting for value, how quick my food came out, and overall the service with a beautiful smile, I gave it a 4.

Would I come back? I would probably revisit this spot but with less expectations.

Our total with drinks came out to be roughly $115 ish and left a $20+ tip.

author: I. Molnar
review_text:
Great selection of sushi for dinner or lunch AYCE! My favorites are baked muscles and nigiri salmon egg, also the hand rolls are pretty good.
Fresh fish, well made.
For the price you get top for your dollar, so dont expect some royalty ikra and real lobster, but there wont be any shortages of goods...
Mochi mango for dessert was delicious and just scratched the right spot.

Place is clean and well designed.

Would definitely come back!!

Update: I did come back and ordered the Gigi, No Name, and Flamingo. Reason is, Ive seen you can order them only once.
Absolutely delicious sushi rolls! A MUST TRY!
Now I know what Im ordering until I get tired of it :D

author: Cheshire Cat
review_text: Wow what an amazing sushi place....absolutely delicious and affordable. Wonderful experience with José and the entire staff. Chill atmosphere, and they also habe great wine, sake and beer. Highly recommend!

author: Amanda Taylor
review_text: Omg! The sushi was beyond what I thought it was. Sake options were fruitful and my friend and I could not get enough of the one fish! Must try! Service was accommodating and atmosphere with music was catchy.

author: Kelvie Malia
review_text:
Ono Sushi was… semi-licious. Let’s just say the food was decent—not bad, but certainly not the highest quality or freshest grade sushi I’ve ever had. The flavors were okay, but nothing stood out as exceptional or memorable. If you’re looking for sushi that wows you, this might not be the place.
What really tipped the experience downhill, though, was the bathroom situation. Imagine this: no toilet paper, no paper towels, and not even a sign of an attempt to fix it quickly. I flagged this issue to the servers, but nothing was done until another customer also complained after going to the bathroom. Mind you, the restaurant wasn’t even a third full, so they had more than enough time to address the issue promptly. It’s disappointing when basic things like cleanliness and customer care are overlooked, especially when the restaurant wasn’t busy. While the food was passable, the lack of attention to something as essential as stocking the restroom left a bad taste in my mouth.

author: leonel renteria
review_text: Place was off the charts amazing. One server and runner for about 9-10 tables. The sushi chefs and serving staff did amazing tonight. I didn't get their names but visited on Sat December 20th at about 5pm for dinner service! Never waited very long for anything and the one server and runner did amazing with as many tables that they had. Regret not taking any photos!

author: AndreaKiana OK
review_text: Thank you Wendy and Jackie! They were absolutely amazing servers! Food was great as always. I Ordered the dragon sushi roll and jackpot sushi roll.

author: Meia Ford
review_text: Ono Sushi was definitely ONO!!! They really live up to their name. We just had our Reception dinner there and the service Bell and Wendy put down was on point❣️❣️They service was fast, clean and friendly. FOOD was delicious 😋 😍, especially for the price! 🍣🍢🍤🍥We are putting it on our list of regular spots!! Go Check em out...

author: Angelica Moore
review_text: Best sushi spot. So close to the stip.  Sushi so fresh and lots of flavors. We had a great time. Nice and cozy inside. Miss Suzette had the best recommendations and her playlist was on point. It’s super cute inside. Lastly desert was amazing. We came twice in a row!!!

author: Joel Headley
review_text:
Update: another visit to Vegas with another great visit to Ono. There are plenty of other all you can eat places, but I'd be worried we would have said, Oh no, had we visited there.

White the rules are still listed in the menu, the waiter seems eager to make us happy rather than stick to the letter of the law.

I had the deep fried rice which had spicy tuna and is sauced to finish my meal. Great easy to end it.
_________________
Great sushi in Vegas? Ono Sushi has shown it's possible. If you eat like I do, the lunch all-you-can-eat sushi is a great deal. All sushi and food is still prepared each order and comes out looking, and ultimately tasting great.

There's a 90 minute limit on the meal, and you get charged for leftovers if you can't eat what is ordered, but loosen the belt and get as much as you can.

author: Mika'ele Keni'
review_text:
Ono Sushi is a solid AYCE spot; Southeast of the Strip, about a fifteen minute drive. I came here for a quick solo lunch, was the first one to arrive and get seated when it opened. A few other patrons started trickling in. All of them looked like local professionals on their respective lunch breaks. I don't think there were any tourists. Medium size venue with a decent amount of seating with plenty of parking available in the plaza. I didn't realize I've actually been here before...forgot to write a review. The menu has changed a bit. I don't see s few item I got the last time I was here.

Looks like they were minimally staffed. There was a lady running the front, taking orders a cleaning tables...superstar efficiency kind of stuff. I only saw one chef making all the sushi and I heard there were another one or two people in the back. Everything came out in a timely manor, good presentation and food was good. No issues! I was impressed...

#AYCE:
~ Idako Karaage (Baby Octopus) - 3.5/5
~ Geso Karaage (Squid Legs) - 3.5/5
~ Pork Belly - 5/5
~ Sashimi Appetizer (Chef Choice) - 4/5
~ Oyster - 4/5
~ Poke Tacos - 4/5
~ Kaki Fry (Fried Oyster) - 4/5
~ Shrimp Skewer - 4/5
~ Salmon Belly  - 4/5
~ Ocean Trout - 4/5
~ Amaebi - 4/5
~ Uni - 4/5
~ Unagi - 4/5
~ Nigiri - 4/5
- Ikura - 4/5
- Ono - 4/5
- Red Snapper - 4/5
~ Lychee sorbet - 4/5

I noticed some this that are no longer on the menu:
Previous visit: (2019)
~ Seasoned Brussle Sprouts - 4/5
~ Green Tea Pannacotta - 4/5
~ Red Bean Ice Cream - 4/5

This place definitely has a more local vibe to it.
No issues coming back...

author: Hannah Swann
review_text: Amazing sushi! Every roll was delicious and no wasting any sushi because it's all so good you cant resist eating it.  Destiny and Bella gave us such great service which made the whole experience that much better.  This is our new go to AYCE Sushi 🍣

author: Lanxin Shen (Ada)
review_text:
Food is good and they got many interesting items. A lot of non-rice options :)
And $30 for AYCE

author: Angelo Cantrell
review_text: Great customer service. Welcoming and heart warming. Clean and nice smelling. And they were friendly. The type of restaurant that has a good staff. I definitely appreciated the customer service. A great place!

author: Jacob Ekegren
review_text: Price is great. Went out for a good time.  Ordered a bunch of food and the server was great.  She was by herself, but did an amazing job.

author: A Day with Melo Melo
review_text: I’ve been here not once but many times. I loved the service and food! Reasonable prices. Wendy our server is very nice and professional. Thanks for outstanding customer service!

author: Cynthia Spenard
review_text:
We sat at the bar, our server Jese and team had our drinks in before we knew it we had food sitting in front of us hot and ready!!!
Thank you for a tasty evening...

author: Brian Kwok
review_text: Great place for Japanese food in Las Vegas.  Very reasonable price with quality food.  Fish is fresh, and many items are for choice. But tempura is not that great.

author: Mark Kunie
review_text: Great staff. Everything was fresh and perfect quality. Monkeys dream is a must. PaDak chicken also.

author: Iveta Petelova
review_text:
To be honest Roberto’s is so much better; I got a burrito asada; the meat was not seasoned and sometimes some beef has this..very unfavorable old fatty like taste -that is just not a good taste . I asked for sour cream (in hopes u can kill the beef flavor and eat the rest) that’s $3 but no one tells you it’s extra; I had a smoothie - not home made; rather an ice packed with cool air taste.. service charge for credit card is another $1; tip is automatically added for parties. The “regular” burrito and soft drink ran me $34 and for $24 the next day I went to AYCE sushi/ Asian food
I did enjoy the authentic items as decor - and I always try to find something good in any situation so here - enjoy the atmosphere :)

author: W M
review_text: Food was great. Prices were reasonable especially compared to the outrageous strip restaurants. We ended up here based on tik tok reviews of the place and glad we came. The atmosphere is cute, very authentic Mexican vibe. Sometimes places are social media picture worthy but the food doesn't match. This place was good. We are used to our LA Mexican spots so we can be picky 😂. Check this place out, definitely worth a visit. Staff was very friendly.

author: Evelyn Cota
review_text: This place is stunning! The staff is fun and playful. The food is delicious! Our waiter had great suggestions for us. They were very attentive to our table. The food marked labeled as "spicy" is moderately spicy but nothing overwhelming. The portions are sizeable. If you're looking for authentic Mexican food, this is a great choice.

author: Thelma Ortiz
review_text:
We recently ate there for my daughter’s wedding. Thalia and Mr. Velasquez treated us with kindness, respect and integrity.
I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. We were welcomed like family and they are so generous too. The food is delicious, freshly cooked and served. The atmosphere is pleasant and the decor is beautiful.
Thank you both for making this experience possible and we hope to see you soon.

author: Omar Ramos
review_text: Good food, very reasonable prices, and significant portions. I found this place via a TikTok posting and I have to say, it didn’t disappoint.
