The restaurant is medium sized and it’s family owned. The decor is Mexican to the max but that doesn’t really impact the food. I had two salsas Azada wet burrito and it was really good. I added some of the spicy green salsa that comes with the complimentary chips to add more spice to it. Overall, great food with plenty of parking space. The customer service is great too. The staff is super friendly.

author: Denella Gaona
review_text: We live right down the street and never knew this place existed. We went yesterday and were so impressed. Right when u walk in, it's absolutely gorgeous,  nice, cool, clean, and smells great. The food was delicious, and the waitress was very attentive.  We were impressed with this restaurant so much. It's a bit out of eyesight, so you don't see it right away. But I really recommend this place if anyone wants some great Mexican food.

author: Gerald Prado
review_text: This is the best Mexican restaurant in all of Las Vegas. Tortillas were fresh, the beef enchiladas had some of the best shredded beef. Was basicallly Barbacoa. Sabroso! 10/10 would enchilada again.

author: Jennifer Rios
review_text: Really enjoyed the ambiance like walking into an authentic Mexican place with beautiful decor. My mom loved the background music of her favorite singer Javier Solis. When you walk in everyone is very nice and welcoming, the waitress was nice and attentive and I over heard another young waiter taking care of a table with all ladies and one in particular was being picky and he had great customer service and allot of patience. I felt bad for him but I have to say he did a great job. Me and my mom had a good dinner, we ordered the fajitas with chicken and shrimp and it was delicious the shrimp were big and the chicken was cooked just right, it had allot of bell peppers of all 3 kinds and onions and all was very fresh. The beans and rice also very good. It was a big portion and we took leftovers home. I recommend this place and prices are good.

author: David
review_text: For a great dine in experience with the family, Los Cedros Mexican Restaurant is the place to go. This was highly recommended by my fellow peers on Google. They were spot on. I ordered the Wet Burrito with Carne de Pastor with red sauce, and the portions are filling, I would say huge, but I ate the whole thing....lol. The sauce was flavorful, not too thick or watered down. It had a great consistency, and the flower tortilla is not homemade, but a good quality and held up to the sauce and carne. The pastor had a great flavor and also not to salty, and you can taste that hint of chorizo. It's topped off with sour cream and side of salsa. Dish does not come with rice or beans but can be ordered separately. The atmosphere is amazing also, you feel like you're in a different country. The corn tortillas are hand-made fresh to order, so any dish you order, I recommend asking for the corn tortillas. I included pics of other dishes my family ordered. It's a 10-minute drive east from the Las Vegas strip

author: Eli Hernandez
review_text: My family and I love coming here! I usually always get the same thing, the mole enchiladas. They’re delicious! Also their agua Fresca tamarindo flavor is so good!

author: Mario Reyna
review_text: The food and service was excellent! There was a good balance of checking in and letting us enjoy the food, atmosphere, and overall vibe of the place. It was not busy at 5pm on a Saturday, which I really enjoyed. Definitely worth the drive.

author: Omar Lopez (Marejo)
review_text: I found this place on TikTok, and it was called the Mexican Narnia. It did NOT disappoint. It was beautiful inside. The best atmosphere I've ever been in for a Mexican restaurant. The only disappointment was I ordered Menudo, and they didn't have any. I settled for the Chilaquiles, and they were  fire🔥 with asada on them. Big portion. My prima had a shrimp cocktail and my mom and had some ceviche, and it was all very good. It's definitely a must try.  We showed up once they opened, and within 20 minutes of sitting down, that place was packed. Make sure you are hungry if you visit cause they hook it up.

author: Robert M
review_text: Food is great no doubt. Visited on not busy day it was empty so the atmosphere was pretty relaxing. I'm not sure how this place is when it's busy, but food arrived on time. Waiter was moody but not rude. Mole enchiladas 🤌🏽.

author: L VK
review_text:
To celebrate Cinco de Mayo we chose a fun local spot we hadn’t been to.
Located on Flamingo Rd in Las Vegas, Los Cedros is definitely a great find. As a family-owned establishment, their dedication to authentic Mexican cuisine shines through in every dish. The Mexican-inspired explosion decor, adorned with Virgin de Guadalupe statues, Mexican art, fountains, colorful flags and flowers through and even intricately decorated bathrooms, creates a visually stunning atmosphere.

Our dining experience  was nothing short of spectacular. We were warmly greeted with complimentary chips and salsa, setting the tone for a fantastic meal. The guacamole was a standout with its generous serving and amazing flavors. The shrimp tacos, chicken tacos, and bean burrito were a delightful explosion of flavors that left us wanting to lick the plates.

To complement our meal, we indulged in their margaritas in mango, strawberry, and pomegranate flavors. These cocktails were not only excellent but also generously poured and delightfully strong. The service at Los Cedros was great, friendly, fun, and incredibly attentive.

Overall Los Cedros is an excellent find for anyone craving authentic Mexican cuisine in Vegas. From the decor to the food to the service, every aspect of our visit was exceptional. Highly recommended for a flavorful and memorable dining experience!

author: Scott Bradford
review_text: Chirping bird sounds was a bit much. Although some will like the very busy decorations I felt it to be plastic feeling and too much.  The prices were reasonable and food passable. They were able to seat our group of 20 at one table.

author: Carla Harris
review_text: The food was great when it finally came, the wait to be seated was an hour and after being seated and getting our orders taken right away, the people next to us got served first though they were seated after. We waited and additional 30 minutes for our food to arrive to the table. Shrimp was huge and juicy in the molcajete, and the beans (which I hate) was absolutely delicious! The staff was great and our waiter was the greatest. He was funny and gorgeous. The prices were high but very well worth it and you can tell the food is authentic and made to serve, also if you think you don’t want to tip that’s out the question the tip is included on the receipt automatically.

author: Nelson Brunes
review_text: While visiting Las Vegas I wanted some good Mexican food and I found a post on tiktok about this place. I ordered the molcajete for 2 people for take out, and it was amazing, so much food and so much flavor. Next time, I'll make sure to eat in

author: Jo De Leon
review_text: The food was delicious, and the service was on point. I highly recommend the cilantro steak. We originally went to try chilaquiles, but they were soggy and had no egg. Every other dish was excellent.

author: Daisy Linares
review_text:
The place is very beautiful and unique. The food was amazing. Love the mojarra frita. It was amazing 😋🥰🥰😍
The restrooms are very clean and very beautifully decorated.

author: Connor Scotton
review_text:
Fun….super fresh fajita’s!!!!!

This is a small authentic Mexican restaurant that is tucked into a corner end plaza.

Keep going!!!!! Its great food served very neatly and very fresh. So well done.

author: Michael Ruelas
review_text: The food and service was ok and the atmosphere was not great because the place had a weird smell. I was disappointed with my dish as it had very little shrimp for the price point. The place was empty and appears to be struggling which doesn’t give me too much confidence on the quality of the ingredients. Definitely had buyers remorse as we left.

author: Wendy Bonilla
review_text:
Everything is REALLY GOOD from this place HIGHLY RECOMMENDED IT to EVERYONE
Food is fresh you feel like at home Service is excellent the vibe is great trust me we are to come back again! And again!!

We went to the restaurant in March 3/23/24 for my friend birthday and it was a hit!! AGAIN!!! I totally 👍🏻 loved it my friend got the Happy Birthday treat from the restaurant!😁😁 and a delicious flan 🍮. So my boyfriend and I had the campechana cocktail (this was spicy 🌶️ but really good and tasty if you’re in for spice you’ll love it),raw oysters 🦪super delicious with the Prepared sangria and a soda too and I ordered the chicken flautas not expecting that they had potato 🥔 in it which seems a little different from what I was expecting good but from 1-5 I give a 3 cause I don’t like potato on my flautas cause they were a bit soggy but the rest was delicious and fresh as always!
Thanks again for the delicious food and the great service!!

author: Leslie Escobar
review_text: I was looking for a local place for molcajetes. This place was better than expected for the reviews. Usually when I see alot of reviews I assume it will be all hype.  This place is really good. Good service. Good micheladas. Not crowded. No wait to be seated.  I have been here 3 times thus far.  Molcajetes are excellent. My husband loves the tore marisco. I will be returning often. This place is authentic.

author: Michelle Dang
review_text:
Very spacious with a bar area and small stage. Good music playing. Our waiter was really kind and very knowledgeable in the menu. He gives good recommendations. It was our first time there and definitely won't be our last. It looks like a fun party place on the weekends but still a good casual outing for a meal with family after a long day.

We ordered the Torre de Mariscos, Tostadas de Cameron, and a fish taco with horchatas. You're given chips and salsa too. My partner really liked the salsa given with the chips. It was really flavorful with the right amount of spicy. Chips were fresh as well.

Torre de Mariscos was amazing! Had shrimp, octopus and I believe scallops too. Tender and juicy. Whole and diced pieces of shrimp. You can tell everything tasted amazingly fresh and not "fishy". The portions are big enough to share which is really nice.

Tostadas de Cameron was delicious. If you want to try ceviche for the first time, get this. A bit more simplier ceviche with a pack of flavor. Shrimp was cooked & diced, tender. It was served in a cute little boat with tostadas. The sauces are different from both plates but compliment the seafood well.

The fish taco we tried was really good too! It had two pieces of fish that were crispy batter fried and put on top of a corn tortilla. The salsa, avocado, and shredded cabbage are on the side when they bring it out to you so that the taco doesn't get soggy. We compiled the taco and added the salsa from the chips on top. Delicious! Horchata was not overly sweet and very refreshing! Homemade is all I have to say.

Service was good overall. The food took a bit to come out but I believe everything's made to order. It's more of a place to chat & dine while drinking than a quick lunch break meal.

It's really hard to find a place that has not only good seafood but really fresh ingredients too. Canelo's is the place. We will definitely come back to try other dishes! Thank you!

author: Joe Lenington
review_text: Food was horrible! It took a long time to get out food (chicken enchiladas and shrimp/fish taco) and the quesadilla was not edible. Pls avoid it, there's better places in Vegas!

author: Alberto Peralta
review_text: Tacos al governor are aswome i do recommend this place will sure do return back again these workers are above and beyond attend you will respect and make sure u enjoyed your food thank you for all hard great service…

author: Carlos Delgadillo
review_text: If you like live Banda music, this is the place, 5 Star authentic Sinaloa sea food. Great friendly staff. Highly recommend, definitely coming back.

author: Cynthia Spears
review_text:
We went there for dinner and did. Not like the atmosphere it looks like they just opened and it was probably about 4:30 in the afternoon we asked for
a cocktail and they had to go back and talked to some lady and then he came back and said they wouldn't know alcohol would be there until 10 minutes so we
left but the food might be good but I didn't try it

author: mspopcurn
review_text:
My daughter and I went here to order to go. We had the Worst encounter ever. Ordering the  meal the young man didn't know how to do a order. We waited 40 minutes. She finally went to see what was taking so long. Notice our order bagged up on the counter. She checked to make sure everything was there. Her order was not even made. The young man said it was the kitchens fault. She left out crying because she had to go to work and was hungry. They never let us know it was ready plus the food was cold. I ended up giving her my fish taco so she could eat before she went to work. My husband's beef taco was cold. The enchiladas were dry with no flavor.  First time I have ever seen white refried beans. Now for the fish taco, it's flavor was good, but it was one corn tortilla face open with about five small strips of fish. Not even enough to made a decent taco.
Never again will I patronize this place. From the time we walked in we didn't feel welcome there. Stay away brothers and sisters. Wasted our money.

author: Victor Koehn
review_text: Don’t sleep on this place. You won’t be disappointed. ¡Muy rico!

author: Cristina Martin
review_text:
After living in the valley for a little over 30 years, I've had my favorites. Owners change, and food trends change, but this experience was a nostalgic joy.

The location being tucked away in a corner makes it easy to forget, but not anymore. Upon entry, you find the classic vibrant colors, tropical theme, a few in progress technical repairs, but a clean smell.  Not overy packed with chairs to expect bumping into other tables. We were warmly welcomed and told to take a seat anywhere.

Menu is not overly complicated. This is great. Classic dishes from diverse meats to their seafood specialities.  While I have enjoyed fusion foods and creative varieties - here I was glad to not have an over complicated menu.  We ordered a fillet w/ seafood medly in parchment paper, a garlic friend tilapia, and fish tacos.  Standard time of about 30 minutes from ordering to arrival to table.

Water - NOT TAP. 👏👏👏 Was cold even with out ice. Coffee - nice, not and stout. Salsa & chips - Medium salted chips with just sufficient thickness. Salsa WAS FRESH TOMATO based (not canned) and a conservative amount of cilantro/ onion/ chile. This is actually a brilliant idea. I know we LIKE HOT/SPICY salsa - it is THE signature experience of Mexican culinary experience.  However, being subtle works to its advantage here. The heat is slow to build and stays in the back of the mouth, still allowing you to enjoy it rather than being blistered by it. Were brought out crackers, tostadas, Chipotle sauce, ketchup, may, spicy mayo sauces.

Filled with medly came with appropriate amount of rice/ salad/ beans.  All decently salted - not overdone. Quality of product also noted. No horrid casino banquet hall grade rice.  Greens were fresh, firm, and crisp. Pico was a classic tomatoe/ cilantro and onion (with again, a controlled amount of onion/ cilantro). Tortillas - FRESH MADE. Light and STILL maintained their structure even when sauced. Not too thick or thin. 💫

White fish filet with seafood medley was soft, light, and not a single rubbery or over-cooked piece.  Sauce was not over bearing or heavy handed to a particular flavor other than a soft hinted creme base. Tilapia was large, evenly garlic smothered and had firm flesh.  Perfect garlic topped! 👌 Classic fish tacos - over abundant tenders. QUALITY. Every bite was CRUNCHY and with virtually no grease to contend with. Impressive. The meat was also tender yet firm. Evenly salted. While I ordered 3 tacos - enough tenders to equate to 5 tacos worth.

Total with tip was around 80.00 for mid day lunch for 3. I can't wait to come tear it up during live band hours as a pre-party and get my hands on a Michelada. Had several other patrons come and go with micheladas to go.  ❤️❤️❤️ Thank you for such kind, patient and accommodating wait staff for all out questions. We appreciate you and feel most welcome to come again - which we will.

author: Lidia Camacho
review_text:
The most delicious tostada de camarones cocidos I ever tasted!!!
They had a good touch flavor from Sinaloa!!
So recommended this place !!
Will tray other plates next time !!

author: Maria Wisconsin
review_text: Okay. I was skeptical but once the seafood platter was served you could tell they know their seasoning. The hospitality and music made the experience one of the best in Las Vegas

author: Ericson Flores
review_text: Great place, way understaff, waiters did an excellent job but I feel the place needs more waiters and cooks, everything on the menu looks excellent, too bad I never got the chance to try any of it, after two hours waiting for my food I decided to walk away.

author: Gnarls Barkley
review_text: This place is no good. It's really dirty. Roaches everywhere. imagine eating here and you see a big black cockroach crawling on the wall while you're taking a bite. The waiters are really rude, very unprofessional too. They don't speak one word of English. The food is edible. The atmosphere is pretty weird. The owner has no idea what he's doing. But it's fun to watch. I don't recommend this place at all. Unless you're trying to get food poisoning and looking for that dirty restaurant vibe. Also for some entertainment. This place cracks me up.

author: Romy Barraza
review_text: As always, they don't disappoint. Authentic Sinaloa flavor. If you don't mind, wating a bit for the waiter as he helps out in the kitchen as well. The customer service is welcoming & staff is friendly & knowledgeable. I love that the tortillas are homemade & they have a variety of seafood dishes, which are traditional to Sinaloa. If you haven't visited their one of their restaurants, I highly recommend it so long as you don't mind the loud music & loud noise. Molcajete Mar y Tierra is a must try if you do stop in.

author: Yesenia Castilleja
review_text: Food is good especially the Molcajete, never tasted anything like that! And the drinks too. Very good atmosphere with great music, the waiter’s were very nice.

author: Jorge Guerra
review_text:
Food is great 5* good portiions.
Service needs improvement. Long wait time for food over 25Min no refills or aditional service checks. At the end I waited over 15 mins. Just to get the check.
Ps . It was not peak hours.

author: Lenita Eldridge
review_text: Delicious food, excellent service, and fair prices.  Will be back again.

author: Reynaldo Valdez
review_text: Bomb Maricos and Mexican breakfast made fresh when u order it. Was looking for some ceviche and damn I was not disappointed. Wife loved her shrimp cocktail.

author: Aaron Feld
review_text:
As of today, my favorite & by far the best New York Style Pizza in Las Vegas! We decided last minute to try Lucinos’s, a place I tried years ago that was always good. I don’t remember them being this great.

Crust was perfectly cooked, sauce was so tasty, & they had a great Vegan cheese option. The Margherita pizza was perfectly cooked too. We tried their poppers which were delicious & the homemade vegan ranch was incredible. They had mozzarella sticks that were huge & the kids enjoyed them.

Everything is priced well & the service is impeccable! Erika, our server was exceptional. The place is super clean & has a lot of space. I’m not into sports but if you are they have a handful of tvs to watch games.

Team Luciano’s! Thanks For everything. See you soon!

author: DANIEL LAWSON
review_text: Had to try a philly after another local said they had the best. And it was great! had a joeys philly, love the fresh texture of the imported rolls. What a difference. Had a slice of tomato pizza which really good as well. East Coast pizzaria vibe as well.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text:
**Lucino's Pizza — A Philadelphia Gem in Las Vegas**

Lucino's Pizza is more than just a place to grab a slice; it embodies East Coast authenticity right in the heart of Las Vegas. The dining room is a tribute to Philadelphia sports culture, adorned with framed jerseys, memorabilia lining the walls, and TVs playing the latest games, creating an atmosphere of camaraderie and excitement. This is a venue where the joy of sharing a good meal pairs perfectly with a sense of tradition.

In the kitchen, classic techniques are employed with skill and care. The hand-tossed crust is a standout feature, striking a balance between chewiness and char. It boasts a gently blistered edge with just the right amount of texture and a tender center. The "original" slice delivers a harmonious flavor profile, with tangy tomato purée, stretchy mozzarella, and a touch of salinity that enhances the overall taste. The pepperoni version adds a delicious contrast with crispy edges from rendered fat and a hint of spice, while the cheese slice, satisfying yet straightforward, highlights the beauty of quality dairy.

Value and practicality shine through with Lucino's 2-slice-and-a-drink lunch special—a wise choice for a midday meal that offers both comfort and affordability (the complimentary soda adds a charming, nostalgic touch). The portions are generous yet sensible, fitting perfectly with the lively sports-bar vibe where patrons gather, cheer, and enjoy their food throughout the game.

The Lucino's Fries deserve special mention. Their crinkle-cut shape provides an extra crunch and maximizes seasoning retention. Dressed with the house garlic-parmesan sauce, the fries achieve a rich umami flavor. The addition of Pecorino cheese adds a salty, nutty contrast, while parsley flakes provide a fresh touch to keep the dish exciting. Overall, the fries are well-crafted and complement the Pizza beautifully.

Service is efficient and friendly, matching the casual pace of a sports-themed lunch or a lively evening of game-watching. The staff handles orders with a warm, approachable demeanor that fits the restaurant's confident charm.

For anyone craving an authentic East Coast pizza experience and a lively, sports-friendly atmosphere in Las Vegas, Lucino's Pizza is an excellent choice. It avoids gimmicks and instead focuses on delivering honest, well-prepared food at a fair price, making it ideal for gatherings, game nights, or anyone looking to savor a taste of Philadelphia with genuine craftsmanship.

author: Fairraiting
review_text:
Highly recommended!
Very friendly staff, the server was great!
She checked on us all the time.
They deserve every penny you give 💗

author: douglas hendrix
review_text: To me one of the best pizza places in vegas....by far my favorite..... don't even have to go for Just Pizza the appetizer menu is second to none a absolute must try are the hot honey chicken strips and the chicken parm egg roles

author: Michael Ruelas
review_text: The service was top notch! The lady was very polite and went above and beyond to help me with the large order. The food was good, but needed a little more to get that fifth star. The atmosphere is great if your an eagles fan. I recommend the supreme and the Philly pizza.

author: Kismet
review_text: Best pizza in town and reheats the next day even better (that’s if there’s leftovers)! I enjoy supporting a small family business that really cares and creates delicious food. Can’t wait u until the next time I can treat myself!

author: Sandy L
review_text:
The Chick-fil-A pizza is interesting and delicious. I was pretty skeptical how a chick fil a be incorporated into a pizza but they did it. The crisscut fries were very crispy, the sauce was on point to the chick fil a sauce. Very creative.

The Bird is spot on with spicy-ness and the ooey gooey cheese on top.

The meatball sub was alright but not great. The meatball was a little dry.

The Classic Philly is also tasty. The meat was very tender n it melts in your mouth.

author: Alejandra Cervantez
review_text: Wings were awesome! I had the hot buffalo and the lemon pepper also had hot buffalo sauce which was super delicious. The pizza tasted really fresh the crust was superb. I would highly recommend this place for really amazing wings. But be prepared, the wings are on the pricey side. We got 3 drinks, a pizza, and a 24 count of wings, and the total was close to $79. But the wings were worth it.

author: Parker Fitzgerald
review_text: Joey & Erica are the best! I went here the other night with a friend and I must say that I was very impressed. It is by far one of my new favorite pizza spots here in Las Vegas. I had two slices of pizza (pepperoni & cheese) and also the Philly Philly which was also very good. Cannot wait to be back soon. TRUE FACT: Their bread comes from Jersey and their steak comes from Philly! Makes the food very good high quality and top notch!

author: Josemari O. Calip (Joma)
review_text: This was my first time visiting through my buddy Jeremy. He reckoned me and I actually like it if it is actually a family friend orientated a little better than your average pizza, but they are from Philadelphia so definitely go through that. I am an ECW Philadelphia fan so I'm sure the owner will know a lot of them. But overall definitely give that a shot if you're around town. Definitely a crown jewel Susie was actually one of the servers that helped me so definitely worth it out

author: Nathan King
review_text: Too tier! My dad and I enjoyed a meat lovers pizza and a Philly. The crust on the pizza was out of this world! The bread on the Philly was so soft and the cheese steak was massive. Our eyes were bigger than our stomachs but we managed to make it thought all the food because it was DELICIOUS!!!! Definitely a must try place! Great staff, clean restaurant and tasty food!

author: Where To Feed
review_text:
THE BEST CHEESESTEAK!
THE BEST PIZZA!
(the culture fries!!!)

Just now realizing I have never reviewed the place I frequent the most in Las Vegas! I took it for granted how amazing it was. Taking the time now to say it!!

author: SKIP.ej1
review_text: Food was excellent 👌 loved it. Live band. Was so awesome.. order the ONION RiNGS.. there the best. Should have came back the next day when the Eagles played DeM B☆YS though. Otherwise this place is great. And will most def be coming back again.

author: Kenzi
review_text: Dined in today. Truly was the best experience I’ve had at a restaurant! Staff is so kind especially our server Suzy. Food was amazing! Highly recommend the Caesar Salad Fries, Buffalo Chicken pizza, and the Apple Walnut dessert pizza. All in all amazing experience food is beyond delicious! I will be back! 😋

author: Cani Esma
review_text:
Don't get me wrong, their Philly Cheesesteak, Supreme Pizza, and Garlic Parm wings were good, but the customer service could be better. I had to cancel an order because we unexpectedly had to take our dog to the emergency vet. I called the store when they were still located next to 7-11, apologized profusely, and was assured by the employee that they would "take care of it" (whatever that meant).
--
Several months later, they move near the Walmart Supercenter on Pecos and Trop, and I decided to place an order. The employee seemed nervous on the phone, told me he was getting the manager, and I was immediately told that I had an outstanding balance from the time I canceled. I explained what happened, and the manager claimed that he was never informed and that I still had to pay, or else I was barred from future purchases.
--
Well, since I like the food and had hyped them up to my family, I paid the outstanding amount. The total came to about 80 something dollars. I've had my fair share of working retail, so I don't really give a hoot that the employee forgot, because we all have those days. What I didn't really appreciate was the awkward and unnecessary tension in that phone call and in-person pickup, as if I was trying to cheat them out of 40 dollars. I can understand where they were coming from, but my family and I won't be returning.

*Edit: Love the response from owner continuing to claim that there was no documentation about the incident, yet here they are replying, scrambling to their defense, and getting dates mixed up as if they know what I'm referring to; because the incident was fairly brief. As previously mentioned, I don't care that the employee forgot their own store's policy and let it slip that they would help me. At the end of the day, I remembered this place and gave my own experience in exchange for points. They can complain about it and respond all they want; I have every right to express feeling uncomfortable enough not to return as much as they have the right to reply.

author: James Wong
review_text: A restaurant that could be plucked right out of Philly, Lucino’s serves good pizza and even better authentic Philly cheesesteaks and other fares in an environment that celebrates the reigning NFL Super Bowl champion Eagles.  Serving sizes are generous and in today’s environment can be considered decent value.  Add a trivia night that is hosted one night every other week and you have a restaurant that deserves regular visits.

author: Sam L
review_text: Being from PA, this was a must-visit. And I am happy to say, Lucino’s is ALWAYS the best! Whether it be the pizza, the wings, pasta, everything is delicious. And the Cheesesteak are a MUST!

author: Loowee
review_text: Located in a regular shopping plaza, front entrance doesn't suggest that there is a restaurant there. Once inside, its small and very clean, purposely designed just like most east coast pizzarias. Service was very good and welcoming. I ordered a slice of Sicilian cheese. The sauce on the pizza was magical. You can tell the quality. The crust although was tick but was also airy which made it easy to eat. I definitely recommend and will be back soon.

author: Daniel Herrera
review_text: Delicious and affordable pizza-by-the slice! Very hard to find these days, perfect for a quick lunch stop. Restaurant was clean, spacious and has multiple TVs for viewing. Erika was very friendly and accommodating. Hooked me up with a slice and side salad. Salad was big and very tasty with lots of veggies in it. Pepperoni pizza was crispy and hot and not too greasy. Slice was not huge, but on the bigger side. There were lots of options for slices when I went in. So far a Hidden gem!

author: Pranjali Sharma
review_text:
2.5 stars. I have no idea why this place has as many good reviews as they do. We went here for the AYCE sushi but decided to go a la cart. I'm glad that we did because the rolls were just average. Nothing to write home about. They were busy on a Thurs night and we had to wait around 10 mins to get seated. There isn't much place to wait inside, so we stood outside. This isn't a big deal at night but if you come here during the day, it might be a wait in the heat.

The ambiance is casual, sports bar with a few booths. We ordered the Call 911 roll, the Kiss of Fire, the Spicy salmon roll, the Takoyaki, the Unagi sushi and
a Hot sake. We love spicy food so a lot of our decision-making was based on the number of spice stars next to the rolls. The Call 911, which had 5 spice stars next to it and was recommended by the server as their hottest, was nowhere close to being spicy. In fact, the Kiss of Fire, which had 3 stars, had more of a kick. The server ended up getting us some spicy Korean sauce to heat things up. The rolls overall were ok. Same thing with the spicy salmon roll. It was fine. Nothing to write home about.

The Takoyaki and the Unagi were just disappointing. Unlike the usual Takoyaki, these were half balls instead of full balls. They also didn't have the bonito flakes and the octopus was more pureed than diced. The Unagi looked nicer than it tasted. Instead of tasting the rice and the eel as a combination, it amalgamated into one melted bite, which wasn't as fun. The sake was fine.

All in all, this was a very average dining experience and we will look for alternatives when we come back to Vegas next time.

author: Byana Holley
review_text: My first time going was, pretty good. The restaurant is really loud, but the sushi was good, the food came out on time and all of the staff was really friendly. I was disappointed in the Green Tea. Ice cream, it wasn't that good. But yeah, I would definitely come back!

author: Stephen Weber
review_text: The food is always top notch and the staff is friendly and nice; but it's always a wait to get a table and so loud! Definitely a hip place for locals.

author: Don Frasco
review_text: We came at dinner time and the parking was full. We had to wait a few minutes for a table. This place has great choices on its menu. I love that they have sashimi as part of their AYCE menu. Service was fast. Servings were average sizes. The place can get loud during game time.

author: Michelle Gomez
review_text:
BEST SUSHI IN VEGAS!!
- #1 Looove that they have pictures on their menu!
- unbeatable prices for the amount of variety offered!
- food quality is super fantastic !
- they’re always quick and good service
- always love the music they play!
I never get tired of coming here and we live on the opposite side of town! Food is always so good ! Come hungry ! But not too hungry ! There’s always a wait out the door BUT ITS WELL WORTH IT!

author: Cory L
review_text:
Received the recommendation to check out Gorilla sushi for when I went to Vegas for the Canelo Crawford fight.

Absolutely loved the super fresh and tasty rolls! The restaurant was clean, and the staff were friendly.

Huge menu with lots of options! I’d highly recommend you check out Gorilla sushi if you’re looking for a great meal while you’re in Las Vegas!

author: Rea Clair
review_text: This AYCE sushi spot was definitely worth the try. It had a variety of delectable food options from their tantalizing appetizers to their savory, sweet and spicy sushi rolls. I appreciated the fact that the Nigri had more seafood versus rice ratio. A majority of the food was absolutely delicious, but some items like the ramen and sashimi salad were just okay in my opinion. Our server was very attentive and made sure we were constantly checked up on. We definitely left with a fully belly so that’s a plus.

author: TL
review_text:
Great price on lunch for AYCE, only $26 for so many great options. This is our first time here and the sushi/ sashimi are extremely fresh tasting and delicious. The baked mussels sauce was very flavorful and elevated the mussels so much more juicy. I recommend the sashimi salad. 🥗
Service was fast, friendly and sushi ordered came out really fast too. Is hard to find a sushi place that’s as delicious as this for the price stated. You also get a free dessert included in the ayce after you done, the mochi and the ice cream bar is very yummy!
Parking is easy n plenty in the strip mall.
Will be back again when we’re in town! 9.5/10.

author: Diana L Franco Lopez
review_text:
1st time here, my college kid invited me to try and show me all her stamps for frequent customer.
Place is enjoyable big menu and I forgot that picture 🫣 we order so many things tasty, fresh and fast.  Friendly staff, we were there for dinner and walk out like we need to go for a long walk.

author: David Kim
review_text:
Pulled up here for lunch today, my server was real nice to me and my family, food was bomb and so were the drinks. 10/10 would recommend to go again, also probably the best bargain for all you can eat sushi in the area

(I WOULD make a reservation if it’s a friday night though)

author: Cezary Kabat
review_text: u can’t beat it for the price, love their baked rolls, especially the Baked Lobster, it’s 100% must try. one of favorite spots during my stay in Las Vegas, do recommend to others for lunch or dinner, i had dinner. spicy japanese ramen is also very good.

author: Zak
review_text:
Came with the little one for a lunch date. Service was great, I did enjoy the food as well.

She typically orders salmon and eel, devoured both. All the rolls I had were great too, and I definitely recommend trying the Johnny.

The music is on the louder side, was weird for a lunch time but not bad. Definitely was more of a late night vibe than a 11:30 vibe.

author: Nathaniel Adams
review_text: My sister told us about this place, 1st thing I noticed it's a vibe soon as you walk through the door.  Food was great.The service was better than the food.... they did not disappoint

author: Hitsomeballs
review_text: Plan to wait on a weekend/Friday.. They are super busy and worth the wait if you like sushi or nigiri.  Some Korean dishes mixed with even whole shrimp ceviche are also on the menu.

author: Kerri M.H.
review_text: Always crowded but delicious. This is my husband's favorite sushi restaurant. The selection is good and the food is excellent. Patience is important when you eat here because it is usually full. Lunchtime is a perfect time to go if you want to skip the crowds.

author: John Raddatz
review_text: Make sure you prepare yourself when you initially walk in! The host will shout welcome in Japanese so don’t be startled like I was lol. Overall rolls were good. Good flavor, fresh, nice texture. No complaints. Service was extremely fast. Our overall experience lasted maybe 30 minutes and we ordered over a dozen items. These people are turning tables like no other place I’ve ever seen. As soon as you’re done with a plate, it disappears from the table. Atmosphere was cool. Nice lighting, sports on the TVs and great music. Overall good experience. Would very much go back.

author: Harmony Lewis
review_text: I love it here sooo much, always an amazing experience. I’ve brought a bunch of family and friends and everyone loves it. Thank you

author: Douglas McClendon
review_text: We were in Vegas for our wedding anniversary and wanted to find something in and around the city. We came upon this sushi GEM!! It definitely was worth the 20 minute wait. Even at 8 pm there was a bit of a wait and we saw why! They food was amazing,a every dish, every plate and drink was VERY good!! All you can eat sushi for around $30 a person was well worth it! Definitely will be back! The place has good energy and the staff was very attentive during our visit.

author: Cesar Torres
review_text: I had an excellent experience here! The service was attentive, friendly, and made me feel welcomed right away. The sushi was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavor — you can really taste the quality in every bite. Beyond the sushi, the rest of the food was also delicious and came out quickly without sacrificing taste. Overall, the combination of great food and great service made this place a standout, and I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good sushi spot.

I go inside there is a group of people waiting and showing the workers their receipts of what they ordered. I told the worker if i or anybody who used the drive thru wanted to park our cars come in to pick up the food we not have used the drive thru in the first place. Next thing I over hear the employees asking one another whose order is whose and whose order is next in front of the customers present. I regret not asking for my mobey back. My food arrives no apology given. This place needs better management. If you are overwhelmed or short staff. Put sign up to have customers not use the drive thru and just take orders one by one 1 line at the cashier so people will get there food, the person at the grill wont be overwhelmed and orders will not get mixed up.

author: Emiliano Guerra Juarez

I love kyle great food and great service.

author: Raven Cuddels

Wow!! Lawrence was super nice and professional - Him and the lady chef were fast and amazing! Give them a raise!
amazing food

If this were the first or second time, I'd be a bit more forgiving, but this is well beyond that. What a waste of money.

author: Karla
review_text: The manager was very rude and completely unhelpful. They messed up the order and she didn’t even try to fix it. The service is awful in general and the place is not clean at all. Not worth it

author: Sarah Wilson
review_text:
Great Carlo Jr Location!
My Husband & I stop to grab a bite to eat here and the serves was great & the food well made well & quickly! That Jennifer & her Team!

author: Anya Lindsey
review_text: Passing thru town we went drive thru. I requested 2 cups of mayonnaise on the side. The girl acted like the four ranches was being generous.Even though the food we ordered was supposed to come with that many dipping sauces. She handed me 1 mayo so I asked her for a second. Her words were "we're too busy. We can't do it. We don't have the time," so I told her, Get me a manager & my second cup of mayonnaise. Manager never came to window & the 2 cup was 1/3 filled. $30 for super dry over heated horrible food plus an attitude.... corporate needs to fix this!!

author: L C
review_text: I ordered the Jalapeno Angus Burger Combo which was very good. The ingredients all came together perfectly: pepper jack cheese, jalapeno, lettuce, tomatos, red onions and santa fe sauce. Fries are served hot & crispy lightly salted. 4 1/2 Stars.

author: María
review_text: Food could be better, weird people coming in and THE WORST MANAGER EVER she is very rude to both costumers and workers…

author: Olena Voloshchuk
review_text: I ordered one combo and a separate burger. They charged me for two combos instead and then said they couldn’t refund me because the manager was not in on weekends. I'm going to point out that I was asked multiple times if I wanted to make it a combo and I said no every time and they still gave me two combos instead of just one. I'm very disappointed. I’m sorry but 26$ is ridiculously expensive for processed food. I’m not coming here again.

author: Brandon Martin
review_text: They stopped carrying Beyond burgers, so we don't go anymore. They have good burgers though. Like any of the fast food joints, if the food is fresh it's pretty good. I'd say it's probably 85% of the time at any Carl's Jr.

author: George Cendejas
review_text: I ordered Large fries and received fries in a box still flat, not opened all the way.   Theyre stingy on the fries. The cashier told me it doesnt make a difference.

author: Steven
review_text: Always enjoy Carl's Jr.  My go to is the Double Western Bacon cheeseburger.

author: FlavorFool-N-Spain
review_text: My brother told me they had great breakfast sandwiches...and he was correct!!!! I had the bacon and 😋

author: Hello Dude
review_text: The food was phenomenal! Your manager there, what's her name? Jennifer is a wonder to be around. If I had anything to complain about I just wish you would add strawberry/grape jelly to the menu. The biscuit can be a little dry. 11/10 otherwise. Please think about the jelly.

author: kimberly Clement
review_text:
8pm at night.

# 1, i did not get a welcome in or anything. #2, ordered my food, so i was a paying customer
#3. I needed to use the restroom while i waited for my food and they said they close the bathroom at 6:30pm everyday…

Why is the dining room open then??
6:30pm closing bathroom for what?

author: Okema Brooks
review_text: Purchased a classic double cheeseburger combo, fries were under cooked the patties were slider sized patties on a regular bun Smashed together very Disappointing because I was Hungry food  presentation was terrible gave it to my Dog even he was looking crazy at me like you bought this smh

author: Christy Haynes
review_text: The food was a bit pricey but good.  The ability to make a couple meals out of the $19 combo made it a bit better.  The salads looked very fresh and even the Farmers boy branded ketchup was good.  The items were brought to the table fairly quickly and staff was polite.  The only issue was being given the incorrect dressing which was easily remedied.

author: Octavio Ramos
review_text:
December 11 at 7:40pm.
I usually order here, every time it’s good, I love this sandwiches. But this time I went through the drive through and a women attendant took my order which couldn’t understand the order, I repeated three times my order, but in the end I received the wrong order for the 2 combos and one sandwich. I’m feeling upset ‘cause besides that, the food was terrible I was so hungry than I did not care what was I eating, but the sandwiches were so messy and the flavor was repugnant that I just can’t accept.

author: Jackie Ayala
review_text:
I like coming to this location
The food is always good
The service is good
The atmosphere is nice

author: Shu jie Chen
review_text: Delicious food fresh made! Great staff. Polite and friendly 😉

author: Justin Webee
review_text:
Friendly Staff, Prices are a bit high for a fast food joint but they do have daily deals and you get what you pay for.

Salads are pretty large and filling.
Hamburgers are huge. Just about big enough for sharing.  Get the fried zucchini they are awesome.

This location gets busy for lunch to plan according.

10/29/2023 Update: it appears prices have gone up even more. This seems like a trend less food for higher prices.  What used to be a great value has sadly gotten to high.   Food is still relatively good but at these prices you have other choices. $56 for:
Pancake platter
French toast platter
Denver omelette
3 small drinks which were $4.50 each.

author: Brandy Cole
review_text: We were in Vegas for an event & we decided to eat here. We were greeted by the manager. I only came here cause the food looked really good when Raina, the competitor eater did a Collab with them. But the food was good, hot, & we used coupons that were available. We ended up getting two box set burgers with fries.  And a big bacon double for my other daughter. Oreo milkshake, & chicken fingers for La Luna. The manager traded my drink out for their orange juice. Because I cant have pop, due to my kidneys. It was an upcharge but I still appreciate the courtesy.  I wish they were near us. Not in Orlando, but southwest parts of Florida. You go to Orlando as a brand, your brand dies...

author: Eugene Weems
review_text:
Farmer Boys - I ordered the Barbecue Crispy Chicken Salad at
Located 5955 S Eastern Ave in Las Vegas, NV. Although they presents a diverse menu that includes their much-talked-about Barbecue Crispy Chicken Salad. Upon entering the restaurant, you’re greeted with a casual atmosphere that feels welcoming, making it an ideal spot for a quick bite to eat after a hard workout .
The Barbecue Crispy Chicken Salad was visually appealing, with vibrant colors from fresh greens,  and crunchy fried onions. The highlight of the dish is undoubtedly the crispy chicken, which is perfectly fried to achieve that satisfying crunch with each bite. It’s seasoned well, and when paired with the tangy barbecue sauce and Ranch, it adds a delightful smoky flavor that elevates the salad. I was only able to finish half of it, but several hours later I polished it off.

author: Cora W
review_text: Ordered their 3 egg breakfast. I ordered the eggs over medium. It came with hashbrowns, a side of meat (I chose bacon crispy), and toast (I had whole wheat. The eggs were done correctly but not seasoned. The toast was good. The hashbrowns were crispy but no seasoning. The bacon was floppy and underdone. My husband had their 3 egg breakfast burrito and said it was decent.

author: Chris Armbruster - Realtor
review_text: Great quality food for fast food  with some kids options and nice atmosphere inside.

author: Erik Redd
review_text: I wanted a sausage burrito. I really don't like ordering food from this place, but it was the only thing open at 6am, in this area that wasn't McDonald's. Everytime I come to farmer boys, I'm reminded why I avoid this place. Here is my "sausage burrito'. After a few bites of tomatoes and hash browns mixed with a bit of eggs, I had to see what was going on. Here is a picture of what you can expect in your tortilla at farmer boys. 20 bucks for this.

author: Abraham Edo
review_text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Terrible Service – Very Disappointing
I went to Farmer’s Boy today (around 8:00 AM) and had one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had at a restaurant. The young woman working as the waitress had an awful attitude from the start. Her behavior toward customers was rude and dismissive, and the way she treated people—including us—was shocking.
When we asked simple questions about the menu, her responses were snappy and disrespectful, making us feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. The overall service she provided was unprofessional and disgusting, which completely ruined what should have been a pleasant breakfast.

Management needs to address this immediately because customers should never be treated this way.and also one thing I don’t wanna forget to address is the makeup she put on her face was almost be on our food.

author: Vincent Lau

author: Mrs. Lomprey
review_text: The food was excellent,  the staff were prompt and friendly. And we received our meals from the cook.  Will definitely visit here again

author: A. Gayle
review_text: This was my first visit to a Farmer Boys. I had the Double Big Cheeseburger combo. The burger was fresh and tasty, but there was nothing spectacular about the fries or regular drink for the extra $6. Not sure if that's just a LV thing. ($$ to make something a combo.) Good service though.

author: Kym Bellas
review_text: Hot fresh food always. I had the grilled chicken avocado on sourdough delicious. And I always grab the zucchini fries. And the place and restroom is clean.

author: Traci C
review_text:
How this place doesn’t get higher reviews I don’t know. Our double big cheese that we shared was OUTSTANDING! Old school delicious. The fries were PERFECT!
Why anyone would line up at “never get in or out” over this place is beyond me.

author: Anthony Ladd
review_text: Decided on Panera bread wanted to try to Bread bowl. Meal was nice. Service was great. The associate Make sure that out ingredients was fresh nice.

author: Sky Jay
review_text: This Panera is in a good location, plenty of parking and not a mad house like the Hughes Dr. Location. However, my thoughts about the quality of the food and the customer service fluctuate between a 3 and 4 star rating. The employees here are either very friendly or they are not very. Also the food and drinks are quite pricey for what they are, as most menu items are rather plain tasting - but do seem healthy. With that said, I would probably visit more only if it were more affordable.

author: The Laughing Lion
review_text:
This location has a big dining area.
I've eaten here over 20 times and I've never had a bad experience.
They have a drive thru too.
Careful with going late in the day, like after 6 pm because they might run out of certain food options.
The parking lot is huge too.

author: Laura Ahmad
review_text: 2 soups, 1 sandwich and a pick 2, $41 otd and had a 25% off coupon that the "general manager" would not honor because of "franchise owned or not." Idk what the deal with the GM was but he would not budge. And to tell a loyal guest that it's not for "my store" like he owns Panera. Well, my family, friends and I will not frequent this location and will have to think about dining at Panera moving forward, especially if they have people like Ben Villalvaso(the GM out of all people) ready to turn people away. Like as if it was coming out of his own pocket. Be aware of this location people. One thing to note, absolutely no one was wearing name tags except Ben. The guy with the pink shirt, don't know if it's someone higher than Ben, but no name tag on him either. Our cashier(had to find her name on receipt) had mucus hanging out of her nose while I was ordering. Not her fault but instead of Ben telling her that the coupon is not valid at "his" location, he should be giving her a heads up to clean her nose out. The worst thing to do when ordering food is to look at someone with snot in both their nostrils. If anyone takes the risk visiting this Panera, GOOD LUCK. My family and I had a terrible experience. Food matched the service sadly. Soups were all cold and sandwich bread was so hard it almost chipped my Aunts tooth. Also, how does a French onion soup have minimal to NO cheese in it? What’s funny is on the receipt shows “accuracy matters”, that’s a lie! NOT WORTH IT

author: Scott Alan Blanchard
review_text:
Decent food, but for the price and robots that "greet" and "serve" (and want/expect a tip).  I did find one person today actually conversing with a customer and that was lovely.
I'd like more options and customizations for salads.
Also don't be so stingy with napkins!

author: D J
review_text: Unfortunately I went to Panera which I normally enjoy. Not this time. I went through the drive through to get a drink and a cup of soup. How difficult should this be? It took 15 minutes. I ordered, paid and waited. Nobody updated me and the cars behind me piled up and started beeping at me. I couldn't move because I didn't get my food. It took forever, I had to ask for a spoon and napkin when I did get the order. The girl at the window was somewhat rude. I won't be coming back to this Panera. Hopefully the manager reads these reviews and gets the crews act together. I enjoy the food but don't want to deal with the poor service and lack of attention.

author: Ray Ju
review_text: The parking spaces for the place is more than enough.  The decor is simple.  The dining area is a good size.  They had some pastry on display.  They have coffee,  tea, and soda choices off to the side.  The coffee was tasty.  The bear claw and muffin was pretty good.  The service was good too.

author: rick pentecost
review_text: I got a bowl of chicken noodle soup and a drink. It was 13.00 and it was not even half a bowl of soup. I would not eat here.

author: C B
review_text: I LOVE Panera and I eat here a lot!! The food is always fresh & delicious and the drive up works great when you are in a hurry. The soups & sandwiches are THE BEST and the bakery items to die for especially the french baguette!! It is addicting!! Love the bagels & orange scones too!! YUM!!!! Friendly staff too!!

author: KNote
review_text: I got the Mediterranean Chicken salad. The chicken was basically cold cut slices of chicken that didn't taste like chicken. The lettuce was not crispy and just about every single leaf was from the core.  The salad was mushy. I got a chocolate chip cookie that was stale. Luckily the Dr pepper was okay. But even the slice of bread that came with the meal was as hard as a rock. I don't think I'm ever going to go to a Panera again. The cashier was really good, very friendly. The food wasn't her fault at all. But over $20 for that? What a waste

author: Kelly Daley
review_text:
This is a new location, and I'm giving a 1 star in hopes feedback will be taken. I was delivering for UberEats. I asked the female preparing the order for an additional bag to put the beverages in. She refused and continued to argue with me. Saying "if you put them (2 large beverages) in a bag, they will spill). **if someone asks for an additional bag, don't argue**
First, ALL of the order should be bagged, including beverages, for the customer's safety.
Second, the bag with all the food items was so heavily packed, when I picked it up, the safety seal tore from the weight.
This order was not packed properly. You need to put the beverages in a bag, and distribute the remaining order properly so that it will NOT spill or tip over.

SN: I have been doing deliveries for over a year now. IF the order does spill, I'd rather it be in a bag (paper or plastic) then all over my car while I'm driving. Please set up delivery orders for success.

author: NDSOLDIER
review_text: This was my first trip to Panera and I thought it was great. I was told about the mac and cheese and I have to agree, it was delicious. I also had the turkey sandwich, it was just as good. The restaurant was very clean and presentable.  The staff was very professional, courteous and polite.  I will definitely recommend Panera and eat here again.

author: Adam Adam
review_text:
I visited the store on Monday 07/24/2023 at 8:15 pm and most of the drinks were out, they closed most of the dining area...usually they don't say "welcome" or "have a good day"!
This location should be closed by 9 pm by they start cleaning so early...poor service.

author: Sammie Peters
review_text: I dont often review chains but wanted to give this place a quick shout-out. They have really wonderful management. I've been a few times and they are kind and helpful. Above and beyond. Its clean and spacious as well. Food is good as usual.

author: Queen Nok
review_text: Toasted Italian sandwich. Toasted on the outside which made it very hard/crispy. Like trying to eat a sandwich made of croutons. Ordered whole, could only eat 1/2 because of it being overly salty. If you want your entire week's worth of sodium allowance in one sandwich, then this is the one to eat. I love Panera Bread and am a frequent customer, but this sandwich should be taken off the menu. This sandwich left me with such a bad taste/experience, that I'll probably not have another craving for an Italian sub until next year.

author: Yvette Kelley
review_text: I had a bowl of your THIN WATERY broccoli cheese soup yesterday at your location. I also have broccoli cheese soup at other Panera locations. Have you changed the recipe? it's very watery and thin. I will not be returning to Panera very disappointed. My order number was 2633360. Yucky thin soup never again.

author: Jessica Maloy
review_text: Great restaurant with yummy food & assertive staff. Shelly was friendly, and my tomato soup hit the spot on a cool day. The blueberry muffin & cookie were delish. I'm going to try broccoli- cheddar in a bread bowl next time. 😋 Definitely recommend this Panara location.

author: Raymond Coshuner
review_text: I recently had the misfortune of ordering the strawberry poppy seed salad from Panera Bread, and I was thoroughly disappointed with my experience. The salad was an absolute disaster as it contained rotten produce, which completely ruined the entire meal for me. The strawberries were mushy and had an unpleasant smell, while the lettuce was wilted and unappetizing. It is incredibly disheartening to spend hard-earned money on a supposedly fresh and healthy salad, only to be served subpar ingredients. Panera Bread, you need to prioritize quality control and ensure that your customers receive fresh and edible food. This experience has left me with a strong distaste for your establishment, and I won't be returning anytime soon.

author: Elijah Brooks
review_text: Very welcoming. Food is amazing!! I always get this for lunch but the workers deserve so much credit for creating this amazing atmosphere.

author: Amanda Brendel
review_text: Had to call in order because website wouldn't let me check out. Ordered 6 meals for a business lunch for pick up. I arrived early, ordered a smoothie to wait. Out of bananas which took too long to notify and then to make with another option.  Once food was ready, no one offered to help with bringing to my car. Took 3 trips to my car with food bags and drinks. I regularly order from AZ locations and they ate much more willing to offer assistance and appreciation for ordering.  Will order somewhere else next time in town. Too many options when given poor service.

author: Dani
review_text: you can always depend on great food here. lots of meat in your sandwich, perfectly cooked on the grill; creamy eggs and crispy juicy bacon; stuffed burritos that will never fall apart. this place reminds me of the very best diners back east. the bustling ambience of those diners is, alas, not present inside Bob's, which seems best suited for well-packed to-go orders. but always, the food here is a satisfying pleasure, and the prices are a relief among other surrounding higher-priced breakfast joints.

author: James Allan
review_text:
First time here was 15yrs ago. The office I worked at always ordered breakfast from here! My absolute fave is the Steak and Eggs on Kaiser roll! The other breakfast offerings are equally great.

Today I came for lunch. We ordered their Pastrami Sandwich, Philly Cheese Steak, Chicken Fingers, Onion Rings, and Chili Cheese Fries! Everything was D-lish!

100% recommend! Gonna miss this place when I move away from NV!

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text:
Bob may be gone, but his legacy is alive and delicious.
Bob’s East Side Deli is still boomin’—same classic sandwiches, same flavor-packed punch. You can taste the pride in every bite. It’s clear the team kept his standards alive: generous portions, fresh ingredients, and no messing around when it comes to quality.

RIP to the legend, but his name still stands strong—one bite at a time. If you haven’t been, you’re missing out.

author: Mark Estochin - Realtor Henderson, NV
review_text: This is what I call a "hole in the wall" an east side deli. They have some great food at great prices. It does have new owners since the owner Bob, unfortunately passed unexpectedly. R.I.P. Bob. But the food is always great, service is always great, great location, and they also do deliver. They have great sandwiches as well. I mean how can you pass up the breakfast wrap/burrito for $7.03 with tax?!

author: Matthew Heiser
review_text: Placed a catering pickup order and loved how easy it was to tweak the headcount and adjust right up to the last minute. We got 40 breakfast burritos, sausage, chorizo, bacon, and plain egg with cheese, plus a 25-piece variety Danish tray from Bob's East Side Deli. Everything was a hit—everyone raved about the food. Highly recommend!

author: Ruby Graves
review_text:
Had the fondest memories of this place, but it's been totally sold out since the previous owner passed on. Such a shame, stay away in 2025, it's a shell of its former self. :(

Food is now mid and overpriced, bread is soggy from overpoured oil/vinegar. No mayo when it used to be homemade. Inside has been corporatized, so it's empty and lifeless. Slower than it ever was when it was busy. Somehow 4 people working behind the counter, but 3 cold sandwiches took 35 minutes.

author: Kyle Montoya
review_text: Breakfast burrito was bland and mediocre. I’m suspicious the tortillas were bought at target. If you put ketchup on eggs, you’ll like this place. If you like flavor, I recommend eating elsewhere.

author: Row Pascua
review_text:
I’m very happy that Bob’s East Side Deli is still open for business. I love supporting local businesses and I’m cheering them on. Nice size and clean restaurant. Friendly staff and great food always and surely affordable. Keep it up Bob’s Deli Team! I’ve only been here to pick up food haven’t had a chance to eat inside. Glad that they’re open early mornings a good time to pick up breakfast before going to work.

We like the Steak and two eggs (cooked over hard) on a Kaiser Roll and Buffalo Cauliflower with Ranch. Oh so yummy!

author: Richard Romero
review_text:
Bob's Eastside Deli is outstanding!
We used their catering service for two events—one in October and again last month—and both experiences were exceptional. The food was incredibly fresh and delicious. What really stood out was their attention to detail: each meal was individually labeled with our attendees’ names, ensuring everything got to the right person. I've never seen that level of organization before.
Thank you, Bob's Deli, for helping make our RC Boating events so memorable with your fantastic service and amazing food!

author: Juan Hernandez
review_text:
I gave you 1 star. Your food the best.
Your service the best
Your atmosphere awesome.

The part I completely did not like was.
That you have to impose minimum 20% on tips.

Come on be real. The people that eats around you or come in to your stablishment are regular folks. From the neighboring businesses.

Be more humble and change that. I'm sure Mr. Bob would never have done that. If he was alive.

author: Brian Bounds
review_text:
Hello Bob’s East Side Deli, I want to start out by saying this place Rocks. If anyone is looking for a great Breakfast, or Lunch you must stop here at Bob’s. Bob’s crew that work there are such awesome people they take care of their customers whether it’s the first time or not. So I put on RC Boat races at Sunset park in Las Vegas. The Boating organization is Called NAMBA we have been around for over 50 years. We came to Bob’s with a large request, we asked them if they would be willing to serve lunches for our National event we put on in September of last year 2024. Stacy said sure we came up with a menu. They knocked it out of the park. They had every lunch ready on time, they didn’t miss a lunch they even had name tags on every box. Wow it was amazing what they did. We couldn’t thank them enough. So
Now it’s the first weekend in May, we went back to Bob’s East side Deli and asked them if they would be willing to help us out again on Lunches as I put on another RC Boat races at Sunset Park they said for sure. So we came up with another menu and every thing was Great. But this time they went above & Beyond they are not open on Sundays, but she had a crew come in & make are lunches on a day they are not open on. Stacy, her Daughter, & staff
NAMBA & I can’t thank you enough for the wonderful lunches you provided us with.
Thank you so much.
So if you live here or if you’re just visiting from out of town please Stop here you will not be disappointed.

Brian

author: Trav23 Angel
review_text: Nice spot as a new Yorker of course katz is #1 but on the west coast I'd pick this spot Mariano delicious 😋

author: neal elsey
review_text: If you haven't tried this deli, please do yourself a favor and get here asap. Everything that I've tried has been great or amazing. Made with love and very fair prices. I stumbled upon this by accident, and now I'm hooked. Their patty melt was the best I've ever had at any restaurant.

author: J H
review_text: My first time at this place was this past weekend and I wanted it to be so good as I love my Boar's Head Meats. I paid almost $15 for a sandwich and drink which I have no problem paying, but when I get the amount of meat I got on my sandwich, that's when there is a problem. I know what they pay per lb for the meat I got and I feel ripped off. The meat was also not very fresh looking like you would usually get at the grocery store or other places. It had definitely been sitting around for a bit. So disappointed as I was hoping this was my new go to spot. Such a shame and it looks as though I should have gone when Bob was alive. I feel duped

author: David Hed
review_text: Bob's is probably best for takeout. My food was brought to my table on a Styrofoam plate with plastic wrapped utensils. The price is right (except the 50¢ surcharge PER EGG in your order) and service is quick though, so you'll see the blue collar clientele quickly rotate through the tables.

author: James Smith
review_text: My favorite sandwich place in the US. Always great service and fresh sandwiches.

author: Jaie Mo
review_text: The food is awesome here I actually met the new owner and I also met the former owners wife they were real nice. Customer service was awesome and on top of that the food was great. I ordered a pastrami sandwich which was very delicious, if you haven’t been there, what are you waiting for? It’s great.

author: Chris Lis
review_text: Haven’t been here in several years, but was working on that side of town and stopped.  Had a Tolls Creation loaded with meat and crispy hot fries were excellent.  Will def try and get by more often in the future.

author: Jami R.
review_text: Cold delis were great! The French dip was mediocre. Could have seasoned the meat while cooking. Service was wonderful.

author: Michael Holstrom
review_text: The ladies that work here are sweet and always smiling. We love Bob's Deli and come every week on our bike rides. They have won us over with their great sandwiches and service.

author: Debbie Mallick
review_text:
Food was hot, fresh and delicious.  Prices online were incorrect...stating $13.99 for all you can eat dinner. It ended up being $27.99 per person for all you can eat, without any add ons.  It was a little pricy ($75 for 2 with only 1 soft drink & tip) and would have been more if we wanted shrimp or eggs added to our stir fry.

Destinie was friendly and efficient, enhancing our experience with her smile and demeanor.

author: MeiLing Hanson
review_text:
I loved my experience at Stir Krazy. There's so many delicious food options in Vegas that it makes choosing where to go hard.

Stir Krazy stands out because the staff works so hard and they're very quick. I'm betting they get super busy after 3 pm when all you can eat starts, and they close at 7 pm so that gives guests approximately 4 hours. It didn't look like they had a lot of staff on the day I went so be considerate. Slow eaters beware 😆

This was my first time at a Mongolian stir fry restaurant in Nevada, and I was impressed.

I do miss the HuHot in North Dakota because there's bigger seating and the prices are more reasonable but definitely try this place if you're craving good stir fry and don't want to cook at home. Great place for families, meetups with friends, and solo diners!

author: Michael Ruelas
review_text: The service was excellent! Considering that it was our first time the waiter took their time to explain the process and included recommendations. The atmosphere felt empty and little effort to add decor to add personality. The food was good but it took a hit because they didn’t have fried rice which is an option and there wasn’t any reason given on why I couldn’t order some. Overall not a bad spot but considering it’s far from home and the cost was a bit higher than I’m willing to pay, we don’t think we will be back, but it’s worth a try if you haven’t been.

author: Kathy Yanke
review_text: Food was excellent, very clean and Destiny, our server was amazing!  So nice and helpful.  You could tell she loves her job!

author: Michael F
review_text: The food is good and fresh, it is like a ganghis ( I know spelled it wrong) grill,  and that was what I was looking for since they left.   The meats seem leaner less far, so like that.   Service was nice and friendly.  Place clean.  So why the lower score.  The price.   Went there with my wife for lunch, so 2 bowls, and 1 soda, with tip $50 so yeah not making this a regular place.  No lunch price,  no different size bowls for different prices,  if you want noodles, you have to put it on top of a already full bowl that is not that big to begin with, or purchase extra.  Do not look at the pictures of prices as they are not correct,  even their website has 5 pictures of all different prices, so when I went in September 2025 at 12pm it was $18 per bowl, $4 for a soda.  So for me,  good for a special break, or occasion,  but way to expensive for a weekly thing.  And that makes me sad

author: N Towers
review_text: Overall good food. Good variety of meats and veggies. It would be nice to have a few other sauce options. Get a really large bowl to make the cost worth it.  Unlike other Mongolian bbq I have been to,  this is one time through for $18 so fill your bowl as much a possible. It would be nice to do smaller portions and try a variety of sauces like others, but this was still good and I would come back.

author: Sheila Sablan
review_text: This place was awesome. I have never been. It tastes amazing. My only drawback is trying to pile things into the bowl they give you, but that's a personal thing, not anything on them. It was hot in the building but to be expected with all the windows and grill. I definitely will go again, I hope soon!

author: Debbie Tribble
review_text: This is the best Mongolian BBQ establishment I have ever been to. From the delicious food, fabulous staff and cleanliness! We’ll drive from UT and Az to eat here!

author: Omar Cazares (BEARLOCSTARR)
review_text: hey man this place is supper cool we got in there and 1st thing was asked was is this your first time we said yes and man they make sure we knew how it works and wut to get and how to get it so we can fill up the bown to the top... i love it the cook was supper cool and waiter was cool man over all a good place to visit not to mention the food was supper good def a must return next time we come back to vegas.. thanks to the team @stirkrazymongoliangrill

author: Wilbur Mijangos (Mr. Stark)
review_text: The food was great and the ingredients were fresh.  Seemed a little short staffed and cook seemed a bit overwhelmed.  All the staff was friendly and attentive. Def worth the wait.

author: ms beauty
review_text: Yayyy we finally found a good Mongolian style establishment. Love the food, cleanliness and atmosphere. The employees are always helpful and I’m just happy I found this place. I didn’t get noodles this time because I had it the last 2 visits.     This is my 3rd time in 1 month😩 lol 🤷🏽‍♀️

author: Tim Chounard
review_text: Have gone here a couple of times now... The lunch special is a really good deal, but if you bring your appetite, the all you can eat special is really good as well!  You get to pick out all of the various proteins and veggies and sauces... And then you hand it to the person running the grill and they cook it to perfection!  Delicious!!

author: V. Oronoz
review_text: Very pricey! They give you a very small plate to put your fresh options, then you give it to them to cook! You will pay $15.99 por a plate portion, or swtich to $25.99 buffet style! The restaurant its ok, food ok, you can tell how cheap it's the owner since they don't have any sauces or nothing on your table, if you need something, you need to go to the window kitchen!

author: Dexter McDonald
review_text: No one was there, but they were very friendly, it was clean and plenty of options. It would be cool if there was music or something to kill the dead air, but ultimately, I liked the experience. I was able to take my daughter and we both were thoroughly pleased with the food. Good spot to go to. Definitely will return if I'm able.

author: Daryel Gonzalez
review_text: My wife and I love Mongolian grills and wanted to try this while we are traveling in the area, the food was just okay - not bad-  and the service is good but you are only able a single plate of food. Mongolian grills are usually supposed to be AYCE. You can fill the bowl you get as much as you’d like, but you will only get once chance to get the food you want & the bowl is very small so you can’t really do that much with it.

author: Joshua Domingo
review_text: Whatever fits your bowl they'll cook it for you! Friendly staff, awesome cook, highly recommended for lunch or early dinner. The place can get packed during lunch rush so plan accordingly if time is of the essence.

author: Andrea Applebury (Ande)
review_text:
Phenomenal fresh sauces, fresh cut veggies,  and high quality protein. All cooked right in front of you. Reasonably priced,  even the AYCE.

Staff is incredibly friendly,  helpful, and attentive.

It's a must try if you haven't!!

author: Erin Madden
review_text: I freaking love this place! SO good! So clean & fresh! Staff so friendly!! The variety of veggies & meat is fantastic! The sauces are delicious! Highly recommend!

author: dave brabham
review_text: Been there twice this week.  1 st time I ate in the restaurant and it was great. The second time I took meals to go. Great food an great seevice.

author: Sarah Juarez (Sarah Juarez, REALTOR)
review_text: Great food!  Love that you can pick your own ingredients and then watch them cook it.

author: Jess
review_text:
We decided to visit for the first time after seeing their Instagram story, and the restaurant is tucked away on the outer edge of the Vegas Strip. You can tell the building has been well-loved and maintained. The atmosphere is decent, and the food comes out quickly with great presentation.

We’re big BBQ fans, and while the smoke flavor was fine, it wasn’t anything exceptional. I ordered the tostada plate, which comes with three small tostadas brisket, chicken, and another beef. Those were great, and the chicken was amazing. 2nd order ribs and sides. The ribs, however, needed a bit more time; the meat didn’t come off the bone easily, so they were just okay overall.

author: Justin Webee
review_text:
Great BBQ and worth the drive!

I’ll start by saying I don’t usually go to places I see on Instagram or TikTok — but my son asked if we could check this one out, so we made the drive. Totally worth it in the end!

First impression: the place looks kinda closed from the outside (half the signage is out, so maybe fix that, guys). But don’t worry, it’s definitely open during normal business hours.

We walked in and were greeted right away. The hostess asked if we wanted a booth or table, we went with a booth. The dining room isn’t huge, but it’s clean and comfortable. Looks like they do a lot of takeout, too. Our waitress could’ve been a little more upbeat, but the food runner totally made up for it — super friendly and took time to explain everything.

We ordered the Grande Family Platter ($110) which came with:
• Full rack of pork ribs
• 1 lb pulled pork
• 1 lb brisket
• 1 qt Hatch chili mac & cheese
• 1 qt sweet & spicy Brussels sprouts
• 6 Hawaiian garlic biscuits
• Plus pickles and pickled onions

Everything came out hot and fresh. The smoke was on point, the flavors were fantastic, and the OG BBQ sauce was legit — a little spicy but really balanced.

All in all, great food, solid service, and definitely worth checking out. You won’t be disappointed!

author: Charlie Te
review_text: This pace has been on my radar for awhile and I am glad that I got a chance to check it out veggie heading back home.  We ordered a variety of items on the menu just because it all sounded good.  The barbacoa tacos, burnt ends, ribs, brisket, and hot link were all tasty. I did really enjoy their Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese and street corn as well.  I really don't think you can go wrong with anything here.

author: Ashley C
review_text:
We finally got to try Humo barbecue and it did not disappoint. Their concept is a fusion of Mexican and American barbecue. If you’re a meat lover, this is your place!

We ordered the half rack, mouthwatering ribs, Barbacoa tacos, sliced brisket, half roasted chicken, and an order of fries. Our favorite were the ribs and tacos.

The prices were great, the service was fabulous!

author: Chuck Roast
review_text: The 3 different employees I encountered in my pickup order were all extremely friendly and made me feel welcomed! The food quality was fantastic! I really enjoyed everything we ordered the burnt ends, the brisket, bacon jam brisket, brisket taco, and the hatch chili mac and cheese. I jave been wanting to try this place for awhile and it did not disappoint!

author: MRS. KR
review_text: This barbecue spot is really good, it surprise me. The host was straight forward not friendly. It took a while for our server to come to the table. But when she did and the drinks and food came out, the story changed… delicious margarita and the platter was amazing however the Mac n cheese just not my style. The dessert was just enough to satisfy the sweet tooth. Really good place, I would go back and recommend!!

author: claire wiedmann
