review_text:
This local restaurant at Sunset and Sandhill serves delicious barbeque meats with a Mexican twist.  We got the Tostada Flight which I loved but my boyfriend would have perfered a bowl because it had salad on too of the meats.  We shared the half of the burnt ends which had a most flavored sauce where we didn't have to add a barbeque sauce.  They had 3 tasty sauces on the table which I added to my tostadas.  We chose the 16 oz hatch chili Mac. & Cheese which was one of the best I ever had.  Our server was great because he was attentive, took the time to explain the menu, and timely with the meal delivery.
The restaurant lost a star because it was so cold in there (90 degrees outside) that I needed a sweater.   Thus, I was too cold to enjoy the delicious meal fully.  The other downside for me was they didn't serve plain churros there which I like simple deserts.

author: JR
review_text: Gabby was very nice. Her recommendations were on point!  The Burnt ends and brisket were great. The chorizo refried beans were delicious. Almost wish I did not have to leave.

author: Wm R
review_text: Met up with a friend for lunch. I had this place on my list and she had been here and confirmed it was good.  Located in a commercial plaza so parking was easy to find. We were quickly seated.  She knew what she wanted and I took a few moments to look at the menu. I ended up going w to meats and one side. Requested the brisket and burnt ends along with the street corn.  Wow the meat was delicious and juicy. The sauce was on point.  We sat in a booth.  There was plenty of art around and that added to the atmosphere. We sat there and talked for quite awhile.

author: Nick Miner
review_text:
The brisket is really brisket unlike a lot of bbq places in Vegas. However, it is boiled with no flavor. The burnt ends were pretty good. I'll come back for those. But save your money on the brisket.
Both dishes came covered in pickles. I don't want pickle flavored meat, guys. Please put that on the side.

I was seated promtly. My order was taken and brought quickly. No complaints there. The music was far too loud.
Prices are in line with everywhere else.

Just to be clear, PLEASE PUT THE PICKLES ON A SEPARATE PLATE.

author: Brian Tai
review_text: The social media advertisements make this place look pretty good. The BBQ and food overall however, is very average. The pork ribs fell off the bone; that's not a good thing. Over steamed ribs fall off the bone. Well prepared BBQ comes off cleanly with the bite but still has structure. The brisket was very dry. The burnt ends were hit or miss. I did like the sides however. For vegas, this is "fine". I'd eat here again, but I wouldn't go out of my way to take people here bragging about it.

author: mikel simmons
review_text: I went with my cousin, when we arrived the music was a little loud so we asked them to turn it down. We ordered our food and it arrived quick. I tasted the Mac and cheese, I didn’t like it but my cousin gave it a strong 9. I tasted the potato salad, didn’t like it but I was told that it’s ordered a lot. They didn’t have baked beans. The ribs were a solid 10 the burnt ends were a solid 10 and they give you enough. Would I go back YES… The service was great.

author: David Mariscal
review_text: Amazing Barbecue!!!  The burnt ends and brisket are as good as any place in Texas, and those ribs are so meaty and tender, the smoky flavor is here with a fantastic selection of sauces.  Don’t miss out on the sides the street corn and sweet Brussels sprouts were straight fire.  Great service and personable staff make this hidden gem a BBQ goldmine!

author: Patrick
review_text: I found this place on IG. This is the best BBQ I've ever had anywhere. Better than John Brown in LIC Queens, Mighty Quinn in NYC, Hometown in Brooklyn or Truth, and Pinkerton in Houston.  Their sausage links were on point!  Can't wait to bring the family here next year when we come for the Big Foot Tournament.

author: Melinda
review_text:
This was our first time at Humo BBQ and we're hoping they'll expand across  town b/c this one is 20 miles from our house. So good it's worth the drive though.
We shared: Two Meats - Two Sides (Burnt Ends, Hot Link - Chorizo Refried Beans, French Fries) for $26. A bit pricey, but a lot of food.
Four Tacos (generous portions of Barbacoa, Brisket, Pulled Pork, Potato) for just $3 each!
Chan was an efficient and friendly server, honoring our wish to avoid the dreaded soapy-tasting cilantro (which meant we couldn't order the delicious-sounding Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese or Humo Street Corn unfortunately). But he also double-checked with the kitchen and the owner (manager?) told us the Chile Verde served with the tacos also has cilantro so they would eliminate it also. Excellent service and delicious food!

author: Jorge Chiman
review_text:
I always see this spot and never got around to going, and now I realize I've missed out this whole time! The atmosphere is giving tex mex, the food is full of flavor and the sides are very diverse. Not one overpowers the other. I got the BBQ chicken and pulled pork and it had a good mix of sweet and spicy with the Mac and cheese and chorizo beans. Overall solid experience would definitely come again.
Make sure you save room for dessert the portions are bigger than they seem.

author: Roberto Robledo
review_text: Food was delicious all the way from the Burnt Ends (food item) to the sauce they used. The bread was also soft and buttery. Also the Jamaica was home made. And the dessert we went with the bread pudding w the ice cream also superb. Highly recommend and plan on returning for more food items. Wow!

author: Harrison K
review_text: Great BBQ! I love the Latino influence in the BBQ flavors! Meat was falling off the bone. Sorry, I hit the ribs before taking the pic 😁. You have to try the hatch chili Mac n cheese. Only downfall is there are a lot of hard surfaces in the dining area and sound echos a lot. For most folks that's fine but I have some hearing damage in one ear and it was hard to have a conversation. Even with that said, I'm still going back!

author: Brenda Alvarez
review_text: This is our 3rd time coming and we have no complaints. Well just one thing to keep in mind Sunday’s they tend to run out of some items which is not a biggie for us. The food is great the ribs are full of flavor and fall off the bone. Best sides in my opinion and my parents is the potato salad and the corn. Definitely worth a try.

author: Lupita Luna
review_text: The meat was delicious tender and very flavorful. We had the Chico platter it had half slab of ribs and half chicken for me and my husband and some brisket all the choices were magnificent! The meat smelled delicious and tasted you could tell how well they brined it. Anyhow we had left overs and that’s what had for next day lunch. The spot was picked by my husband 🙌

author: Annaliese
review_text:
I’ve been to this place a few times and unless you’re getting specialty donuts, quiche, or their freshly made cinnamon rolls their general donuts aren’t that great. Specific instance is their glazed donuts and donut holes are cakey not airy. And others like maple bar are pretty dry.
But if you get specialty ones they pay pretty good attention and have fun flavors. One of my favorites are their peanutbutter and jelly. They also made some pretty good caramel and blueberry pie donuts as well. Perfect amount of filling in those.

author: Neil May (Spartan Claim Resources)
review_text:
Great selection.
My vendors love it when I bring boxes to their offices.

I bought this cute 3d printed spider for my grandson who is obsessed with jumping spiders.

author: Charles Cheese
review_text: If you’re looking for dry donuts that taste a day old, just come in after 7 AM. And don’t expect a true “Baker’s Dozen” anymore—apparently 12 is the new 13 here. Very sloppy. Staff also seem irritated if you don’t tip, which just adds to the negative experience. On top of that, it feels unprofessional when employees switch to Spanish to give certain customers extras. The combination of stale donuts, no extra piece, and poor service is disappointing. I’m not the only one who noticed—there were over 10 people with me upset about the change from 13 to 12. One customer lost, and probably more to follow.

author: Rohan Dmello
review_text: Amazingly fresh donuts and friendly people. I don't think I have ever had such fresh donuts anywhere. They even made a custom donut for my son. Coffee was great too. Anytime I'm in Vegas I am going to get donuts from here. I would recommend anyone who like to eat donuts once in a while this place is worth the drive from strip. Compared to other places it's is extremely affordable.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text:
**Carl's Donuts: A Legacy of Culinary Craftsmanship**

Along Sunset Road, Carl's Donuts stands out as a family-owned bakery that blends traditional techniques with innovative practices, rooted in a rich history dating back to its inception in 1966 by Carl and Lyn Sanders at the Wonder World variety store. What sets them apart is their commitment to quality and our ability to balance time-honored methods with contemporary culinary trends. Currently, the third generation of the Ramsay family, Amber and Brock, meticulously uphold the bakery's heritage, ensuring that every product we offer is a testament to our culinary craftsmanship.

**First Impressions & Atmosphere**
Upon entry, the bakery welcomes patrons with a complex olfactory profile that combines notes of sweetness and warmth, evoking a sense of nostalgia. The design ethos is characterized by minimalistic elegance; carefully curated display cases showcase a selection of pastries, while the customer service area, designed to foster a welcoming environment, makes you feel right at home. A transparent view into the operational kitchen enhances the experience, allowing guests to observe the meticulous production processes that define the bakery's offerings.

**Culinary Mastery: Donuts & Pastries**
Carl's Donuts showcases a carefully curated menu that emphasizes quality over quantity. Signature offerings, including the classic glazed ring—characterized by its delicate structure and balanced sweetness—are complemented by other traditional varieties such as glossy maple bars and the visually appealing pink sprinkle doughnuts, which pay homage to the bakery's nostalgic roots.

Innovation plays a crucial role in the bakery's evolution. Seasonal and monthly specials, such as the crème brûlée raised doughnut—which features a torched sugar crust that offers a tantalizingly contrasting texture—and the toffee-crunch bar enveloped in dark chocolate with English toffee accents, highlight the establishment's commitment to creative culinary expression. The incorporation of flavors like matcha and chocolate in a filled doughnut exemplifies an understanding of flavor profiles and ingredient synergy.

Beyond donuts, the bakery excels in creating high-quality pastries. The almond croissant is a prime example of laminated dough mastery, filled with a rich almond paste that enhances the flavor profile. Their quiches offer intriguing flavor combinations, such as spinach and jalapeño-turkey, known for their creamy consistency and layered textures.

**Final Verdict**
Carl's Donuts serves as a paradigm of how disciplined craftsmanship and respect for culinary heritage can elevate comfort food into a sophisticated art form. Each product, from the iconic apple fritter to the avant-garde crème brûlée donut, reflects decades of dedication, interwoven with contemporary innovations. Pairing their pastries with meticulously brewed nitro cold brew coffee further enhances the experience, offering a timeless connection between tradition and modernity.

author: Laura Powell
review_text: This is our new favorite sit-down donuts shop! Lots of creative, unique donuts. We picked blueberry cobbler, coconut cake, and apple pie donuts, just to name a few. Scrumptious ham and cheese croissant hot from the oven with fresh-squeezed orange juice. Nicely laid out dining room. We will be back to try the quiche and other specialty donuts!

author: Carl Everett
review_text:
Carl’s deserves all 5 stars, and maybe even a Michelin Star. The entire experience was fantastic, and we will be back. The doughnuts were made with care, and the freshness of the items at Carl’s shined through. Every member of the staff was super nice, and treated everyone in the store with care and a genuine smile.

There are many things I am looking to try in the future, like their cold brew coffee on tap. They have done good enough, I don’t mind them using my name on the building! I’ll for sure be back!

author: A Grandusky
review_text:
A BEST place EVER ☆
Our first time & everyone n everything was just too wonderful ♡☆
We took ssssoooo long in line picking out what we wanted aaaand nobody cared ♡☆ not one single person ♡☆
The selection is enormous ☆
Every clean ☆
Well lit ☆
Very open ☆
Great seating: inside & outside in the awesome shade ☆
They have a very nice water dispenser ☆
Fantastic music ☆
Some may say it's expensive.  ... THESE Donuts ARENOT your "store packaged" ones & for us, worth every penny ☆
Glad we came from across town!

author: Saira Rab
review_text: Delicious donuts made fresh! I tried their specialty donuts and liked their pastries! Recommend their croissants as they are soft not hard like some other places. The price range is similar to pink box donuts, but they offer more variety of drinks and have no drive-thru.

author: hottyson hottyson
review_text:
Seven year celebration for this location today. I have enjoyed all seven years to the hilt! BEST DONUTS IN VEGAS! We absolutely LOVE Carl's donuts. We always chose Carl's over any other donuts. They are delicious and worth every cent. All employees (except for one female) are always smiles and friendly. If you run into one of the owners, you will be presented with a bright smiles and welcomes. Thank you Carl's for always making it possible for my family to enjoy such delicious donuts.

Update: Jade M did not help my wife with her order and so it was too late as we had been rung up. If we had purchased a dozen items we would have gotten a discount. Jade M instead chose not to help my wife by suggesting a twelfth item. We spent over $50 and this is the service she chose to provide us. Thanks for nothing. Also no greeting and no smiles from her.  Jade M is ruining what was the best donut shop in town. Orange juice was still delicious. The quiche is yummy. And of course the donuts are perfect. Too bad about the service. We are going to go to another donut shop next weekend.

author: omnipresent original
review_text: Chris was amazing! He was super cool 😎  and super nice and polite to my wife it was so pleasant waking up with him this morning he didn't mind the million photos for the review and he found us the best croissants and donuts in the house we really appreciate it 10/+0 service today from our server chris so if you're in the neighborhood come say hi he will treat you like family

author: F
review_text: Day 1 of my vegas trip from New York we decided to get donuts for breakfast. This place was on my list to visit so why not try the famous Carls Donuts on the first morning!....We got a specialty donut which was the creme brulee, a chocolate covered mochi donut and a huge almond cream filled croissant! Everything was fresh and They were all delicious! This place is very clean and the service was 5 stars!

author: K P
review_text: This place gets it right! The donuts are incredible in flavore AND texture. The filled donuts are filled completely, no unhappy endings of just dough, there's filling in every bite. The flavors are incredible and they taste exactly like they are named. Now this is a donut spot right.....well why am I about to talk about brisket?? BECAUSE THE BRISKET CROISSANT IS INCREDIBLE! Tender and flavorful. Not just that though, the garlic rosemary croissants are also a hit and the ham, cheese, and red sauce (I cannot recall the name) quiche knocked my socks off. Now for my very biased very part, the blueberry thyme matcha!!!!!!! It tastes like a dream and is just perfect. The young lady with the black hair was also just wonderful from a customer service POV. I will absolutely be back and have already raved to all my Henderson folks about this place.

author: Jamiey Jo
review_text: Not only are are the pastries, donuts and cookies 10 out of 10 Stars, the customer service is amazing! I went into Carl's today and had the pleasure of meeting Carlos. He was extremely kind to me and made my day!

author: Erin Russell
review_text: Great donuts, atmosphere & super friendly staff.  They offer tons of different donuts, croissants and coffees.

author: Frank Palombi
review_text:
HANDS DOWN best donuts around ! Folks are friendly and the place is clean. More importantly the donuts are AMAZING. Light and fluffy and some really cool items you don’t see anywhere else. Worth the trip from the strip !
6/8/25

author: Anthony M
review_text: Great donuts that taste just as good as they look. Keep in mind that they will be overly sweet if you get a flavor heavy on sugary tastes but donuts with a tart filling are well balanced. It's a very busy place but the line moves quickly.

author: Sala Smith
review_text: They donuts are so delicious. Got a mystery box a dozen and every single one was delicious. The Croissant was so good. It had a believe it was pepperoni and jalapeños and cheese so good. I tasted it. The kids loved them and the adults let them I will be back.

author: Scott Alan Blanchard
review_text:
Oh wow!
Great, FRESH YUMMY-LICIOUS-NESS!
The smells alone could make you gain 10 pounds! I'm certain of it! I'm sure Heaven will have Carl's Donuts!

author: lvlisa
review_text: Online selection and advertising is false to what the store provides. Been there twice and they are out of everything. Jelly filled donuts are maybe a quarter filled. Donuts do not taste fresh, but stale. Not worth your time or money. Recommend Pink Box for jelly filled donuts- they are loaded with filling and quality of pastry.

author: J. P.
review_text: I ordered the seafood platter, and the entire dish was extremely overcooked to the point of being completely inedible. The texture and flavor were ruined, and it was honestly disappointing considering the price. What made the experience worse was that the staff didn’t offer a discount, replacement, or any attempt to address the issue. For what they charge, I expected far better quality and service. Overall, the food was overpriced, poorly prepared, and the customer service was lacking. I wouldn’t recommend this place based on my experience.

author: SoyAlonsoDc
review_text: We have been visiting this location for years. All the staff of the place are friendly and very attentive. The photographer always comes to greet us and today we decided to take pictures to remember the beginning of this new year as a family. She was very sweet and friendly 100% I recommend this place

author: David E
review_text: My favorite ever Mexican restaurant outside of Mexico and I am picky about Mexican food. Genuine Jalisco style food. Never had a bad meal here.

author: John Larson
review_text: Great AmeriMex comfort food. Great service and reasonable prices. Good bartenders and always sports on the TVs.

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text: Food is good service is even better. Juan Carlos was or waiter and the younger kids was his runner both did a great job ! We will be back.  Also glad they're open earlier again.

author: Farmer John
review_text: This was the BEST food I've had. Double-sized portions with low pricing. I was at the restaurant on Sunset for my birthday. Shrimp burrito, fajitas and a tostada bowl. Service and atmosphere are perfect. Some Pinkbox for dessert.

author: Robert Webb
review_text: Amazing food and phenomenal atmosphere! Five stars all the way! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Miguel Ferran
review_text: The atmosphere is ok, found the bar prices for the shots a bit high. Food was good but nothing that stood out above a like restaurant, beans were bland, same with the carne asada. Service good,nice employees.

author: Steve Facer
review_text: Not sure what happened to the location, but back in the day a super burrito would make you feel over full and would walk out feeling super satisfied. Today, we went in for what was expected to be a great sit down lunch. I ordered a super burrito and was presented with something that was just a little bigger than a microwave burrito and was actually smaller than their chimichanga. A total rip off for just under 25 bucks.

author: Stephanie Hanshaw
review_text: My husband and I flew into Vegas to pick up a rental van in this area and had some time to kill. We stopped here for lunch and it was so good! They let us place our luggage in the booth with us, provided excellent customer service, and my shrimp tacos were SO GOOD! Fresh guac and fresh salsa as well. Highly recommend!

author: James Trunnell
review_text: This is my favorite Mexican spot in town. The carne asada is perfectly cooked and seasoned and they give you a good amount of it with your food. I usually get the carne asada plate but this time around I tried chilaquiles and it will be my new go-to. I recommend trying it with both red and green sauce with eggs over medium

author: MissChelle827
review_text:
I think I've died and gone to Mexican Food Heaven.
The Chicken Mole had me almost in tears.
The Sopa De Fideo was rich and tasty.
The table salsa and chips were heavenly.
Service impeccable.
Muchas Gracias 🫡👌

author: Tom
review_text:
Our first time at Casa Don Juan. We stopped in for lunch and were immediately greeted as if we were old friends.  We were seated and Victor introduced himself as our waiter. He was prompt, efficient, and entertaining. We will definitely ask for Victor next time we dine here.
I had the shrimp ranchero and it was very good and filling. I am anxious to come back and try their many other dishes on the menu.
My only regret is that I have not tried Casa Don Juan before today.

author: Lee
review_text:
Found this restaurant on Groupon and the reviews looked pretty good. We ordered   Chile Verde and Carne Asada.

While waiting for our meal, we were served (4) complementary flour tortillas which, had just been freshly handmade by a lady standing behind a counter in the dining area.

It was apparent this was not her first time making tortillas. She was quick and her knowledge of the process was evident.

Customers were welcome to walk over and observe her masterful tortilla making skills and ask questions. If there was any doubt as to the freshness of the tortillas that question was certainly answered.

The Chile Verde was good but the Carne Asada lacked flavor and seasoning. The meat was a bit thinner than what I’m accustomed to but the portion size was generous.

The dining area had a  very authentic vibe with streamers, color patterns, and other types of art displayed throughout the restaurant.

There’s a very large bar with TVs to watch sporting events and other programs while indulging in a beverage.

Our server was great and had a wonderful personality. His knowledge of the menu was vast which, was greatly appreciated. The staff was very gracious and made you feel welcomed.

Overall, my dining experience was good but not great. With that said, I think I’ll give this spot another try sometime in the future.

author: R D (IEATFOOD&GOLF)
review_text:
Meh,

Food 2.5/5: Got shrimp tacos (again). Very under seasoned. Found the shrimp a little bit dry as well. Needs more mexican flavours. The queso dip was just ok and nothing special.  Food could definitely use more flavour.

Service 4/5: Great servers, drinks were refilled without being asked.

Atmosphere 5/5: Great Mexican feel. Decor was def authentic from the table to the kitchen.

Overall 2.5/5: wouldn’t be my first choice of mexican in the area.

author: Ernest Baca
review_text: The staff here are fun and love to keep you happy w food and drinks. Our waiter Victor was not only funny but fast and never let our drinks get empty. This is a spot for great Mexican food and drinks in town. So come in hungry and leave wobbly and happy

author: Gabriel Torres
review_text: I had the Menudo with the pig feet and no corn inside it. It was perfect - just like my grandma never made. My wife had the Lengua burrito - very good portions, but she said it was dry. Maybe they could use some more moisture infusion next time.

author: VelvetDaDog
review_text: Last time I came here the service/ food was horrible. That was May 2017. Now it's October 2025 still the worst ever!. We asked for 2 happy hour Margaritas. They told us Happy hour was over at 6 p.m. I looked at my phone it was 5:55 p.m. The Margaritas were bland. We ordered guacamole.  We received fake guacamole. I would say it's the green pea base type guacamole. It tasted like Gerber baby food. No spice no flavor. Now let's talk about the watered down salsa.  It's like they added water and vinegar to diced up tomatoes and cilantro.  The tamales were served dry and about 1 teaspoon of meat inside. We were charged 3 dollars for a side of red sauce (Tasted like canned tomato soup) and 3 dollars for a green sauce. We could walked over to Robertos and got better sauces for less. Check came to 70 dollars. Never going here again! Need a great restaurant drive to Juan's Flaming Fajitas!

author: Nechel Rodriguez
review_text:
This was our first time coming to this place and will be our last. I don't know maybe we came in the wrong time with the wrong Cook. But if you guys like a weak margarita ( I felt like I was drinking a strawberry shake),   a bland shrimp fajitas and if you like to pay $3 for a 2oz salsa then this is the best place for you . For a price over $20 or $25
IT IS NOT WORTH IT. We don't mind paying high price if food is good but this place is not for us. For the amount we paid, this place is no good.

author: Leslie Escobar
review_text: Very cute place decorated. I found this place through tiktok. The salsa that came with the chips was resturant stlye pace sauce not authentic. The michelada was more of a bloody Mary. I came to find a good molcajete and the intention was there but lacked authentic flavor. Prices were on the higher end. I will not be returning and authenticity being the factor.

author: Collin Martinez
review_text: This place is an excellent gaming bar. I win all the time.  Food is great! Ronnie is an excellent server. Makes us feel comfortable and she is very attentive.  Tony is the best! I can not say anything more.  He is an excellent drink maker and conversationalist.  He brings us good luck! A must go visit!

author: John Benner
review_text:
Get the breakfast potatoes! I don't care what time of day it is! GET THE BREAKFAST POTATOES!!!
Everything else on the menu is fine, but the breakfast potatoes with their rich sauteed onions and bell peppers keep me coming back.
Drinks are decent and the staff is just wonderful

author: Robert Erpelding
review_text: I ordered a $18.99 chicken sandwich that was as thin as a piece of paper. The main bartender really needs to work on her people skills. Not very friendly.

author: Macrina Rose Blanco
review_text: Watched Super Bowl 58 with our Jiu-jitsu team here at Bogeys. Was a great, friendly environment. The staff were so nice and always checking up on us. There were so many tvs which made it so easy to watch from any angle. Food was also good. I recommend this place.👍🏻

author: Eddie Sanchez
review_text: Love this place employees are friendly and Courteous.  Food tast great a couple times  messed up but they fixed it without and issues.

author: Spencer
review_text: The bartender Autumn was amazing and not to mention beautiful! It was graveyard so it wasn’t as busy and she took the extra time to chat and be personal instead of just dropping a drink off and walking away.

author: Jeffrey Tuggay
review_text: When I was out at Sunset Park umpiring, I had recommended a Team Git-R-Done to go there, and they did the whole team. They had a great time with good service, even better food, I was told. So I stopped by and gave them a try also and did not disappoint good job Bogeys I will recommend more teams to go there after games....

author: Abby Council
review_text: My boyfriend and I have been coming here for a little over a year. We love it here. Tony is absolutely amazing and always makes sure we feel very welcomed. The new waiter that works Sunday evenings has a great personality too. Overall, great food, and even better service. Will be coming back often.

author: Darnell Farrow
review_text: Food was super fresh and very tasty bar host was amazing and has amazing customer service  . I will be back

author: Vincent K
review_text: Food, looked like the pictures, very tasty. Workers were very friendly.

author: Robin
review_text: The grave yard shift is fantastic. So friendly. It's definitely a neighborhood bar that I would go to to watch games and hang with friends! The food menu is good! Lots of options and good proportions!

author: jim Ortega
review_text: I love this place, the bartenders are fun and friendly the servers are awesome, I usually go in later in the evening so I don't know about all the cooks, the guy that works at night is very very good. We try and go a couple times a week for dinner and a beer or two. It's always a good experience, music is usually pretty good over all. Also a good selection of beer. I have been here since Dec and have checked out a lot of the places in my area, and this one is my favorite.

author: Anya R.
review_text: First and last time trying this place, low quality food, slow service, bad experience all around, don't recommend this place to anyone with good taste..!!!

author: Albert A
review_text: Overall rating based on the past 7ish times I've been there. This time in particular, the wings only seemed to have sauce brushed over top of them, & the inside was pretty bland to say the least. I asked for extra buffalo sauce, but it wasn't the same. The wings are usually pretty amazing, so not sure what happened this time. The bartender was good, but seemed a bit overwhelmed (almost irritated at times). He still did a decent job & he reminded me of myself during some pretty bad days I've had, so I won't personally hold it against him. A few other things have happened recently & I've abstained from writing reviews because overall I still love most of the food there & it's in too convenient a location for me so I'm gonna keep giving it a chance. Hopefully it gets better. I still believe in you guys!

author: jeremy
review_text: Me and friends came to bogeys for our first time from someone who recommended the place, let me first say that the place was dead when we walked in, went to the rest room and it smelled like urine, hasn't been cleaned it looked like. Next we sat at the bar and it took us at least 15 minutes to even be seen to get a beer, by this time we were hesitant about ordering food but we decided to give it a try.. well I ordered the fish and chips and the fish was cold in the middle, my friend got the tacos and he asked for extra sauce for the tacos in the side and Normandy did he not get the sauce in the tacos but didn't get the extra in the side.. incompetent cooks it seems like they have in the kitchen.. be the last time we will pay a visit to Bogeys

author: Brittany Legnon
review_text: Our server was fantastic. She checked on us throughout our night there to make sure our big group had drinks and food. She was super sweet to us and even stayed later than she was scheduled, just to help her coworker out.

author: Marilyn Barber
review_text: First time trying Bogeys. I had been told it had great fish tacos. Naturally I had the fish tacos and they truly are fantastic. 3 tacos with chips and salsa was the taco plate. Ice cold draft beer. Highly recommend. Staff is friendly and attentive.

author: Donald Nassif
review_text: It just feels good. Walking into this place Place looks good. The air is good people that work there are great and the menus extensive so something new to try. I like this place a lot it's like a home cooker they got me.

author: Crystal Wilder
review_text: They are  always great ! Great prices, great food, FAF .. 😘 hot like a firemen  🔥

author: Char Xxxxx
review_text: Great prices. Not smokey. Not too loud. Intimate. The servers have always been amazing.

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text:
I've been coming here for at least 4 years now, but the last 2Xs, the food has been horrible . No flavor and just not good. The service is still amazing and the sever is really friendly and good atmosphere is cool local vibe plus kid friendly for lunch. Hope they get a new cook soon and bring some items back.

Hey taylor thanks for responding back i will definitely like to go back and give it a try again .like I said the last 2x have not been the best but at least 8 other times I had great food and great service,The Pic I posted is from a Lil less the 2 years ago and didn't take pics of my most recent visit.

author: Joseph Lauenroth
review_text: Atleast Nebraska won.  While in Vagas find the Nebraska bar.  We are used to busy Huskers games and this was exactly like home.  Sadly the food is just uninspired bar food.  FromNacho cheese sauce to bad chicken fingers.  The burger was actully pretty decent but a bit over cooled.  Service was a little lacking even for a busy game day.  I've worked them and it's tough day but it seemed like we were last on her list.  Will we give it another chance... if it's a Nebraska game yes but other nope.

author: Justin Webee
review_text:
Bentleys Steakhouse and Bar is a great spot with a local vibe. The staff is super friendly and helpful, adding to the welcoming atmosphere. The only downside is that smoking is allowed at the bar, so there is a slight cigarette smell in the air.

I tried the meatball Parmigiana Sandwich, which looked amazing but tasted underwhelming. It seemed like frozen meatballs on a hoagie with marinara and melted mozzarella. However, the onion rings were a hit - crunchy and well-cooked. My wife had the chef salad with blue cheese dressing, which was just okay in terms of taste.

The fries were pretty good, especially when dipped in their spicy teriyaki sauce. Overall, the food was decent but not outstanding. It's more of a casual hangout spot than a true steakhouse, but still worth checking out for the friendly staff and relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for grabbing a few drinks and enjoying the local scene.

author: Beth Harper
review_text: Great Husker bar!!!! Food average but fine! Thanks for having a Husker bar in Las Vegas!  GO BIIIIGGGGG RREEEEDDDD❤️

author: Tom
review_text:
Found a gem of a restaurant this morning.Stop by Bentley's Bar and Grill on Sunset for breakfast. The decor and ambience were quite impressive.
I had the steak and eggs and it was only $7.95! My friend had the vegetarian omelette and she was quite pleased with it.
I will most definitely be back!!!

author: CMB
review_text: Absolutely amazing! I don’t understand how there is not a line out of the door here. The lemon drop martinis by our bartender were great. We ordered the ceaser salad, lobster ravioli, filet and asparagus. The ceaser salad  is a must. The croutons were incredible. The lobster ravioli was the perfect portion and the sauce was creamy and flavorful. The filet was cooked perfectly as ordered, medium rare (the peppercorn sauce is a must) and the side of asparagus was the perfect vegetable for the meal. Also order the crème brûlée if you have room! The shell of sugar was crisp and came with a beautiful sliced strawberry. Presentation was phenomenal and the taste was even better. Our bartender was amazing very attentive and was so sweet. I will be back soon!

author: Larry Upton
review_text: Went for the Husker game on Thursday service was terrible waitress was clueless & walked away from us mid order & went to next table to take their order. Over a hour to get food & drink refills were approx 20 mins. Very dissatisfied. She said she just got hired that day off from Facebook.

author: Robert DeVine
review_text:
Went to watch the Nebraska game September 6th. Spent $62 on food. Alumni raffle ticket guyGuy yelled at us for not b
uying raffle tickets. He threatened my wife and I and said we won’t ever be welcome here again. I said no problem we’re from Nebraska. And we left at  half time. We will never be back and we will tell others never to go back. People from Nebraska don’t act like that and neither should they if they represent the  University of Nebraska.

author: Lindsey Charbonneau
review_text: Went for huskers game and had fun. The Husker fans were great. We even won an item on the raffle!

author: Lavender Star
review_text: Awesome customer service. Top notch food. Will definitely be back, often.

author: Arnesto Hernandez
review_text: Great quality and great portions. Best bang for your buck on the steak sandwich. Will definitely be back to try everything else.

author: ANDREW HANS
review_text: So, I went there with my son to catch up after his vacation. Figured we tryout a new s, ot and maybe we could use it as a regular hangout. Ordered a Ribeye and a pizza. To split.  The server asked how  we wanted steak, and we said medium rare. The server says thanks and walks away. Food comes. The pizza was great. But it was just the steak on a plate.   Im thinking to myself why didn't he ask what sides we wanted. So I said, "Where's the sides he said I could get you a menu.  So we spent $40.00 on a steak with no sides. Never going back there. It's not like it's a 5 star restaurant.  It's a dive bar with slots, pizza, and sandwiches. As far as ambiance, we had to walk around buckets as the roof was leaking. The only reason I gave them 2 stars is because the pizza was good.

author: juanita1 “Juanita” Pitt
review_text:
Froze my tush off.  (AC was cranking)
Food was decent.
Was not excited that they were holding a political rally.  I go out to eat to 'escape' the computer and TV.

author: Oscar N
review_text: I have to say I didn't expect this place to be as good as it was, food was excellent and our server Elena was very polite and attentive she made the experience even better and I will definitely be returning to this place, I need to try the rest of the menu ☺️

author: Sheila Frye
review_text: The food is great. The service is terrible no one ever in the restaurant but takes  over a hour to get the food. Ridiculous. Been coming for years this will be the last time!

author: Micheal Yerigian
review_text: The food was decent. Thought the potatoes might be instant mash potatoes.

author: 5880 Partners Peoria, AZ
review_text: Wow. A new wall for a nice room. Try the chicken caesar salad. We'll be back for the steaks!

author: H Holly
review_text:
Chicken wings were just ok . I've been there twice and no one is ever in there.
But the kicker is they charge you a service fee to use your credit card. I will not be returning.

author: Shane Morrison
review_text: The best atmosphere,  the coolest bartenders and staff and the adult beverages and food are second to none in this town and I've been here since 1997... check it out, you won't be disappointed

author: Greg
review_text: The filet steak kabob is very good, and sliders were probably the best I've ever had. Also, ask for Cheyenne, she makes the dining experience worth going back for.

author: Mario Martinez
review_text: We needed to find a place for a quick meal before we headed to the airport to fly back home. We had never eaten here before so we gave it a try. The food was excellent and the service was great. This was around 11 AM and the place was packed. The food portions are perfect and the banana nut muffin was great. We will be back on our next trip.

author: Sheena D
review_text:
First time here and I was overwhelmed in a good way with the menu options. The food was good and the portions are big. The food in the pics are actually half portions to give you an idea.

Ioana was the best server I’ve had in a long time. Very attentive and kind. She elevated the experience.

author: Duane DePhillips
review_text: The breakfast menu is awesome.  The eggs benedict was great, the apple cinnamon pancakes are amazing,  the banana nut muffin is amazing and the chicken fried steak and eggs are also amazing.  Our experience here was great and this restaurant does offer gluten free options. We will be back the next time we visit Las Vegas. This is our new go to breakfast spot!

author: Allie Marini
review_text:
Tucked off the main strip, this is a little gem past the airport that's perfect for breakfast. Good portion sizes, lots of options, good standard American diner fare with a Latinx flair. Bespoke sauces, salsa, & seasonings available for purchase.  We took home a bottle of the Verde hot sauce, it was super-fresh, balanced, & cilantro-forward.

The restaurant's cartoon eggs on the menu & a full-scale model train running the top of the area are great touches of whimsy that kids (or your inner child) will be sure to enjoy.

Bonus: You can choose a banana nut muffin or toast, & you really should get the muffin, it's ☆ heavenly ☆

author: Rian Krisna
Sadaf K
review_text: Tasty food, huge portions, and great prices. The banana muffin was the highlight: fluffy, moist, and delicious.

author: Brian Hinkle
review_text: Good food. Huge portions. Great staff. First stop from landing at the airport. Hidden gem

author: hans tuesta
review_text: Stopped here before we left Vegas. It was a great dinner. Extensive menu with lots of options executed very well. If you get coffee they leave a whole pitcher. Lots of options for everyone in the family. Pretty large portions and reasonable prices. Servers were attentive and the food came out at a timely manner.

author: Nicole Romkes
review_text: We had a wonderful breakfast with our kids here. Kristen helped us amazing with ordering our special wishes for our kids. Food was really good! Unbelievable quick as well! We still have a few days to go here in vegas and definitely will be coming back!

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Breakfast Spot – A Must-Try in Vegas!**

My visit to **Egg Works** was absolutely fantastic! The Mexican omelette was packed with flavor—perfectly spiced, loaded with fresh ingredients, and cooked just right. The sticky rice and avocado on eggs was a unique and delicious twist that we have never had anywhere else. Every bite was a delight!

Our server Ariel was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. The portions were generous, and everything tasted fresh and high-quality. If you’re in Vegas and craving an outstanding breakfast, this is the place to go.

author: Michael Smith
review_text: Even when the place is packed, service is still quick, friendly, and unassuming. There's much to like on the menu with big portions and fair prices. Some establishments, with their simple approach and attention to detail, can turn everyone into a repeat customer. Egg Works is that kind of establishment.

author: Penny Young
review_text: Seated very quickly nice warm banana muffin brought to the table we had the chili relleno omelette. WOW fantastic.

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text:
If you’re looking for a no-nonsense, hearty breakfast that doesn’t skimp on quality or portions, Egg Works is the place. This spot delivers every time—whether you’re craving a classic eggs-and-bacon plate, a loaded skillet, or one of their signature omelets that can put you out for the rest of the day (in the best way).

Service is friendly and efficient. The staff knows the menu and keeps your coffee full without asking—exactly how a breakfast joint should run. They’re pros, and you can tell they’ve been doing this a while.

The vibe inside is comfortable, casual, and clean—kind of that old-school breakfast diner feel but with a touch of personality. Everything just works, and there’s never a long wait unless you’re rolling in mid-morning on a weekend (but even then, it moves fast).

Bonus points for their homemade banana nut muffins and house hot sauce—both are worth taking home.

Overall, Egg Works doesn’t try to be flashy. It’s just good food, done right. A dependable spot that respects your time, your appetite, and your

author: Manuel Melara
review_text: Place was amazing! Food was delicious server was great! Had a blast! Highly recommended! 🥚

author: hladyt me
review_text: The food was delicious. Well seasoned and hot. I ordered the western skillet with scrambled egg and American cheese.

author: Hoan Truong
review_text: Great breakfast restaurant. It has that family vibe. The food quality is fresh and you get a large amount for what you pay. It is one of favorite breakfast location everytime i come to Las Vegas. The pricing is pretty affordable and friendly staff. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who want a good brunch in Vegas.

author: martymar77b Butler
review_text: This place was awesome!!! Those potatoes were great too, so try them. I got the pancakes and they were big as my head!

author: Robin Baker
review_text:
Blackened brisket spinach croissant eggs Benny
Chilli rellanos omelet
Watermelon mimosas
Ice coffee.
Amazing experience.
Will be back to try more!

author: DemonHideki
review_text: Best place to grab a good breakfast from i am from Louisiana and will happily travel here again yo try their food and also if you ordering foor make sure you get the potatos you wont be sorry!

author: Bridget Ohms
review_text: Stopped here for a quick breakfast and we were not disappointed!! Delicious food, great service & amazing atmosphere!! I have to add that their banana bread muffins are the BEST!!

author: Vee
review_text:
Stopped in for the first time the other day and was pleasantly surprised! The space is very clean, bright, and open. We ordered a hot The Palma latte (coconut) and an iced toffee latte, both half-sweet. Both drinks were delicious—I never thought I’d enjoy a coconut latte, but this one was so good.

There was only one barista working, and she seemed a bit overwhelmed with orders, so the drinks did take a while. I didn’t mind waiting, but just something to note.

The shop has a lot of open space—almost too much. With the limited seating, it would be great to see more tables and definitely more charging outlets for people looking to work or hang out.

Only Christmas music was playing during my visit, which personally isn’t my vibe, but that’s subjective. On the plus side, the bathrooms were very clean!

I’d definitely come back for the coffee itself (it was genuinely great), but probably just for a to-go order rather than sitting down.

author: Rachael Richardson
review_text: How quaint and beautiful is this place?! The atmosphere is so inviting. This is not your average coffee shop. This coffee shop is definitely anointed. I came here for coffee and ended up staying two and a half hours and didn't even realize how much time it went past because the atmosphere is so electric you literally get out of time and you travel into space upon entering this place.

author: Terry Herbold
review_text: What a cute place with some great offerings.  If you’re headed to airport later in the morning, do yourself a favor and head off the strip to support a local shop.  The Specialty Latte offerings are really good - I had the Lavender which gave a nice floral note to the nicely pulled shot.  The pastries, made locally were a perfect accompaniment to the coffee.  Cinnamon roll hit all the right notes with warm spices, scones and croissants were perfectly baked as well.  Get em warmed up!

author: Tatyana S
review_text: This coffee is insanely good! I live in San Francisco and love Blue Bottle coffee, which usually beats any other coffee shop for taste and atmosphere for me. I was absolutely blown away by Savor coffee and would choose it over Blue Bottle coffee now. My cappuccino had not only an amazing flavor but it was so smooth that I never imagined one could foam milk that well. I plan on grabbing another cup tomorrow morning before my flight. And btw the owner is a wonderful woman who truly cares and creates a great atmosphere too. Impressive!

author: Ashley Romero
review_text: This is such a cute place. I would recommend the honey vanilla latte, palm latte and the flourless chocolate cake. It is great that they offer vegan and gluten free options such as the flourless chocolate cake.

author: Erik Echezabal
review_text: This is a legit coffee shop. I would recommend to anyone looking for good coffee shop. The owner really cares about serving great coffee and food. The attention to detail on the equipment and store are all indicators of an actual coffee lover. I'm definitely coming back when in town.

author: Cole Young
review_text: Every time I swing through Vegas I make it a goal to stop here for an espresso and a pour over. This is easily the best coffee I’ve found in the state of Nevada. If you’ve not stopped here for a pour over, you’re missing out!

author: Scott Ferreira
review_text:
This was a great little spot we stopped in at while driving through.

I went with a vanilla latte and coffee cake. The latte could have used slightly more vanilla. Overall still a great way to start the day. I really enjoyed the coffee cake as it wasn't overly sugary as they sometimes can be.

Also, the cute little cups they use for the lattes were great. They held the heat well!

I usually try to do a coffee shop internet test but didn't do that here. I'll have to try on another trip.

Should you stop in, I think you'll find the place warm and welcoming. Enjoy!

PS - They have a little gift shop in the very back! Don’t forget to check it out.

author: Y T
review_text:
Love the aesthetics and plants! Support my IG @ytbossbae 🤍

The avocado toast (1st option) | The Valley girl with cream cheese was amazing! The balsamic gave the kick but also made me visit restroom.

I got the Palm latte (coco & vanilla). Maybe not a good combo with the balsamic 🤣 this latte is 7/10.

Enjoyed and love the rest of the coffee shop! Also mini store in the back if you love shopping with their styles!

author: John Happel
review_text:
I had the palm latte and the valley girl (cream cheese and avocado on sourdough with cherry tomatoes, microgreens, and a balsamic drizzle).
Both were delicious!
Veronica (the owner) is very friendly and makes delicious food and drinks.

author: Ernest M
review_text:
Food: I had their version of avocado toast. Took a couple mins to receive. For someone who hasn't been to a coffee shop in a while and was hungry. It was delish! I also had their iced vanilla latte with oak milk. Made to perfection.

Service: I love the nice touch delivering the food when its super slow. Very very nice touch.

Ambiance: the space is very clean and loving the wood tones inside the coffee shop.

I came in a random Tuesday afternoon. This is really close next to my house, so when I am in the mood for coffee and vibes, this is the spot.

author: Andrew Minarik
review_text: This is a Wonderful coffee shop. Great minimalist clean asthetic, Great drinks, good WiFi. A great place to relax and escape the craziness.

author: Maria B
review_text: Worst $8 I've ever spent. I purchased the marcha with the coconut syrup, it was watered down, the coconut taste was not good and maybe 5 sips is all I got. Place was clean, the girl that took my order was really unfriendly.

author: Valorie Chadwick
review_text: This is by far my favorite small-business coffee shop. They always bring my order to my table, and they’ve always been so friendly. Conversational, but respectful when I’m trying to work. They make their own homemade syrups and the coffee comes from a good source, so the flavor is always great. Aesthetic atmosphere, clean tables, chill music, comfortable temperature (they don’t complain if you adjust the window shades). I especially love the adorable book and plant shop in the back. Also, as someone with a service dog, I super appreciate that the owner seems educated on ADA laws, so I feel comfortable coming into Savor without expecting to run into people’s untrained pets. They also have coffee-with-a-cop days so I love how they actively take steps to make the community feel more safe. Hands down the most comfortable coffee shop in Vegas.

author: Autumn
review_text: Very chill vibe. Asked the barista for a rec and she made me literally one of the best lattes I've ever had. Everyone was very nice and helpful, place is super clean and comfortable. Also got a smores pop tart and it was delicious. Normal prices, nothing crazy. Definitely recommend giving it a try, also I didn't realize at first but it's a pretty Christian place so if that's ur thing you'll like it even more.

author: EmilyAnn1115
review_text: I was so surprised with this place! I have passed it many times and finally decided to meet a friend here before a walk in the park. The decor was so peaceful and it was a nice atmosphere. My honey vanilla cinnamon latte and oatmeal was amazing. They were also playing christian music and there was a small room in the back selling christian books and artwork. I was so impressed and I will de be back. I am also telling all my church friends about this place🙏🏻

author: Simone Rendell-Shelby
review_text: This is my new go-to coffee shop! The owner, Veronica is lovely too, friendly and knowledgeable. Amazing coffee and pastries, beautiful interior design which fits the overall relaxed/chill and Chic environment too. PS I recommend the Lavender Lattee with macadamia milk, the coffee cake and the blueberry and lemon scone. Even better there are vegan options too.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text: Nice quiet place to meet friends and have a coffee. They have a Clean shop and friendly staff working here. I think the owner was here today, she was sitting down and then got up to help the staff make some coffees!!

author: Sandra Gonzalez
review_text:
Clean and modern looking cafe. Loved the wood accents around the store.

I ordered a flat white and a s'mores pop tart. And my husband ordered an Americano and a caramel apple pop tart. Pastries and food were good.

The atmosphere was very chill and quiet. People were there doing work on their computers and then saw other people using it as a hang out spot. My husband and I went there for a quick coffee date. Didn't disappoint. I'm glad we came upon this place, we would come here again. 😊

author: Jo aisen
review_text: Love this place! The store is clean and bright. Their coffee is strong smells so good! We ordered cappuccino and ice latte. I love them! We also ordered Avocado toast. It’s great as well. Thick avocado with Balsamic…yummy 😋😋😋

author: Willie Ruiz
review_text: Great food. Very tasty. The service was excellent. Clean and spacious dinning area. They let you have the spices on the side to adjust your spice level which I enjoyed.

author: George Okinaka
review_text:
We went looking for a new Thai restaurant since our usual one wasn’t open today. So after a quick little search online, we decided to try the Buon Thai restaurant, and we were pleasantly surprised!

Sure the walk up to the restaurant doesn’t conjure up a nice dining establishment, but once you inside it was quaint and clean.

Then came the food, we ordered fresh rolls, Pad Woon Sen, crab fried rice and mango sticky rice. All of which were delicious!

Lastly the staff were very friendly and helpful with their food suggestions!

We’ll definitely come back for sure!

author: Coco A
review_text: We love to eat at Thai places around Las Vegas area since there's a variety to choose from but decided to try this place for the first time since it has good reviews online but our food trip got cut short due to the unsatisfactory taste of the food. We ordered Calamari, Drunken Noodles, and Green Curry. And based on my opinion they could do better. The Calamari is hard and you can tell that it has too much flour/starch and it makes it challenging to chew. We ordered the Drunken Noodles as well with NO spice but they still made it so spicy that we didn't enjoy it nor finish it. And lastly the green curry, it's so watery that it becomes tasteless and the rice is not fully cooked as well. The only positive is. the thai ice tea. To make matters worse we waited an extra 30 minutes to pay since their credit card system is not working. Overall it's a one-and-done type of visit for us.

author: frances stangroom
review_text: Very glad we found this hidden gem.  From the moment we arrived we felt like we were being treated like family.  Ole was our server and he was so enthusiastic and attentive I had a smile on my face the entire visit.  The food came out rather quickly and was seasoned perfectly.   We had the fresh spring rolls to start, then we had Thai Fried Rice, Drunken Noodles, Mixed Vegetables and Basil Eggplant.  We always get more so we can enjoy leftovers for next two days.  It was definitely tasty the next day.   Boun Thai is definitely worth the trip.

author: EW
review_text:
We had the mango sticky rice, crab fried rice and appetiser set here, all were good and can tell this is authentic.

The price is also reasonable.

author: Jhenu
review_text: Went with no expectation. Was pleasantly surprised by high quality and delicious Thai food. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone travelling to Vegas. Must Try !

author: Harry
review_text: Boun Thai Kitchen in Las Vegas offers a great experience for a casual dinner. The friendly staff makes you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. Ample parking ensures a hassle-free visit, which is always a plus. Their quick service is perfect for a convenient to-go option after a busy day. The portions are generous, providing excellent value for the price. The food is flavorful, with dishes that strike a great balance of authentic Thai taste. The to-go packaging keeps the meal warm and fresh until you’re ready to enjoy it. It’s a solid choice for anyone craving good Thai cuisine without the long wait. Perfect for takeout or a relaxed dine-in experience. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.

author: Isaiah Vang
review_text: What an AWESOME find! We love Thai food and this place was absolutely delicious. The atmosphere was fun with live music and karaoke. Everything felt comforting with a family style environment. Huge shout out to our server! He was very friendly and personable and made the experience enjoyable. Definitely will come again!

author: Prateek Goyal
review_text:
Boun Thai Kitchen is amazing! The portion size is great and the taste is fantastic. I would definitely recommend the place if you're visiting Vegas.

Items ordered :
- Pad Thai
- Orange Chicken (good portion size, comes with sticky rice, not overly sweet)
- Green Curry
- Chicken Satay (perfectly cooked and peanut sauce was yummy)
- Veggie Spring Rolls
- Raspberry Iced Tea (lightly sweet and very refreshing)

author: Jelena Zekanovic
review_text: Our new go-to spot for Thai food!! The service we received made us feel like we were just at home, such a warm and inviting atmosphere. We tried the Chicken yellow curry, the spicy Thai basil, and pork jerky. The flavor was a solid 10/10, we can’t wait to go back & try all of the other items they have to offer!! You really can’t beat the quality of food, especially for the affordable price.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Sharvari Thorat
review_text: We were so glad to find this place open late on Christmas Eve. The vibe was warm, welcoming, and the restaurant was spotless. The prices are perfect—meaning super affordable without compromising on quality. Portions were ideal for two, and every bite was top-notch. Hearty, flavorful, and truly satisfying Thai food. Will definitely visit again!

author: Paul T Nguyen
review_text: This place is a gem.   The food here is excellent! Service is great too. Wife and I had pineapple fried rice and drunken noodles with dessert not 1 but 2 mango dessert which was delicious with just ripe mangos perfect to eat.   We've been here almost every week to eat and the chef and owner she is so wonderful and great cook!  Chef comes out to make sure everything is perfect for us.   I have never had to thank the chef in person because usually they are busy cooking.   Chef here in glad she comes out and we thank her for such excellent cooking.   I definitely will be coming back over and over again and definitely recommend this place to eat to others! We've added other dishes prior too in our photos.   All the dish we are yummy too

author: Eric Merten
review_text: Boun Thai had some really good food. I love Thai food and I trybto eat it wherever I go. This meal was exceptional. So good. And the nice cook lady came out at the end of the meal and we had a nice chat about the spices n such. Lovely time.

author: Kimberly Schmaus
review_text: Olay (sorry if I spelled it wrong) was an amazingly attentive, kind, funny, and surprisingly intuitive server (he had a feeling I wanted a green Thai tea which is exactly what I wanted, and I didn’t verbalize it to anyone at all)! The food was so delicious along with green Thai tea and Thai iced coffee that we got, not pictured since they were devoured quickly. Where I live on the east coast, I’ve tried pretty much all the hot spot Thai places and none of them are as good as this place. We also tried the mango sticky rice, and it was so good that we decided to order another one as well as the fried banana with ice cream, which did not disappoint. We will be back here the next time we’re in Vegas! :) (also, I took the entree picture after we had already eaten)

author: Salty Sauce
review_text:
Hate to rate a place because of other customers but two girls were sitting next to me were gross and their conversation was not appropriate for a public place.

Other than that, the value and food was good.

author: Von Dominguez
review_text: Best Thai spot in Las Vegas! I live on the other side of town and still make the trip to come here when I can, it’s that good! If you’re undecided on what to eat and Boun Thai came up on your radar, just go ahead and dine-in or order that takeout - you won’t be disappointed!

author: Alexis Heu
review_text: My husband and I stopped here after a long road trip. Hands down, the best Thai food we've had in a while! We ordered the Drunken Noodles, Cashew Nut Beef, Sticky Rice, and the Chicken Satay. All were phenomenal! If we're ever near Vegas again, we'll definitely be back. Our server was amazing! We loved everything about this Thai restaurant. 10/10!

author: Ernest M
review_text:
This is in my neighborhood so I want to try this out. I wanted something to go so I can chill at home and do some errands as well.

They do have. Launch special from 11-3pm which I just missed by 40 minutes. No big deal. Just like any Thai restaurant if I never had anything there, I'm gong to try their pineapple fried rice.

Service: I got to go. No wait to order. Just pulled up and placed my order. There's a 4% discount if you pay in cash.

Ambiance: clean inside, they have a small stage for small performing acts. They have a an old vinyl record that's just for looks but a small speaker playing today's hits.

Food: pineapple fried rice. Plenty of meat inside. Rice is cooked well. Everything to make a good pineapple fried rice. Well done.

author: Leslie Lai
review_text: Came here for dinner with my family and we loved everything about this place! Ole was an attentive server and he described dishes in detail (including the Lao & Thai influence). We aappreciated the heads up in the spice level and also the condiment set that allowed you to adjust flavor and heat as desired. Ole said that the mango sticky rice was the best on the west coast and coming from California, I might just have to agree. Can’t wait to return!

author: Danika Randa
review_text:
I’m new to the area and was looking a Thai food restaurant. I tried another local place and I was not impressed. It wasn’t very flavorful.
As soon as I walked in here I knew the food was going to be good cause it smelled delicious! I was getting take out and just decided to get what I usually order. Combination Pad Thai spice level 3/10, Thai Tea and decided to try their Fresh Rolls. I took a to go menu and sat down to wait. After actually looking over the menu, everything sounded and looked so good I needed to place another order. I decided on the Chinese Broccoli with Crispy Pork, Mango Sticky Rice and the Garlic Crispy Pork. Let me tell you, I was disappointed with none of it!
The Fresh Rolls were so fresh! The rice paper was the perfect texture. The peanut sauce that comes with it was a delicious complement to the crisp of the veggies and shrimp.
The Garlic Crispy Pork was so good! So much roasted garlic flavor but not being overpowering.
The sauce for the Mango sticky rice was perfect! Tonya really knows what she’s doing! I’m glad I ordered it.
The sauce that the Chinese Broccoli with Crispy Pork has would be good to just mix with white rice It’s so good.
The Combination Pad Thai was good. 3 huge shrimp (usually there’s 1 small shrimp) the beef, chicken and pork were not over cooked or dry like you get at some places.
The Thai Tea which is usually pretty much the same everywhere you go tasted better. It wasn’t sickly sweet like most places. Very well balanced flavor and beautiful.
I have no complaints. The presentation even for being take out was great. Delicious food! The service was top notch! Chatting with Ole was lovely. I like the welcoming feeling and not just being a customer but a friend. While I was waiting some customers left but not before stopping to tell a worker how much they enjoyed their food like they always do.
Since I bought a lot of food they even helped me to my car. I’ve already told my local friends and can’t wait to bring them to dine in next time.
Thank you Ole and Tonya and everyone at Boun Thai Kitchen for a great experience.

author: Mohamad Osama
review_text:
I live close to Sonic warm spring in Las Vegas this is not a one-time thing it's a regular I have been waiting for like 20 minutes and we are only two cars the other car left and there is even no one in the Drive-Thru no one even bothered to answer us on the thing, or to come ask us. The stuff also are super rude especially the White guy with the blue hat this is my third encounter with him, except for maybe one or two. I looked from the window and checked they was literally talking to each other they didn't even bother look at us. And this is exactly the second or the third time ftor the same people I always come in around the same time after my work.
It was Aug. 25, 2025 from 7:50 pm to almost 8:30 pm youbcan check the cameras both inside and outside the store.

author: Diane Garcia
review_text: Night crew manager she yells at employee to hurry and she goes outside to smoke I sat there in my car  for about45 min  she smoked a cigarette every 10 min on her phone literally every 10-15 min she went outside to smoke. She was rude to employee . I’m suprised he didn’t slap the old lady. Or walked out of his job leaving her by herself.  She should be fired for her rudeness and laziness.  He should either get a raise or be promoted . He did a great job and stayed calm. Especially on a truck load night she just watched him while smoking outside while he maintained truck load AND the store. Which I don’t think it’s his position to be unloading.  My props to him keep up the good work  n patience. Old lady needs to retire n SMOKE her life away. Other than that food was great great service. I go eat almost every night .  I stayed ands ate there at the parking lot n this dude took it all like a champ worked extremely hard while old lady out for a smoke every 10 min sad but true. He needs to be recognized. Not being yelled at. She is mean, grumpy, and rude, to employee .

author: William Van Den Ouden
review_text:
This place is terrible probably the worst place to eat in Las Vegas hands down

The "children" burn your food don't change filters and the manager is a older lady that tries her hardest but the new generation walk all over her

They don't sanitize anything

All the drinks are nasty
Lemonade tasted slimy and gross

And I bought two bags of ice and the ice taste like it wasn't clean

Manager fixed it though and gave me back my money

This place is going to be closed just like the east lake mead location due to the children not taking it seriously

Sad

author: Cierra Gallego
review_text: Ordered through postmates, ordered a burger with bacon no bacon on it, ordered the pretzel burger to just get a regular cheese burger, ordered jalapeno poppers didn't get those either and to top it off ordered 2 shakes that were spoiled one was an oreo with no Oreo and other strawberry banana and I'm not even joking I took one sip and knew instantly it was spoiled!!! $60 worth of food and I was afraid to eat any of it and obviously couldn't drink the shakes. Postmates took care of what they could I called location to let them know order number and whatever they used in the shakes was spoiled they seemed to not care as if I was making it up. Saying they don't know how it could happen!

author: Quavail Leontay
review_text:
I’ve always loved Sonic as my go to fast food restaurant. It was my first job and it’s nostalgic to go back to, but every time I go, especially to this location, something is wrong. Usually, I just brush it off because mistakes happen but consistent mistakes and always have to wait 10+ for the meal I preordered is inexcusable.
Usually, the mistake is that my kids burgers still have pickles even though I asked for them to be plain. Tho lately my strawberry limeade slush ordered as a (limeade slush add strawberry) has barely a spoonful of strawberry sauce in it. I used to be frustrated trying to suck up all the strawberry pieces through the straw as I drink this drink. The last few times though, my lime green drink has hardly even turned red because they fail to put enough strawberry sauce inside.

author: Grace Freed
review_text: It seems that because I asked about the allergens for one of the food items, they decided to "punish" me by making me wait over 20 minutes for my order, a burger, and not putting any strawberries in my strawberry limeade. The workers seem unhinged. (Btw, if it's true they have no way of telling what ingredients are in the food, as the manager supposedly said, then this place should be shut down because that's dangerous.)

author: Keri Carrillo
review_text: A literal nightmare. We’ve come here 3 times now and each time it’s been a disaster. Long wait times, wrong food, terrible food quality, etc. Last time we were here was over a year ago so we decided to give it another chance. We went through the drive thru and waited in line behind another car for about 5 minutes. The car in front of us gave up and left. We then waited to order at the speaker for another 3-4 minutes without anybody talking to us. We finally decided to pull up to the window, thinking maybe the speaker was broken. When we got to the window the girl looked at us and literally said “huh?” We told her we’d been waiting for quite a while and weren’t sure if the speaker was broken so decided to pull up to the window. She again so eloquently said “huh?” Another guy (the manager?) came up and asked what was going on and we again explained we’d been waiting for quite a while behind another car that had eventually left then waited some more and thought the speaker was broken so had pulled up to the window. He told us that they’d just (coincidentally?!) started taking the car behinds ours order and we’d need to go back around and get back in line. By now, we’d been waiting over 10 minutes to order 2 blasts, so didn’t want to pull back around and wait in the long line of cars that had piled up. We asked if there was any way we could just place our order at the window since it was small & fast. We had to ask them maybe twice to take our order but we were kind and respectful and not at all argumentative. The manager said it wasn’t a problem and he took our order and we paid for 2 blasts with extra mix-ins. The total for the two items was around $15. We waited about 3 min, got our 2 blasts and were on our way. Parted on good terms, thanked them for helping us out and drove off. As we started to dig in, we realized that the 2 medium cups that we’d just paid $15 for were filled with plain ice cream with some toppings on top. They hadn’t put any toppings in the ice cream or blended anything. I called the store and let the manager know and while he did offer to give me a gift card for new blasts, I wasn’t at all comfortable going back there. This location is ALWAYS short staffed, the staff that is there is not at all trained, and they’re unbelievably rude. Not once has the food been right and a couple items have been inedible. It’s always taken an inordinate amount of time to take the order and then an ever longer time to get the food. Everybody at this location (including the manager) needs to be fired, an entire new staff hired and they all need to actually be trained properly. In a time when everything in incredibly expensive and treats are few & far between, it’s not right that these children ruined a the little thing we’d decided to treat ourselves with.  I will absolutely NEVER visit this location again.

author: Travis Coleman
review_text: This has to be one of the worst Sonics I've ever been to, they mess up orders quite frequently and the quality of it isnt very good. Not to mention that the wait times here are insanely long most times you order, Ive order on the app, drive to a stall, alert them I've arrived and sat at the stall for over 15 mins on several occasions. I live next to this sonic and we now drive miles away to a different one whenever we want sonic.

author: Mass Dragon
review_text:
It gave me indigestion. Way overcooked the onion rings in what tasted like old oil. Double whammied my insides.

Also somehow the Oreo Frost tasted sort of… bland? And I hadn’t been eating sugar beforehand.

author: Rachelle Hodges
review_text:
Arrived just before 11:00 pm, after a long day of flying and starving. Waited in a stall for a bit until a voice came on saying drive thru only.
Okay moved to drive thru. Waited 30 minutes to order behind 1 car. The person taking our order was rude. Took another 5 or so minutes to receive our food.
I ordered a BBQ burger with no bun (I'm gluten free) and this was what I was given. I've ordered this many times from other Sonic stores and it's put in a container with a fork and knife. This didn't have the grilled onions or other vegetables either.
Very disappointed.

author: Ray Cooper
review_text: Never understood a word the male cashier said. There was no greeting, and no attempt to repeat when asked to. I had to check my bag AT THE WINDOW to make sure he got the order correct. Of course this is after waiting over 10 minutes when I was the only one in line

author: Andrea Payne
review_text: I waited ten minutes for two drinks and it was obvious by the layers in my caramel latte drink that it had been sitting. Carhop was friendly n did apologize, but sometimes the app isnt better.

author: Christina Eagar [Detwiler ES]
review_text: Slow service. RUDE employees. No smiles anywhere. This place cannot survive for long with the crappy attitudes. We asked what time the half price shakes happy hour was and the girl just shrugged. We had to say, “can you ask someone?” She came back and mumbled 2. Then hastily handed the first shake, knocking the lid off and making a mess. She just stared at us. No offer of napkins or another lid. Handed us the second shake and closed the window. We had to sit there and get her attention to get the straws. Reading through all the other reviews I don’t understand why corporate is allowing this place to ruin Sonic’s reputation. Get a good manager in there and fix the employee’s attitudes. The quality of everything will go up.

author: George Bailey
review_text: When you're here ordering food and sitting down to eat it and ask if there's a restroom for the customers and they answer you with a rude crazy look I think it's time to call the health department. I think it's illegal not to have a bathroom at a restaurant where they serve food and drink drinks.

author: Becky Deitenbeck
review_text: Need to READ the order. I ordered 1/2 sweet/ 1/2 unsweetened ice tea via the mobile app. When I arrived 45 minutes later, the order wasn't made yet and it was wrong. I received all Unsweet tea with NO ice!! Will not be back! Double check your order before you leave!

author: Anthony Gage
review_text: I wish I had read some of the recent reviews, I waited in line for 30 minutes and got my burger and it was pure grease, the slushie I purchased was melted and the tots were cold.  I could not eat the Hamburger it was not edible.

author: Aliene Sasaki
review_text: The reason for going to Sonic was to fulfill a request or an out of towner. They wanted a Hot Chocolate Malt and an Orange Shake. Sonic does not do malts anymore so settled for a shake. The shakes were great but it took 45 minutes to get them. I know the business seemed a little busy for mid afternoon but this wait was excessive.  It seemed like drive thru customers orders came first, that is a management decision to prioritize.

author: Cory Stoehr (Raith)
review_text:
Slow service, was the only car in the drive thru, still took 15 mins to get 2 items. They got the sizes wrong,  and some of the order wrong.

I normally dont review places poorly, but this was wild.

author: Barry Chase
review_text: This Sonic consistently has the worst service of any I've ever been to. The grill goes down at midnight. The ice cream machine doesn't work at 2:00 in the morning. They're out of eggs at 11:00 in the morning. And this stop, they don't have enough staff so it's drive through only. This location has seen the last of my business.

author: Q
review_text: The food is good if they didn’t run out of stuff all the time . They got good people working there good service, the atmosphere is alright you have to sit out side an eat nice in the spring too hot in the summer to cold in the winter would like it if they had seats inside the restaurant.

author: Patty B
review_text: Not a great experience.. the place seems ok nothing to brag about!!! I have been to better places but wanted to see what’s the hype about .. and a total disappointment !! Not only did they charge me up front but they took the gratuity at an 18.0 % smh 🤦‍♀️.: I got a ham n cheese pennine with a cranberry mimosas and my mom had a avocado pennine and a strawberry ice matcha .. deff not worth my money !!!  She gave us  lays potato chips lol 😂 come on !!! Would I come back here ??? Heck no.. for what I spend I gladly would spend it at a place with better quality

author: Layer2chains
review_text: This is a lovely little Cafe. I took my family here and we all liked it a lot. Every drink we got was delicious and fancy as could be. Great for a lunch date or a daddy daughter date. The staff was very friendly and helpful and the prices are good too! Thanks Cafe de Flores! We will be coming back!

author: Jasmine Askin
review_text: Such an amazing café! We were welcomed with warm, friendly vibes and seated right away. The décor is beautiful, and the staff is incredibly kind. I ordered the cheesecake crêpes with the cotton candy magic strawberry milk — everything was delicious!

author: S. G
review_text:
The cafe looks absolutely gorgeous on Instagram, making you want to go there immediately.
