When we arrived, it didn't look very nice from the outside, and when we went inside, we weren't really impressed either! A bit of a mixed bag!It's too much from everything,the pink flowers and teddy bears are very cute, but Beauty and the Beast doesn't fit the concept at all! And all the other unnecessary stuff on the Table and in the Cafe either,too much from everything!

We didn't like it. The drinks were nice, the designer coffee was cold, the iced bear caramel latte was delicious, and the ice cube bear was super cute,the crepe was tasty.

author: Janet McMahon - Keller Williams Realty California (Janet McMahon- KW, Nevada)
review_text: Went with a group of 8 women & everyone was very pleased with their drinks & food.  It offers very unique menu from the pink teddy bear strawberry latte, the various crepes, salads & paninis.

author: Nevaeh
review_text:
We came to Café de Flores with a group of 8 at 11 AM and didn’t leave until 1 PM. We paid over $350 upfront for a so-called VIP experience we were forced to choose and it was a joke. We were sat at a dirty, sticky table we had to clean ourselves, then ignored for an hour and a half.

When the food finally showed up, it all came at once. No drinks, no salads first, and two plates missing. The salad was stale, the chicken crepe came with Lays chips, and the pizza crepe had cold, unmelted cheese. The only edible thing was the Nutella crepe.

Service was awful, the food was gross, and the “VIP” was a scam.

Was it cute? Yes. Is it worth your time and money? NO!

Save your money  go to the Bellagio or make crepes at home.

author: Christina Hernandez
review_text: One of my new favorite breakfast places in Vegas. Our waitress was very friendly and served our food hot and correct. The restaurant is clean. We will definitely go back.

author: Emma
review_text: Perfect place for some Instagram photos!! Ordered an iced coffee and Nutella crepes. The people working there were very nice and let us know we can take pictures anywhere!

author: Nathan Porter
review_text: Great little Cafe filled with a ton of decorations suitable for selfies. I got the Strawberry Classic crepe, which was literally stuffed full of sliced fresh strawberries. The Americano was also very good. Would return for the crepes alone.

author: michelle feather
review_text: The space itself is charming and very inviting—definitely a great spot if you’re looking for a photo opportunity. That said, the food was pretty average, and the drinks felt overpriced and watered down. Neither the food nor the drinks had much effort put into presentation, which was a bit disappointing. They also have one very pretty table that they charge you $35 a person to sit at.

author: See Thao
review_text: Very cute place for photos.  Crepes were really good. But everything is super overpriced.  I paid $18 for a small (canned) Chicken Pesto Panini.  I would've given 4 star, but the fact that they used canned chicken for a Panini and charge $18.

author: Kanetia Durden
review_text: This was one the cutest places I’ve been to here in Vegas. If you’re looking for a very picturesque, instagram worthy place to eat and take pics of amazing food/drinks, I would recommend coming here. The customer service was amazing and the food & drinks were also great.

author: Celi Valadez
review_text: Overall it was just ok. From the tap water provided, to the service and overall experience. I wasn’t a fan of my drink, a Carmel bear latte. Basically, the bears are ice cubes of either syrups, espresso, juice etc. they’re supposed to melt into the drink. So I was drinking room temperature Carmel syrup and milk, which wasn’t the best. I pushed the bear in the drink, but then my drink just tasted liked espresso. I ordered a classic banana crepe, which was ok. At first it was a little hard to get over the doughy taste, but the center that had more bananas and chocolate was good. From the moment we sat down, no one checked on us. It was only myself, my husband and son in there, but no one checked on us. As we were about to leave a group of Hispanic girls sat down. I noticed they did get checked on, which left me annoyed and curious as to why. Was it because my party mainly had males? Or could it have been because I’m Hispanic but my husband isn’t, and my son looks like him? The server wasn’t rude when she took our order, but wasn’t super friendly or looked engaged either. She did greet us, but that was about it. Overall just ok, but I can’t say I’ll be coming back, even though I live very close by. I wouldn’t say it was much of an experience. I hope the owners read the comments and recognize the areas of opportunity. I love to see small businesses thrive, and this cafe has a cute concept but needs to work on their customer service.

author: Chloe Snethen
review_text: The owner was so sweet and friendly. If you love pink and crepes you will love this place. The food and atmosphere was great. Perfect place to get IG pictures of food and of you and your friends of family. The bacon crepe and blackberry crepe were so good. Skip the lemonade and get a coffee.  I got the latte with an ice cream bear it was so delicious. We will definitely be back next time we visit.

author: Ed Tom
review_text: Most beautiful cafe in the world!!! Passed by here many times but never was able to sit down because of the long line!!! Extremely long if you want the prime seats outside! But it is so worth it.. inside is nothing extra ordinary!!! We were so lucky to sit below the iconic sign! The hot chocolate was really good and the best ham/cheese sandwich in Paris!!! Is it expensive compared to other cafe? Yes! Is it worth it ! Absolutely!  How often are you in Paris????

author: Cindy Chiang
review_text: Came across a Facebook posting which highly recommended this cafe and decided to stop by on my Vegas visit. Did not disappoint. Both the iced cafe mocha and strawberry banana nutella crepe were outstanding. The owner/barista was also very friendly and pleasant.

author: bills832000
review_text: Really enjoyed this place. The crepes here were amazing. The coffee drinks are delicious! Area close to the strip. Highly recommend to stop by if you’re in the Vegas area.

author: Ben Paz
review_text: The girl that served us had a bad attitude hospitalizatily was horrendous, we requested a table more into the cafe and because she wanted us to sit by the door which was windy outside. We saw many tables more inside the cafe but she denied, it was a table for 5,4 but she should make a acceptability, it was 2pm about to be 3, it was not rush hour we saw only 2 table sat inside. Overall place was small could be easily overcrowded.

author: Den
review_text: Visited today and ordered two crepes, three paninis, avocado toast, and 5 drinks, 3 of which had the bear ice cubes.  Total came to $161.  One of gals bit into her chicken pesto panini, and it had a big piece of plastic in it (1x4 inches).  We brought it to the gal's attention at the counter and she said it must have come from the cheese wrapper and apologized, but acted like it wasn't a big deal.  She didn't offer to re-make it or refund. Didn't even appear embarrassed by it.  The drinks were cute with the bear ice cubes, but underwhelming in taste.  The avocado toast had what appeared to be cream cheese on it and avocado slices and bagel seasoning, but again sort of tasteless.  I love to support small local businesses, but feel this place is way over-priced for what you get and lacks service.  There are cute cafes in Vegas with better tasting food and cost a lot less.  Only two people working and service was on the slow side.  Note, you go up to the counter to order, yet they add on an 18% service charge!  So our total included a $32 service charge for 5.

author: Kendra Gray
review_text:
Save your money!

I tried calling for 3 days to reserve a table. It kept going to voicemail and the mailbox was full. I also tried texting and only received one short reply. Since they were active on Instagram, I messaged them there and finally received a response about 3 hours later.

I simply wanted to reserve a table for 10 people for my daughter’s 8th birthday (her favorite is banana crepes). They sent me a photo of their packages, and I chose 5–6 of Package 2, thinking it would be a cute experience for the kids. I sent a deposit and was told the reservation was confirmed.

When we arrived, I was told I had to pay upfront and that everyone sitting at the table (including us 3 parents who were not participating) were required to purchase a package.. something that was NEVER communicated to me.

The cashier called the owner, who said that because I reserved for 10 people, everyone had to pay for their “Grinch Event” so that it’s fair for everyone. First, the had MANY empty tables. Second, I had NO idea this was an event and was never informed. *She said she assumed I knew because she sent a flyer and because I reached out on Instagram, neither of which explained that this was mandatory or required payment for all guests. The only reason I had to reach out on instagram is because they don’t answer their phone.

I ended up paying almost $300 for 6 kids (ages 3-8) and had to get everything To-Go so us parents wouldn’t be forced to sit outside while the kids ate inside without us. This was not the experience I planned for a child’s birthday.

The pink lemonade was extremely sour and none of the girls drank it. The crepes were just okay - definitely not worth $45 per person.

The place made for cute photos, but the lack of clear communication, responsiveness, and transparency made the experience stressful and disappointing.

author: B
review_text: This place is off the hook! Authentic Hawaiian food. Had the oxtail soup and the bbq mixed plate and the whole meal was so good. Gotta try the soup super comforting and nice size oxtails

author: Kalvin-Jay Villa
review_text: Always love coming to this location, especially Aunty Jinky, she always make sure we good and the staff always has quick service, good portions, and the atmosphere is just like back home, chill, always make me forget I stay in vegas but Hands down in my opinion the best location! Mahalo Nui Loa for the staff for always being welcoming when we walk in with da Ohana!! Get da oxtail soup, bugga is ono.

author: Brown Suga
review_text: Customer service was excellent. Atmosphere was nice. Food was overall good just lacking a little flavor. The teriyaki beef wasn't hot enough a little cold and the chicken stir fry was lacking flavor/seasoning. The lumpia and Mac salad were the best.

author: the Deveras671
review_text: We had a wonderful dining experience. The food was great, the restaurant was clean and well kept, and the staff was extremely friendly. Andy consistently checked in on us to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Highly recommend!

author: Kawai Kaapana
review_text: Food was great.  Adobo fried rice omelette and adobo/katsu combo.  Service was also good.  Veronica and Karen were awesome.  The fountain drink dispenser was not working properly but they both got it up and running quickly.  Great job and Aloha 🤙🏽🤙🏽🤙🏽

author: Chris Coburn
review_text: Stopped into Aloha Kitchen & Bar for breakfast and had the longanisa with rice and over easy eggs everything was spot on. The rice was cooked perfectly with great consistency, and the longanisa was super flavorful. The woman working the counter was incredibly friendly and even chatted with me about Filipino food. Great food, excellent service. Highly recommend this place.

author: Anne Deguzman
review_text: Aloha Kitchen is a very delicious and welcoming environment, especially if you enjoy Hawaiian food! The food tasted wonderful, along with the many times we have come to this restaurant before. The service here was very friendly and accommodating towards us, as well as the food coming out quickly. The restaurant itself is well kept and clean, not dirty whatsoever. The decorations and designs on the wall are very nice too! I highly recommend this restaurant to anybody.

author: Alohilani Villa
review_text: As a local family of 8 from Hawaii, we LOVE coming here!! All the staff is always so accommodating and patient! Very fast and DELICIOUS!! Aunty Jinky always makes our dine in experience feel like home! We will forever and always come here to get a taste of Hawaii!

author: Kalvin-Jay Villa
review_text: Everytime I come in here, it’s always an amazing experience. Ono food, and all around good service. My go to is da Oxtail soup and everytime, it’s onolicious, no gotta worry about it being a hit or miss. 5 stars all ova. Atmosphere brings me back home like Moloka’i or Maui. Mahalo Nui Loa to all da staff!!! (Only reason I went put $20-$30 cuz we get choke food cuz we haanngrrryy)

author: Rob S
review_text: Came in today Karen our server was very nice. We got the adobe rice and banana was delicious

author: Coupon with Cari
review_text: Great cute little spot off Maryland if craving for Hawaiian + Filipino dishes. Food were tasty and lots of options too; First time trying them out and staff were super friendly shout out to CT and Aeron.

author: Jennifer Bell
review_text: Aloha Kitchen is a go-to spot for delicious, comforting Hawaiian food. Their new late-night special from 10pm-midnight for just $6 is a great deal, featuring favorites like the chicken bowl and spam musubi. The food is always fresh, flavorful, and served up quickly with friendly service. You really can’t go wrong—perfect for a satisfying meal any time of day!

author: Jordan Hollier
review_text: I recently visited Aloha Kitchen & Bar and had a great experience. I tried the local plate, and it was absolutely delicious—each bite was full of flavor and felt like a true taste of the islands. While I did feel that the food was a bit overpriced, the overall experience made up for it. The service was good, with friendly and attentive staff, and the place had a chill vibe that was very welcoming. One of the major perks was that it was open late, which is always a plus. I'll definitely be back for another late-night bite!

author: T Rex
review_text: Well I think I found my favorite Hawaiian BBQ spot in Las Vegas.I kept it simple and ordered the BBQ pork plate.A heaping portion of pork on two scoops of rice with Mac salad on the side.Came with some extra sauce on the side.Just delicious.Can't wait to go back to try the plates as well.

author: Robert Lee
review_text:
Obviously, this is a Hawaian food restaurant.  Their menu is that of a classic Hawaian diner.  That is a mixture of the foods from the different working class people that had immigrated to Hawaii in the past.  Probably the first fusion food.  I had their excellent oxtail soup, which is served with 2 scoops of rice, and it was delicious.   The staff are friendly and helpful.  The ambiance is like someone took a "local's" restaurant from a strip mall in Honolulu and put it in a strip mall in Las Vegas.

They serve generous servings of excellent Hawaiian food at reasonable prices .  And this location closes at 3 am.

author: Kim Tran
review_text: Always a great experience at Aloha! My friends and I always make a pit stop here when we first arrive to Vegas, and it always hits the spot. My go to is always the abodo fried rice & chicken katsu. Both are incredibly every time! The abodo fried rice is beautifully wrapped in egg & has big chunks of meat. The katsu has the perfect amount of breading to meat ratio. Definitely able to share with others too!

author: Jennifer Crisologo
review_text: Great food and service at Windmill location… the best hawaiian for me! Everything we ordered were so sumptuous

author: Jillian Marty
review_text: The staff was absolutely tentative, friendly, and very caring! The atmosphere was welcoming, clean, and the service was efficient! The food was great and reasonably priced and highly recommend! Big shout out to CT and Aeron for their amazing customer service!

author: Dustin Banks
review_text: Andy was great. Great customer service and made sure we were taken care of. Food had a little too much sauce on it but other than that it was great.

author: Liza Pastor
review_text: Wish the kitchen was 24 hours!!! Need to keep up with the times.  People will come all hours if the food was available.  Even if there was limited menu, it would be great for this area.  Gaming is 24 HOURS.  The sign and GOOGLE should reflect this

author: Tiffany
review_text:
Great customer service (thanks Jasmin) and I look forward to having another meal here! I was surprised and glad that they only grill their meats. That’s good!

There is ample seating and all the good jams playing as you enter the door. We are looking forward to our visit at the Phoenix location.

Update: Jerk chicken over rice, red beans & rice, greens and yams - I am quite impressed with this plate and I’ll tell you why. First of all, the food is seasoned and well balanced. Often times soul food is too salty or too sweet. This right here, is called balance! I enjoyed everything. The greens were perfectly tender just how I like them, however, my only critique is that more seasoning (not salt) be added and wish the jerk chicken came through a bit more. But, so glad it didn’t hit me hard like some places I’ve had!

The banana pudding was a surprise, because I thought there’d be more cookies, but instead there was fluffy pudding that seemed to have cookie blended inside? I could be wrong. However it was made, it was flavored well and I could taste the vanilla, banana and everything.

We definitely will be back to try more!

author: Lana Bryant
review_text: First time here and I will for sure be back. Everything is grilled no pork, I got the catfish mac n cheese and red beans and rice, everything was fire!! My daughter and her dad got the oxtails, literally fall off the bone deliciousness.

author: Talise Berry
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Black-Owned & Full of Flavor!

Taste Budz Creole Kitchen is the real deal! The shrimp, mac & cheese, and collard greens were all seasoned to perfection — pure soul in every bite. The seafood Alfredo bake potato was rich, creamy, and loaded with flavor. The staff was FRIENDLY and the vibe felt like home.

If you’re in Las Vegas or Phoenix, do yourself a favor and stop by — this is Black-owned excellence done right! 🙌🏾🔥

author: Melissa Boyd
review_text:
Went here because I had heard all these raving reviews on instagram/tiktok. Customer service… horrible. Doesn’t make you feel welcomed. I tried to hold a little conversation about how I heard all about their food, and wanted to try it. I was so excited. The young lady scrunched her face, and didn’t respond. She took away the excitement. I had to go get my id to be matched with card. When I came back in, the young lady was sitting talking to another employee, and didn’t see me (I guess). The other lady cashier saw me and just stood there, then looks down at at the cashier that was doing my order and started laughing talkin’ about girl you so ignorant, lol. Now I’m getting upset. Paid for my order and left. As I was walking out they were laughing about the incident. Absolutely no tip from me, and no more business. And people wonder why a lot of us don’t like supporting black owned businesses!!! DO BETTER…!!!

Oh, I ordered the lobster Mac n cheese, and the banana pudding ( more like cookies and instant pudding). The lobster and Mac is tasty. Haven’t touched the cookie pudding, yet.

author: Yolanda Leilani
review_text:
I recently won the lottery of bad customer service with Taste Budz. They lost my order, reheated my food, and got it all wrong. I'm just glad I didn't have to pay extra for the excitement.
The service was unacceptable and the food quality was abysmal. My party of six had a confusing and frustrating pickup experience, beginning with being directed to the wrong location (the online order failed to specify the correct address). After driving to the correct spot at 333 St. Louis St., a shared-kitchen concept, my order couldn't be found. We spent considerable time sorting out the confusion: four of my companions' meals were at the first location, and mine was completely lost. Forty-five minutes after I left, the restaurant called, claiming to have found my meal. Upon my return, the order was incorrect, and the quality was very poor. The salmon and shrimp were chewy and appeared reheated, and yams were substituted with cornbread. Despite the complimentary sodas and dessert, the entire ordeal and the final product were incredibly disappointing. I cannot recommend service to anyone.

author: Ebony Anderson
review_text: Walked in to an open environment with great music. She was already busy with customers but instantly greeted us. We ordered the baby boil, veggie loaded potato, and strawberry shortcake grapes. Words can’t describe how delicious everything was. If we take her back to Ohio, we would!

author: Serina Cardona
review_text: This place is 10 out of 10!!! Hands down the best in VEGAS! Cause if you aren’t from here… most of you know it’s hard to find real food! Love eating here & I’m always bragging to my friends and family to come here every time they visit Las Vegas!!

author: Mallory Horton
review_text:
I would suggest having stronger utensils for Togo orders.

I ordered my food 10 minutes into opening.

The oxtails had soooo much fat on them that once I got done peeling the fat off I was left with a little of unflavored meat. I would suggest to skim most of the fat off.

I would also suggest to separate the food. Not everyone likes their food touching. Plus it allows you to taste the flavor of the dish.  I asked for oxtails and Mac but the oxtails were served on top of the Mac in the same container. Thanks for not using styrofoam but a smaller portion size would be a great option too.

author: christinya ware
review_text: Super disappointed definitely with spending almost $100 on 2meals. Oxtails were hard and burnt. Mac n cheese was good , greens had no taste. If you get a “baked potato” please be advised that it’s not an actual baked potato. It’s a potato cut into chunks that is not all the way cooked I was so sad in this whole experience because y'all hyped this place up way too much for it to taste like what I received.

author: Sisilia Mataele
review_text: Amaaaazing taste! Customer service was great, very helpful explaining how to order. TasteBudz did NOT disappoint. Every bite was goodt! We’ll be coming back when we visit again from Cali.

author: John Williams
review_text: My first experience eating Tastebudz was by Doordash, but after tasting their food, I had to go there in person.  My experience was great. The food was even better eating coming out freshly prepared.

author: Lakita Robinson
review_text:
Wait time way too long. Waited almost an hour for food. Mac and cheese was good, Oxtails and alfredo was entirely too salty. For the taste and wait, I’ll try another location, if it’s not good. I’m just be good on Tastebudz.

OH YEAH THEN AFTER 1 HOUR WAIT FOR YOUR FOOD and your food still is not Ready. They OFFER NO REFUNDS!! They have signs stating no Refunds… Spare Yourself!! Your Money your Time.

author: Karlyne Neemia
review_text: First time coming here today. I asked the cashier for some recommendations. She did not lie. Everything she suggested was on point. She was sweet and helped us go through the menu to try some stuff out. Food came fast. And they packed my plate. I only tried a few things this time but I will go back to try some more. This time I got the oxtail with Mac and greens with the gravy on the side. And also got the seafood gumbo and the banana pudding. They got a mix of Creole and Jerk so flavors are definitely there. I’d come back again.

author: Ashlee R.
review_text: Jasmine was very helpful and helped understand the menu, ordering process and what comes with what we ordered. Most folks including myself get their order to-go so don't think you made the wrong choice if you don't see the place packed. Food is a 10 out of 10. I would recommend.

author: kl33tus
review_text: Maaaaan this food is good. The staff was very kind and helpful since it was my first time. The restaurant has a lot of tables and chairs and they were all clean. I highly recommend the jerk chicken and shrimp. The cornbread is amazing too

author: Sequoia Wright
review_text: Hello, so 1st time back here at this Decatur location bc I had my Mouth watered & set on their Oaxtail mac but once Receiving it, Driving all the way Home from work (not to Mention), Tasting it to see wassup, I instantly became Upset smh Mac & cheese a little dry, 1 oaxtail was cooked Perfectly & well the 2nd one, Not so much, meat not Tender enough & here's a Pic to Prove it as well. Last time I checked, this Meal use to be Bigger portioned & you had 3 tails instead of 2 as well; Probably won't be Coming back here for any Good eats😩  I just want my Money back, Refund me please & thank you!

author: caitlin mathews
review_text:
We found Taste Budz Creole Kitchen thanks to TikTok recommendations, and it definitely lived up to the hype! The menu is on the pricier side, but honestly, it was worth it for the quality and flavor.

We ordered the large seafood gumbo, a side of mac & cheese, banana pudding, and two waters — total came out to $54. The gumbo was packed with bold, rich flavor and just the right amount of spice. You could tell it was made with care. The mac & cheese was a pleasant surprise — creamy, cheesy, and delicious all on its own.

The only thing we weren’t crazy about was the banana pudding. It was mostly vanilla cookies with very little actual pudding and no bananas, which was a bit disappointing compared to the rest of the meal.

Overall, the food was delicious, and we’d definitely come back again. A solid stop in Vegas if you’re craving authentic Creole comfort food!

author: Sprinkles
review_text: It was a wonderful experience. Our cashier was Delilah and she was awesome. Very informative and knowledgeable about the menu. She recommended that we try the banana pudding and the stuffed grapes and she was so right because they were so good. I will definitely be coming back here.

author: Terroll Fields
review_text:
Prices are a bit Steep, but The Food was Amazingly Great!

This is the True Definition of Soul Food!!!

Both of the T's were are Great Employees, not to mention the Bomb Chef!

author: ashley munn
review_text: Tastebudz never disappoints! The food is slapping every single time — full of flavor, fresh, and worth every dollar. The atmosphere is super chill, perfect for eating in or grabbing food on the go. And honestly, every cashier I’ve come in contact with has been so nice and friendly. Great vibes, great service, great food. Definitely one of my favorite spots!

author: Dr. Frances Ince
review_text:
Red Lobster continues to impress! The food was exceptionally good, and the seafood boil was as delicious as ever. This has always been one of our favorite places to eat, and over the last couple of months, both the service and the food have been outstanding.

Many years ago, this location was always busy with a line out the door. Lately, it’s been surprisingly empty, with only the bar and one back section in use. I’m not sure if it’s due to staffing, the economy, or something else—but the quality hasn’t changed.

The food is consistently delicious, the greeters at the front are always friendly and welcoming, and our server was top-notch. Highly recommend this location!

author: Jada Beasley [West Prep MS]
review_text: I had a great experience at Red Lobster on Decatur. Everyone was so nice. The host who brought me in, to the waiter who served me, they all made sure I was satisfied. Then the manager Whitney I believe her name was came over and asked how everything was and was sweet too. Wonderful lunch experience on my late grandpa’s birthday.

author: Ariel Jones
review_text: Linda was a breath of fresh air! We had wonderful meal here thanks to her incredible service and positive attitude. After a bad experience at a different Red Lobster in Henderson we weren't sure if we'd give the restaurant another chance...but Linda made us fans again!! The food was cooked to perfection too!

author: El
review_text:
It has been awhile since I was at RL again.  This time I took my son and surprising they offer “ Shrimp” choices for Kids meal.
Overall Food was great and most part was our waitress Ms Paola had enhanced our dining experience to escalates to its maximum.
We had an enjoyable dining experience by her attentiveness and enthusiasm service.  She is among the BEST in service industry we experienced.
One of our most comfortable meal here and look forward to going back again.  Thank you

author: PB Russell (Bernie)
review_text:
Francisco was awesome!

We had a great happy hour before catching a show later. I had the shrimp three ways and they were all delicious. I loooove me some Shrimp Alfredo. Hubs had the King's Platter or whatever w Lobster and Scallops. I loved his scallops in my garlic butter. My favorite part is that the food was all cooked so well.

The restaurant feels dated but Cisco made our visit awesome.

author: Willie Battle
review_text:
Service was great. Our waitress was kind and attentive.
I ordered the Carb Pasta which was ok but I got really full on a few bites.
Bring your own crab tools 🛠️
We also ordered the Crab-u-let or whatever.. looks great but unfortunately that’s all I can say that’s good. They were out of Cajun sauce so we had to deal with the only sauce they had at the time. We really couldn’t taste the crab meat cause we had tools to open… our kind waitress tried to go find some but no luck..

We came because of the new promotion ad but it left us disappointed.

I definitely won’t be coming back.

author: Tiffini Tasby
review_text: What a great Christmas dinner. Linda and her team was fantastic! I loved the service and my food was phenomenal! I need a wheel barrel to get out of here. Lost my parents last year. It felt like home in this atmosphere. Great music great times with my loved one. Thank you Linda for being a wonderful person to meet with a great heart plus funny!

author: Kira Reed
review_text: Excellent service today from Nick- the skier. I came in for the Vets day lunch special after getting an email from RL. The special was Walts shrimp and chips with cole slaw, and of course the yummy cheddar bay biscuits. A perfect lunch and excellent service. Not too crowded and a pleasant temperature inside. I didn't need my jacket. Great experience and service. Thanks for treating Veterans. We appreciate your dedication to us and how you treat your wonderful staff who are on the front lines providing consistent great service to us.

author: Eline Valoaga
review_text: Food was Delicious! I love coming to this location. Atmosphere was Wonderful as always. Service was good. The greeting when we walked through the door and being seated, Awesome! I was trying to be understanding that we were getting forgotten on certain things. I chopped it up to she said she was kinda new and I just told my daughter she was busy. To let’s leave it at that. We tipped her well and I talked to her and gave words of encouragement. If you get a server and she says she’s only been there for a few months, well, I’ll pray for her. I would definitely keep going back.

author: Desiree Joseph
review_text:
I haven't been to this restaurant, since the pandemic.
I must say I was pleasantly surprised.
From the hostess,to my waiter Joseph, the bartender that made my drinks, and the chef that prepared my food.
Everything and everyone was on point, beautiful personalities, atmosphere was chill, and the price was worth every bite.
I highly recommend you drop by for a delicious meal and memorable dinning experience.

author: Gene Agawin
review_text: After a night long drive with my Cybertruck (Foundation Series), my brother in law and I decided to stop here in Red Lobster Summerlin Nevada. Red Lobster is one of our favorite sea food restaurants so while cruising along the road, as soon as we saw this Red Lobster, we stopped to check it out. We looked the menu and ordered, as usual the lobster was good and all its sides but to top it all and more importantly - the service - is topnotch - I took a picture of our friendly, courteous server (sorry forgot her name). As a bonus, at that time, I was searching in my Tesla App for a supercharger since my Cybertruck's batt is low and bam! it popped in my phone that a Tesla supercharger is located just behind this Red Lobster - wow, what a pleasant surprise! We dined and charged the Cybertruck at the same time! awesome 👍

author: Sandy Johnson
review_text: My server Ms. Debby was awesome. She was very attentive tour needs. Not to mention the food came hot!! Perfect meal

author: Jamie Keno
review_text: Barely anyone in there the night we went. And the bartender couldn't even shake a margarita. For a $200 bill- just order wine here, because the bartender can't be bothered to make a decent drink. LAZY

author: steve herman
review_text: We ate here on Christmas day and Linda our waitress and server was the best, the highlight of our dinner. Linda talked to us, cared about our service, she was amazing. 76 year old waitress working on Christmas and giving the best service ever

author: Mrs Pittman
review_text: 1/26/24 between 630pm to 730pm and sat at the bar. The waitress was excellent and made our 1st to this location very welcoming. We would dine in again just because of the excellent service we received. I know prices are inflated but please don’t short us on the portions of our food. What was most upsetting was the lobster dip we ordered to go and it was $16.99 but what we received I believe we should’ve only paid $6.99!!!! We received more chips than dip 🤦‍♀️ The food was good but the portions didn’t weigh out for what we were charged. If you look at the menu for the lobster dip and compare to what we received, you’d be as upset as we are for how much we spent last night. Red Lobster do better please!!!!

author: Necie Aevum
review_text: Sarah was our server and was amazing! My mom always loved going to Red Lobster for her birfday for lobster, but has passed away. So for her birthday we went in to maintain the tradition and Sarah brought out an adorable sundae in my mom's honor 🥰 So thoughtful!! Great service and great food.

author: Alson Asehan
review_text: Started the month of October trying Red Lobster for the first time. I can definitely say that it won't be the last! Service was great, thanks to Alex and Whitney! Food was delicious and the lobster pizza was my favorite out of all our orders. Overall, it's a perfect Red Lobster experience. Until my next visit!

author: John Mclaughlin
review_text: Amazing group of people at this restraunt. We had a big group event and the staff blew away our expectations.

author: Larry Berg
review_text:
New: The lobster is always perfect! Their new shrimp scampi is huge and delicious! We always get good service here. It's always nice and clean. We love going to this restaurant; we are regulars.

Old: On our most recent visit, everything was perfect. We heard the ownership had recently changed hands. From what I've researched, a seafood conglomerate has purchased it. The food and service were unsurpassed on this visit. Every steak was perfect and great cuts. Every lobster tail was big, and perfectly cooked. Our server, Linda, was courteous, attentive and very helpful. Their Wednesday night steak and lobster special is amazing! So is the Tuesday night crab special. Every weekday has a special! Every time we come here, it seems to get a little bit better. Now under new management, we hope that trend continues.

OLD REVIEW:
Usually good food and service. Both can be a tad spotty during and after COVID. Always good portions. Good management.

author: Lydia Perez
review_text: The lobster tail was over cooked, it was tough to bite it. The broccoli had brown coloring, as if it had been burned by having been frozen. Please look at the pictures. Everything else was good, The waitress was on point, great service.
